title: Philosophy Teacher (Lehrer/in - Gymnasien)
description: Are you passionate about inspiring young minds to think critically, explore new perspectives, and develop their own ideas? As a Philosophy Teacher at Phorms Campus Hamburg, you will play a key role in fostering our international school ethos and working alongside colleagues to bring fresh ideas to bilingual education. Located in the vibrant Hanseatic city of Hamburg, our campus is home to around 730 children and young people, from nursery through to the German Abitur, within an international, German-English learning community. Our state-recognised secondary school (Gymnasium), attended by approximately 255 students, combines the Hamburg state curriculum with bilingual education, high academic standards and an open-minded, internationally focused school culture.For our Secondary School in Hamburg  we are looking for a motivated and qualified Philosophy Teacher (part-time, starting 01.02.2027)Our BenefitsAt our secondary school in Hamburg, teaching Philosophy is about so much more than exploring big questions. It's about inspiring young minds to think critically and discover their own perspectives on the world. In a vibrant, open-minded city like Hamburg, you'll spark curiosity, and empower students to explore ideas that shape how we think, live, and connect with others. You'll be part of a welcoming, international team that values fresh perspectives, and shares your passion for inspiring the next generation of independent thinkers. - Attractive salary with additional benefits such as lunch allowance, monthly public transport ticket or Edenred City Card, company pension schemes, subsidy for Urban Sports Club company membership and access to a Corporate Benefits Portal- Five days of fully paid leave per year to care for a sick child, plus discounted nursery and school places for employees' children at Phorms- Relocation allowance and support securing residency and work permits - Small class sizes and personalised learning, supported by modern facilities and technology, including interactive whiteboards, laptop-equipped classrooms, a learning centre and dedicated IT support- Freedom to shape your teaching approach, with plenty of scope for educational innovation and streamlined administrative processes- Comprehensive induction and onboarding, including a buddy system throughout your first academic year, as well as support for ongoing professional development and trainingYour Responsibilities - Plan and deliver engaging, curriculum-aligned and competency-based Philosophy lessons that encourage critical thinking, creativity and individual learning pathways- Regularly assess and reflect on students' learning and progress, applying modern pedagogical approaches to inspire curiosity and enthusiasm for Philosophy- Contribute fresh ideas and innovative teaching concepts, integrate digital learning tools effectively and continuously develop your teaching practice - Support and guide students and their parents with empathy, openness and an understanding of individual strengths, needs and challenges - Actively engage in continuing professional development (CPD), strengthening your subject expertise and pedagogical practice while sharing new ideas and approaches with colleagues- Ideally, you also teach French as a second subject and enjoy inspiring students to discover the French language and culture while helping them develop their intercultural awareness and understanding.Your Profile- Qualified secondary school teacher with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Philosophy, a teaching qualification (such as a Certificate in Education or Qualified Teacher Status – QTS), ideally with French as a second teaching subject.- Ideally, some classroom teaching experience following completion of your teacher training - English at C2 level and ideally a good command of German for everyday use, together with enthusiasm for working in an international team - A genuine passion for Geography and the ability to inspire and motivate students - A keen interest in modern teaching methods and contributing to the continuous development of teaching and learning- A strong commitment to personalised learning and enthusiasm for our bilingual educational approachAre you excited about making a difference, bringing your own ideas to the classroom and helping us shape the future of education? We would love to hear from you. Apply now via our website (https://www.phorms.de/en/career/jobs/job/philosophy-teacher-777/?utm_source=afa&utm_medium=jobanzweb&utm_campaign=HAM_GYM_Lehrer_Philosophie_eng_1126) .You can find out more about Phorms and our opportunities in Hamburg at jobs.phorms.de (https://www.phorms.de/en/career/hamburg/) . If you have any questions, please contact Sandra, via careers@phorms.de.We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Senior Software Developer (m/f/d) – JVM (Kotlin, Compose) in MedTech (Softwareentwickler/in)
description: Senior Software Developer (m/f/d) – JVM (Kotlin, Compose) in MedTechEmployer: PERCEPTEC GmbH Location: Technologie- und Innovationspark, Moritz-von-Rohr-Str. 1a, 07745 Jena Employment type: Full-time (partially remote work possible)Start: ImmediatelyAbout usPERCEPTEC GmbH is a young, innovation-driven and multi-award-winning company in the heart of Jena's start-up community. We develop new diagnostic methods in optometry and ophthalmology — driven by the disruptive changes happening in eye care. Right now, we are building a virtual eye test. It determines visual impairments of the human eye reliable and quick without an examiner.Our tech stackJVM (Kotlin, Compose Multiplatform, Gradle, JDK 21, SQLDelight with SQLite, Koin).How we workWe make heavy use of agentic AI coding to speed up software development.Your roleYou build the application that opticians, optometrists and ophthalmologists use every day. It is Software in a Medical Device under the EU MDR. That means documentation, traceability and patient safety are part of every feature, not a separate phase.You own client features end to end. You shape the architecture with us. You also connect the app to components built outside it — a measurement device SDK and AI models developed with our external partners.You will be one of two developers in a team of six.Your tasks- Build features in our Kotlin desktop application, from the domain logic to the screen.- Extend our own design system. It is generated from Figma design tokens and built on Compose.- Integrate externally developed components behind clean interfaces. Own what the app does when they fail.- Integrate the AI models our partners develop into the diagnostic workflow. Work together with our partners and bring your own AI knowledge to find a good solution.- Build our release pipeline. We do not have one yet. It needs signed installers for macOS, Windows and Linux, plus in-app updates.- Write tests first at the seams that matter. Keep the chain from requirement to test visible.- Keep the code clean and easy to change. Review your colleagues' code and expect the same back.- Work directly with eye care specialists. Turn clinical needs into software that works in a practice.- Document everything to meet the MDR regulationYour profile- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field.- 4+ years of professional software development experience.- Strong JVM development skills — Kotlin or Java. Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose are a big plus. We are happy to bring you up to speed.- Solid working knowledge of Python.- Experience integrating third-party engines, SDKs or AI models into a product. The ability to improve and tune models yourself, not just integrate them, is a huge plus.- Experience of integrating hardware into software is a huge plus.- Good knowledge of SQL and relational data modelling.- Good understanding of integrating hardware into a software product.- Practical experience with test-driven development, Git and modern build tooling.- Knowledge of building CI/CD for desktop software from scratch.- Experience in medtech or healthcare is a plus. So is any exposure to regulated development.- Strong analytical skills. An independent, structured and proactive way of working.- Very good English and good German (B1+).Your benefits with us- Shape the architecture of a product early, while the decisions are still open.- Permanent employment contract.- Flexible working hours. A remote start is possible until you relocate, then work from Jena.- Participation in the company's success through our employee participation program.- Receive tax-free additional benefits- Not familiar with every technology yet? No problem. We support you with a dedicated program for your professional development.ApplicationWe look forward to your application.Send your CV to jobs@perceptec.de (https://mailto:jobs@perceptec.de) , together with a short description of how you use agentic AI to build software. GitHub or personal projects are welcome.Please state your earliest possible start date and your salary range.

title: Gärtner mit Schwerpunkt Mähroboter (w/m/d) (Gärtner/in - Garten- und Landschaftsbau)
description: Du möchtest deinen grünen DAUMEN ausleben, lebendige NACHBARSCHAFTEN sowie ein schönes Umfeld mitgestalten und für gepflegte AUẞENANLAGEN sorgen? Dann findest du bei uns eine dauerhafte Perspektive. Denn Zufrieden Wohnen fängt bei uns nicht erst im Blumenbeet an, sondern ist Teil unserer DNA. Mach sie zu deiner und bewirb dich.Freue Dich auf:- eine spannende Kombination aus innovativer Technik und praktischer Grünpflege- die Chance, den Einsatz von Mährobotern bei Sahle Wohnen aktiv mitzugestalten- eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit modernster Mährobotertechnik- eine verantwortungsvolle Spezialistenrolle rund um unsere Mährobotertechnik- familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten - kein Wochenenddienst- selbstverständlich sind für uns: leistungsgerechtes Gehalt, 30 Tage Urlaub, ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis, Betriebsfeste, flexible Arbeitszeitregelung, Corporate Benefits, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, Zuschüsse zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und Bike-Leasing sowie bei Bedarf Unterstützung bei Deiner WohnungssucheHier setzt Du Deine Talente ein:- Einrichtung, Steuerung und Betreuung unserer Rasenmähroboter für die Wohnanlagen im Rheinland und Ruhrgebiet- Überwachung der Mähleistungen sowie Qualitätskontrolle der Mähflächen für einen störungsfreien und effizienten Betrieb- Erkennen und Beheben kleiner technischer Störungen- Optimierung der Mähabläufe und Pflege der eingesetzten Arbeitsgeräte- Durchführung allgemeiner Garten- und Grünpflegearbeiten in unseren AußenanlagenMit diesen Stärken passt Du perfekt in unser Team:- Begeisterung für moderne Technik, Robotik und innovative Lösungen- Bereitschaft, neue Technologien kennenzulernen und aktiv mitzugestalten- eine praktische, zuverlässige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise- Pkw-Führerschein Klasse B für Fahrten zwischen unseren Wohnanlagen (zwingend erforderlich)- erste Erfahrungen mit Mährobotern und Gartenpflege sind von VorteilDeine Fähigkeiten weichen teilweise von unseren Anforderungen ab? Wir sehen darin Potenzial für neue Perspektiven. Gemeinsam finden wir heraus, ob wir zueinander passen.Allgemeine Informationen zum Stellenangebot:Dein Arbeitsort: Leverkusen, Troisdorf – Nordrhein-WestfalenBeginn der Tätigkeit: nächstmöglichArt der Beschäftigung: VollzeitBerufsfeld: GewerblichWir leben Wohnen: Mit rund 23.000 Wohnungen in mehr als 40 Städten zählen wir zu den führenden privaten Wohnraumanbietern Deutschlands. Dabei sind wir sowohl im öffentlich geförderten als auch im frei finanzierten Wohnungsbau tätig. Mit 19 Kundencentern und Servicebüros, der gemeinnützigen sozialen Dienstleistungsgesellschaft Parea und rund 1.200 Mitarbeitenden sind wir nah an unseren Mieterinnen und Mietern und arbeiten täglich für Zufrieden Wohnen.Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt? interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit• Interesse an klinischer Forschung und Lehre• Bereitschaft zur aktiven Weiterentwicklung medizinischer Prozesse• Interesse an Digitalisierung und modernen klinischen StrukturenIhre PerspektiveDie Position bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, innerhalb eines großen kardiologischen Versorgungsumfeldes sowohl klinisch als auch strukturell Verantwortung zu übernehmen.Sie wirken an der Weiterentwicklung diagnostischer und therapeutischer Standards mit und können eigene fachliche Schwerpunkte in die Abteilung einbringen.Durch die enge Zusammenarbeit verschiedener Standorte und Fachdisziplinen bestehen umfangreiche Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen Spezialisierung und Weiterentwicklung.Das bietet Ihnen die Klinik• Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit• Verantwortungsvolle Oberarztposition• Attraktive Vergütung nach ärztlichem Tarifvertrag• Betriebliche Zusatzleistungen• Modernes und innovatives klinisches Arbeitsumfeld• Hochqualifiziertes und motiviertes Team• Kollegiale Arbeitsatmosphäre• Umfangreiche interne und externe Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten• Unterstützung bei der Teilnahme an Fachkursen und Kongressen• Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung• Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit auf hohem medizinischem Niveau• Beteiligung an klinischer Forschung und Lehre• Möglichkeit zur aktiven Mitgestaltung der Abteilung• title: Stellenausschreibung Sozialarbeiter*in/ Sozialpädagog*in im Jugendclub Strausberg Vorstadt (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
description: Der Jugendclub Strausberg Vorstadt ist ein offener Treffpunkt für Jugendliche und junge Erwachsene und einer der wenigen Räume in Strausberg, in dem junge Menschen ihre Freizeit selbstbestimmt gestalten können. Unsere Hauptzielgruppe liegt zwischen 14 und 21 Jahren, aber auch jüngere Kinder und Jugendliche besuchen regelmäßig den Club. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die offene Treffpunktarbeit und partizipative Angebote, bei denen Jugendliche den Alltag im Club aktiv mitgestalten. Das Clubteam besteht aus den zwei Sozialarbeiter*innenstellen und einer Erzieherin.Zentrale Grundlage unserer Arbeit sind kontinuierliche Beziehungsarbeit und eine demokratische, diskriminierungssensible Haltung. Wir stärken die Jugendlichen in Selbstbewusstsein, Eigenständigkeit und sozialen Kompetenzen, begleiten sie in Konflikten und Krisen und schaffen Räume, in denen sie Erfahrungen sammeln, reflektieren und ihre eigenen Ideen ausprobieren können. Dabei legen wir Wert auf eine reflektierte, strukturgebende pädagogische Arbeit, in der Beziehungsgestaltung, klare Haltung und Intervention zusammengedacht werden. Ansätze der akzeptierenden Jugendarbeit entsprechen nicht unserem fachlichen Selbstverständnis.Träger des Jugendclubs ist das Alternative Jugendprojekt (AJP) 1260 e.V., einem seit 1991 in Strausberg ansässigen gemeinnützigen Verein und Träger der freien Jugendhilfe, der sich der partizipativen Jugendarbeit und dem Angebot von selbstorganisierten und politischen Kultur- und Bildungsveranstaltungen verschiedenster Art verschrieben hat. Der Verein betreibt unter anderem die Einrichtungen des Sozialen Zentrums „Horte“ (https://horte-srb.de/)   und den Jugendclub in Strausberg Vorstadt. Der Trägerverein übernahm den Jugendclub im Jahr 2005 mit dem Ziel, den Standort als offenen, demokratischen Raum für junge Menschen zu stärken, rechter Raumnahme entgegenzuwirken und Interventionsarbeit am Standort zu etablieren. Dieser Anspruch prägt die Arbeit bis heute.Qualifikation:- abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium Soziale Arbeit/ Sozialpädagogik- Berufserfahrung im Bereich der offenen Kinder- und Jugendarbeit- idealerweise Erfahrung mit geschlechterreflektierten Ansätzen, insbesondere Jungen*arbeitAufgaben:- offene und gruppenpädagogische Angebote und Projekte entwickeln, durchführen und begleiten- Beziehungsarbeit mit den Besucher*innen- Beratung und Unterstützung von jungen Menschen in besonderen Lebenslagen- Mitarbeit an der konzeptionellen Weiterentwicklung des Jugendclubs und deren Umsetzung- junge Menschen bei Prozessen ihrer Identitätsentwicklung, Persönlichkeitsentfaltung und ihrer (Selbst-)Bildung unterstützen- fachliche Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Trägern und Kooperationspartner*innen sowie Netzwerk- und Gremienarbeit- Aktivierung und Jugendbeteiligung- Verwaltungsaufgaben und sozialadministrative Tätigkeiten (z.B. Konzeptions-, Berichts- und Abrechnungswesen)- Anleitung von Praktikant*innen, FSJ-ler*innen, Sozialstundenableistenden und Kooperation mit Midria e.V.wir wünschen uns:- eine selbständige, strukturierte und flexible Arbeitsweise- Organisationsfähigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit, Durchsetzungsvermögen und Belastbarkeit- Reflexionsvermögen und Kritikfähigkeit- Bereitschaft zur Arbeit in den Nachmittags- und Abendstunden- konzeptionelle und methodische Sicherheit im Bereich der offenen Kinder- und Jugendarbeit- Partizipation als Grundhaltung und leben von demokratischen Werten im Jugendcluballtag- Parteilichkeit für junge Menschen- Diskriminierungssensibilität- Identifikation mit den Werten und Prinzipien der Einrichtung und des Trägerswir bieten:- hohe Teamautonomie in der täglichen Arbeit, dem pädagogischen Handeln und dem Umsetzen eigener Ideen- flache Hierarchien und ein wertschätzendes Miteinander- Raum eigene Interessen und Fähigkeiten kreativ in die Arbeit einzubinden- Fortbildungs- und Supervisionsmöglichkeiten- ehrenamtlicher Trägerverein mit politischer Ausrichtung und breiten Netzwerken- Erfahrung und Kompetenzen in den Bereichen Rechtsextremismus, Netzwerkarbeit und Fördermittelakquise- sehr gute Erreichbarkeit mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln- *wöchentliche Arbeitszeit von 16 – 22h → die genaue wöchentliche Arbeitszeit können wir zusammen aushandeln.- Bezahlung angelehnt an TVöD SuE 11b, 30 Tage Urlaub bei einer 5-Tage-Woche- Möglichkeit zur Mitgestaltung der Einteilung der Arbeitszeit- unbefristeter ArbeitsvertragBewerbungen bitte per Email an:info@horte-srb.de (https://mailto:info@horte-srb.de) bis zum 09. Dezember 2026.Wir freuen uns auf Ihre und eure Bewerbungen.Bewerbungsgespräche planen wir voraussichtlich in der Woche vom 14. Dezember.

title: Service Line Specialist – SAP (f/d/m) (Sales-Manager/in)
description: Service Line Specialist – EPS SAP, Germany (f/d/m)About the roleAs a Service Line Specialist – EPS SAP, Germany, you will make an impact by driving growth for Cognizant’s SAP services business across new and existing enterprise clients throughout Germany.You will be a valued member of the EPS SAP team and work collaboratively with industry and field sales teams, SAP, hyperscalers and internal solution specialists. You will identify client needs, shape relevant digital transformation solutions and lead opportunities through the end-to-end sales cycle. In this role, you will:- Develop and execute a sales strategy to grow Cognizant’s SAP services business across new and existing enterprise clients in Germany.- Identify, qualify and progress opportunities within a defined portfolio of target accounts, building a sustainable pipeline of SAP transformation engagements.- Lead the end-to-end sales process, from initial client engagement and opportunity qualification through solution development, negotiation and closure.- Achieve annual revenue and total contract value targets for the EPS SAP business.- Collaborate with clients, SAP, hyperscalers, field sales teams and internal stakeholders to translate business requirements into compelling digital solutions.- Build trusted, long-term relationships with senior client stakeholders and clearly communicate Cognizant’s SAP capabilities and value proposition. Work modelWe believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position based in Germany, with regular travel to client sites also required.Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programmes.The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. These may change depending on the project you are engaged in and evolving business or client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.What you need to have to be considered- Demonstrable sales or business development experience within SAP services, with a track record of selling complex transformation solutions to enterprise clients.- Strong knowledge of the German digital services market, including relevant industry trends, client challenges and opportunities within the SAP ecosystem.- Experience developing target-account plans, building qualified sales pipelines and presenting service offerings and value propositions to senior stakeholders.- A strong understanding of SAP services, ERP market trends, digital transformation and the adoption of intelligent enterprise solutions.- Proven experience leading complex, end-to-end sales cycles involving multiple client, partner and internal stakeholders.- Strong executive communication, relationship-building and commercial negotiation skills.These will help you stand out- Established relationships with enterprise clients and senior decision-makers across Germany.- Experience collaborating directly with SAP and major hyperscalers to shape joint client solutions.- A strong record of achieving annual revenue and total contract value targets for SAP or related enterprise technology services.- Experience working within a global, matrixed consulting or technology services organisation.- Fluency in German and English, with the ability to engage effectively with senior client and internal stakeholders.- A bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline; an MBA or other advanced qualification would be advantageous. We’re excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Praxisanleiter (m/w/d) für Auszubildende in der ambulanten Pflege (Pflegefachmann/-frau (Ausbildung))
description: Wir suchenPraxisanleiter (m/w/d) für Auszubildende in der ambulanten PflegeEisenberg (Pfalz) - Teilzeit - flexibel, VollzeitWerde Teil der Cosmea Pflege Familie in EisenbergCosmea Pflege steht für moderne ambulante Pflege, die zuverlässig unterstützt und dabei eines nie vergisst: Menschlichkeit. Für uns zählt der Mensch. Dabei verbinden wir die Vorteile einer starken Unternehmensgruppe mit der familiären Atmosphäre eines engagierten Teams vor Ort.Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams an unserem neuen Standort in Eisenberg in der Pfalz suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen engagierten Praxisanleiter (m/w/d) für Auszubildende in der ambulanten Pflege, die unser Team mit Fachlichkeit und Herz verstärkt.Deine Aufgaben- Du begleitest unsere Auszubildenden während ihrer praktischen Ausbildung und bist eine wichtige Ansprechperson im Pflegealltag.- Du planst und führst strukturierte Praxisanleitungen durch und stellst die Verbindung zwischen Theorie und Praxis her.- Du beobachtest die Entwicklung der Auszubildenden und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre fachlichen und persönlichen Kompetenzen weiterzuentwickeln.- Du beurteilst und bewertest die Leistungen der Auszubildenden und gibst ihnen wertschätzendes und konstruktives Feedback.- Du arbeitest eng mit den Berufsschulen und weiteren an der Ausbildung beteiligten Personen zusammen.- Du unterstützt bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und sorgst für einen guten Start in unserem Team.- Du bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Ausbildungsqualität ein.- Du arbeitest eng mit der Pflegedienstleitung und dem Team zusammen.Was wir uns wünschen- Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als examinierte/r Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger/in, Kinderkrankenpfleger/in oder Altenpfleger/in bzw. Pflegefachfrau/Pflegefachmann.- Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Weiterbildung zur Praxisanleitung.- Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung in der ambulanten Pflege und/oder in der Anleitung von Auszubildenden mit.- Du hast Freude daran, dein Wissen weiterzugeben und Menschen in ihrer beruflichen Entwicklung zu unterstützen.- Vernetzung, fachlicher Austausch und Weiterbildung sind dir wichtig.- Du arbeitest gerne im Team, übernimmst aber ebenso eigenständig Verantwortung.- Du verfügst über Kommunikationsstärke, Einfühlungsvermögen und ein gutes Gespür für unterschiedliche Lernbedürfnisse.- Organisationstalent, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und die Bereitschaft, neue Aufgaben zu übernehmen, zeichnen dich aus.- Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B.Was wir bieten- Du möchtest mehr Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann unterstützen wir dich auf deinem Weg!- Perspektive auf eine zukünftige Position als stellvertretende Pflegedienstleitung- Enge Zusammenarbeit und Einarbeitung durch unsere Pflegedienstleitung und ein herzliches Team, das dich unterstützt- Einblick in Dienst- und Tourenplanung, Personalorganisation und Qualitätsmanagement- Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einer wachstumsstarken Unternehmensgruppe mit langfristiger Perspektive- Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle (z.B. 08:00 bis 13:00 Uhr) – angepasst an deine Lebenssituation- 36 Tage Urlaub (6-Tage-Woche) – angepasst an Arbeitszeitmodell und Bundesland- Kurze Entscheidungswege & direkte Ansprechpartner im täglichen Arbeiten- Attraktive und leistungsgerechte Vergütung zzgl. Zuschlägen- Klare Strukturen & verlässliche Dienstplanung für eine gute Balance im Alltag- Strukturiertes Onboarding für einen gut begleiteten Start- Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie Entwicklungsperspektiven innerhalb der Gruppe- Gelebte Vielfalt & ein offenes, modernes Miteinander im interdisziplinären Team- Teamorientierte Arbeitskultur mit gemeinsamen Events & wertschätzendem Miteinander- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge- Moderne Arbeitsmittel & digitale Abläufe, die den Arbeitsalltag erleichtern- Wachsende Unternehmensgruppe mit stabilen Strukturen und Zukunftsperspektiven- Interne Standortwechsel möglich – flexibel, wenn sich Lebenssituationen ändernDu möchtest dein Fachwissen weitergeben, junge Menschen auf ihrem Weg in den Pflegeberuf begleiten und gleichzeitig die Qualität unserer Ausbildung aktiv mitgestalten?Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und gemeinsam mit dir die Ausbildung in der ambulanten Pflege weiterzuentwickeln.Mach den Schritt zu Cosmea Pflege! Sende uns deine Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe der Stellen-ID: 5422.

development of new business by providing technical expertise, preparing quotations and contributing to the acquisition of new customers and projects.- Review customer specifications and define the required scope of supply, taking serviceability, spare parts availability and customer-specific operating conditions into account.- Perform thermodynamic calculations and process engineering design calculations and documentation.Your Qualifications- A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related field.- Previous experience in the sales of technically preparing quotations and negotiating contracts, as well as knowledge of thermodynamic calculations.- A strong customer focus, confident communication with internal and external stakeholders and strong negotiation skills.- The ability to translate technical requirements into compelling and commercially viable solutions.- Very good written and spoken German and English, as well as confidence in using common Microsoft Office applications and CRM systems.What we offerAt Kelvion Machine Cooling Systems GmbH, we combine a long-standing tradition with a forward-looking approach. description: Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.What your job includes- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes What we expect from you- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures- Autonomy in decision-making - Strong communication and presentation skills - Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficialWhat we offer youWe are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. title: Teamleitung Fertigung (m/w/d)
description: 1 Teamleitung Fertigung (m/w/d) Arbeitsort: SopronDarum dreht sich Ihre Rolle * Analyse, Vorbereitung und Konzeption ** Sie analysieren die bestehende Fertigung bei unserem bisherigen Lieferanten direkt vor Ort und dokumentieren die Abläufe lückenlos. ** Auf Basis der Daten setzen Sie das bestehende Fertigungskonzept konkret um und bringen sich aktiv in die Feinplanung sowie das Hallenlayout ein, um von Beginn an maximale Effizienz zu sichern. * Prototypenbau, Optimierung und Schnittstellenarbeit ** Sie koordinieren, steuern und unterstützen das Team beim Aufbau des Prototyps auf Basis des zugelieferten Bausatzes. ** Sie analysieren die Effizienz, vervollständigen notwendige Prozessdokumentationen im Dialog mit den Beteiligten und bauen ein System zur Qualitätssicherung in allen Fertigungsschritten auf. ** Sie geben technisches Feedback an das technische Büro zurück und arbeiten eng mit den zentralen Abteilungen (Technik und Projektleitung), der lokalen Geschäfts- und Werksleitung sowie den lokalen Meister:innen zusammen. * Serienüberführung, Arbeitsvorbereitung und Logistik ** Sie bereiten die AV vor, legen Losgrößen für Einzelteile fest und sichern die reibungslose Bereitstellung von Halbzeugen im Standardablauf des neuen Partners. ** Sie erstellen den Fertigungs- und Kapazitätsplan passgenau auf Basis unserer Bestellungen und Liefertermine. ** Sie überführen den Prototypen erfolgreich in die Serienfertigung und wirken parallel an der Entwicklung neuer Prototypen mit. ** Sie tragen die Verantwortung dafür, dass das Endprodukt nach unseren vorgegebenen Standards verpackt und transportiert wird. ** Sie führen und motivieren Ihr Team von 4-10 Personen mit klarem Blick für das gemeinsame Ziel.Diese Kenntnisse können Sie verwerten * Sie verfügen über einen Meistertitel in einem metallverarbeitenden Beruf oder einen HTL-Abschluss mit Matura. Zudem bringen Sie solide handwerkliche Erfahrung und idealerweise bereits Einblicke in die Arbeitsvorbereitung mit. * Sie bringen idealerweise fundierte Praxis aus dem Stahlbau oder der Fertigungstechnologie mit. * Sie haben nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Fertigung komplexer technischer Vorrichtungen sowie in der Serienfertigung. * Sie zeichnen sich durch eine hohe Detailorientierung aus, bringen Ideen konsequent auf die Straße und lassen sich auch von engen Zeitplänen nicht aus der Ruhe bringen. * Da Sie viele Schnittstellen koordinieren, überzeugen Sie durch ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, diplomatisches Geschick und die Fähigkeit, gemeinsame Lösungen zu finden. * Sie haben bereits erste Erfahrung in der Führung von Mitarbeiter:innen gesammelt und verstehen es, Ihr Team zu motivieren und zu inspirieren. * Kenntnisse über Arbeitssicherheit und Arbeitnehmer:innenschutz im modernen Fertigungsumfeld sind für Sie selbstverständlich. * Sichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend erforderlich. Da sich die Fertigung vor Ort befinden, sind ungarische Sprachkenntnisse kein Muss, aber ein willkommener Bonus, um die Kommunikation vor Ort noch reibungsloser zu gestalten.Dieses Angebot bereiten wir für Sie vor * Eine abwechslungsreiche Position in einem internationalen Unternehmen, in einem interessanten, rasch wachsenden und innovativen Bereich * Ein engagiertes und dynamisches Team * Firmen-Events * Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg * flexible ArbeitszeitenJe nach Qualifikation und Vorerfahrung liegt das Grundgehalt bei dieser Position zwischen EUR 5.000,-- und EUR 6.000,-- brutto monatlich.Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie die Zukunft gemeinsam mit uns!Das AMS Baden wurde durch den Betrieb mit der Vorauswahl betraut.Bitte senden Sie Ihre aussagekräftigen schriftlichen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit folgenden Angaben in der Betreffzeile*U03-17423824*vorzugsweise per Mail an: bewerbung.baden@ams.atBei Mailbewerbungen Speichergröße von 3MB nicht überschreiten!bzw. per Post anAMS Baden * Service für Unternehmen *Nicole Vordre...

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Fenris Creations is looking for a Senior Software Engineer!The infrastructure team owns the core platform that powers EVE Online, building a reliable foundation that will scale and grow with our players over time. As a senior engineer on the team, you’ll own large, open-ended projects, such as making login faster and safer, letting a node fail without ending a fleet engagement, or finding where the latency in an RPC path goes. You’ll define the problem, propose a direction, split the work into pieces that each ship something useful, and build them with the team, supporting our most critical workloads.Your Tasks:Take a goal like “improve authentication”, talk to the people it affects, and write a design that breaks it into milestones.Lay out the tradeoffs (reliability, cost, effort, risk) and bring the team and stakeholders to an agreement.Write production code, mostly in Go, from service interfaces and data models to the messaging between services, and take your design through review to launch.Estimate throughput, storage and latency before you build, then load test and failure test the result.Work out how state is partitioned, replicated and cached, so a bad node degrades one region while the rest of the cluster keeps running.Explain your designs to engineers and non-technical stakeholders, review other people’s work, and mentor.Your Profile:You push clean, tested code in at least one language, such as Go, Python, Rust, Java, C++, C# or TypeScript. We write mostly in Go and expect you to pick it up quickly if you don’t know it.You break large, ambiguous problems into smaller ones and work through them systematically.You can design a system end to end, with realistic estimates for each component, and explain the tradeoffs.You know data structures and complexity, concurrency, how data stores behave as they grow, and why networks and services fail.You’ve led a project from a fuzzy idea to a shipped result, delivering in increments.You use excellent written and spoken communication skills to communicate and influence technical choices clearly, tailoring trade-offs for each audience.You measure what you build and use the data to choose what comes next.You may lean toward software design or toward how systems fit together, but a blend of both is the perfect sweet spot.Nice to have:Prior hands-on experience with distributed systems patterns: RPC, pub/sub, message queues, event streaming, replication, partitioning.Prior experience running services on AWS, Azure or Kubernetes.Prior exposure to tracing, metrics and structured logging (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus or similar).Philosophical inclinations towards infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible or similar).Prior experience with enough UNIX and networking (TCP/IP, load balancing) to debug your own systems.A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.What We Can Offer You:The inspiring opportunity of working on the award winning MMO EVE Online in cooperation with amazingly talented and passionate co-workers.A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.Double work station setup and flexible work environment.A lively fun division that hosts regular events.An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.Annual sports grant.A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.Home internet.A conditional monthly transportation grant.Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.Relocation Package.Please submit your application in English: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/5d2d81e1-174f-4d78-b0cb-ff3a6bd24b4eApplication deadline: Deceember 31st, 2026

title: Ræstingar ofl.
description: Leitað er eftir starfsmanni í hlutastarf við Orlofsbyggðina á Illugastöðum í Fnjóskadal. Engrar sérstakrar menntunar er krafist en hæfni og reynsla á þrifum er skilyrði. Ensku kunnátta og lágmarks íslensku kunnátta þarf að vera til staðar. Starfshlutfall getur verið misjafnt á milli mánaða en vinnutími er kl. 9 - 17 þá daga sem unnið er en vinnutími getur þó verið sveigjanlegur upp að vissu marki sé það ósk starfsmanns. Starfsmaður þarf almennt ekki að sjá um sig sjálfur til og frá vinnu svo ekki er skilyrði að viðkomandi hafi örkuréttindi eða eigin bíl til umráða en það er vissulega mikill kostur. Ef upp kemur sú staða að starfsmaður komi á eigin vegum / eigin bíl er greiddur akstursstyrkur sem og gjaldið í Vaðlaheiðargöng er greitt fyrir viðkomandi.

title: Skipstjóri í hvalaskoðun
description: Skipstjórar og vélstjórar óskast.Norðursigling leitar að öflugum og ábyrgum skipstjórum og vélstjórum til starfa í hjarta hvalaskoðunar á Íslandi. Húsavík er þekkt um allan heim fyrir einstaka hvalaskoðun, stórbrotna náttúru og öflugt samfélag fólks sem elskar sjóinn og dýralífið.Við rekum einn fjölbreyttasta flota landsins, þar á meðal hefðbundna íslenska eikarbáta af mismunandi stærðum, seglskútur og RIB báta.Norðursigling býður:✅ Alþjóðlegan og samheldinn starfsmannahóp✅ Tækifæri til að sigla fallegum sögulegum skipum✅ Nánd við náttúruna og dagleg kynni af hvölum✅ Samkeppnishæf kjör✅ Húsnæði fyrir þá sem þurfaUmsækjendur þurfa að geta fengið samþykki frá Samgöngustofu til starfa á íslenskum farþegaskipum. title: Senior Raft Guide & Safety Kayaker / Kayak leiðbeinandi
description: Arctic Rafting is looking for a Senior Raft Guide and Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor for the upcoming summer season of 2027. Our season is May – September, with our high season in the summer time; June – August. There are some operations and preparations to do also before and after, in April and October. In particular, we are looking for someone to come in March, to repair equipment and do admin office work for the river operation, to prepare for the summer. This position will extend to be all year round, working part time over the winter months and taking a long leave (1-3 months). Arctic Rafting has a base camp on the well known tourist circuit of “The Golden Circle” in the southern part of Iceland, in just over an hour drive from Reykjavík capital city. Our operations include family friendly rafting trips on the mighty Hvítá River (class II-III), which is the third longest river in Iceland, originating from Langjökull Glacier. Our base camp has other amenities like a bar, restaurant, sauna and hot tubs, so clients can wind down after an action-packed adventure on the river.The qualities we are looking for is experience with good customer service, and good team work skills. Any added language skills are appreciated, operational skills for safe and high quality river trips, repairing skills for river rafting gear and other equipment, and skills for cooking, cleaning, photography, marketing/office, mechanics and general handy man skills. Job description and responsibilities of a Senior Raft Guide:* Operate safe and entertaining river tours for clients (rafting or kayaking)* Be a team leader and trip lead a group of guides in rafting trips of the size of 100+ clients* Kitchen worker and general work in the restaurant and bar serving clients* Work around the property (repair gear, cleaning, laundry, gardening and handy man jobs)Requirements:* Current WRT (Whitewater Rescue Technician) or similar* Current IRF (International Rafting Federation) certification or similar* Up to date Advanced First Aid training* Minimum 5 seasons of raft guide experience* Good English skills to communicate with clientsExtras, good to have, but not a requirement:* A big bus license to drive the river shuttle (45 seater)* Kitchen and bar experience* Photography skills* Sales / marketing skillsWork arrangements:* We generally have one morning trip and one afternoon trip every day; you either do two trips per day, or one trip and then base work for the rest of the day (cooking, cleaning, repair gear, etc.)* The work days can be anything from 4-12 hours per day, but the normality is generally 8-9 hours* A full time job means 160-170 hours per month, and as the hours vary, the pay is by hourly rates* Normally you would get 2 days off per week, but this can vary to 1-3 days off weeklyHousing and food:* Living arrangements is at an old farm in the countryside 1,5 hour from Reykjavík city, next to the river rafting base / restaurant* Everyone gets their own private room, including shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* We do daily communal dinners and everyone is expected to partake in the cooking and cleaning at the end of the day* We supply breakfast, lunch and dinner; while you are at the raft base for work Rates:* Depending on your skill level and experience the pay would be around 2.500 – 2.900isk per hour* In addition to this we offer free housing and food for your stay during your work periodPlease note that in Iceland we pay around 40% tax, and other fees will be deducted too (union, pension fund etc.)Benefits:* Some great times living in the countryside, being a raft guide for an Icelandic summer season* Private room with shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* Use of base facilities (staff kitchen, hot pots and sauna)* Occasional use of communal work car; we strongly recommend having a valid driver’s license, as public transport in Iceland is quite horrid when you live at an old farm in the middle of nowhere.About the Company:This is one of the oldest adventure activities to do in Iceland, but the first river rafting trip with clients was made here in 1985. Around 1990 they started renovations at the old barn and farm house to make the raft base into what it is today; changing rooms, showers, sauna, hot pots, restaurant, bar and guide facilities; for around 10-12 staff members to live there for the summer season. Our clients are mostly from Iceland, Europe and USA, so the minimal language requirements are good English skills. Owned by a local raft guide and kayaker, and more details can be found on our website: www.arcticrafting.com This video sums up what a normal day in the summer looks like – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQTo apply; please send a CV and cover letter to drumbo@arcticrafting.is before 1st of December 2026Best regards,The Arctic Rafting teamdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.comArctic Rafting leitar að reyndum flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanni (Senior Raft Guide) og öryggiskajakræðara/kajakkennara (Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor) fyrir komandi sumartímabil árið 2027.Starfstímabilið okkar er frá maí til september, en háannatíminn er yfir sumarmánuðina, júní til ágúst. Einnig þarf að sinna ýmsum undirbúnings- og rekstrarverkefnum fyrir og eftir tímabilið, í apríl og október.Við leitum sérstaklega að einstaklingi sem getur hafið störf í mars til að sinna viðgerðum á búnaði og skrifstofu- og stjórnsýsluverkefnum tengdum flúðasiglingarekstrinum, til undirbúnings fyrir sumarið.Starfið mun þróast yfir í heilsársstarf, þar sem unnið verður í hlutastarfi yfir vetrarmánuðina og möguleiki verður á lengra leyfi, í 1–3 mánuði.StarfsumhverfiðArctic Rafting er með bækistöð við hina þekktu ferðamannaleið Gullna hringinn á Suðurlandi, í rúmlega klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík.Starfsemin felur meðal annars í sér fjölskylduvænar flúðasiglingaferðir á hinni mikilfenglegu Hvítá (erfiðleikaflokkur II–III). Hvítá er þriðja lengsta á Íslands og á upptök sín við Langjökul.Á bækistöðinni er einnig bar, veitingastaður, gufubað og heitir pottar þar sem gestir geta slakað á eftir ævintýralega ferð niður ána.Eiginleikar sem við leitum aðVið leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur reynslu af góðri þjónustu við viðskiptavini og býr yfir góðri hæfni í teymisvinnu.Önnur tungumálakunnátta er kostur, sem og færni í að skipuleggja og framkvæma öruggar og vandaðar flúðasiglingaferðir.Einnig er kostur að hafa reynslu af viðgerðum á flúðasiglingabúnaði og öðrum tækjum, matreiðslu, þrifum, ljósmyndun, markaðssetningu, skrifstofustörfum, vélaviðgerðum og almennum viðhaldsverkefnum.Starfslýsing og ábyrgð yfirleiðsögumannsStjórna öruggum og skemmtilegum flúðasiglinga- og kajakferðum fyrir viðskiptavini.Vera leiðtogi teymis og stýra hópi leiðsögumanna í flúðasiglingaferðum með yfir 100 þátttakendum.Vinna í eldhúsi og sinna almennum störfum á veitingastað og bar, þar á meðal þjónustu við gesti.Sinna ýmsum verkefnum á svæðinu, svo sem viðgerðum á búnaði, þrifum, þvotti, garðvinnu og almennu viðhaldi.HæfniskröfurGilt WRT-skírteini (Whitewater Rescue Technician – sérhæfð björgun í straumvatni) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild IRF-réttindi (International Rafting Federation – Alþjóðasamband flúðasiglinga) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild og uppfærð réttindi í ítarlegri skyndihjálp (Advanced First Aid).Að lágmarki fimm tímabils reynsla sem flúðasiglingaleiðsögumaður.Góð enskukunnátta til að eiga samskipti við viðskiptavini.Viðbótarhæfni sem er kostur en ekki skilyrðiÖkuréttindi til að aka stórri rútu (45 farþega) sem notuð er til að flytja gesti til og frá ánni.Reynsla af eldhús- og barstörfum.Hæfni í ljósmyndun.Reynsla af sölu- og markaðsmálum.Vinnutími og starfskjörYfirleitt eru farnar tvær flúðasiglingaferðir á dag, ein að morgni og önnur síðdegis.Starfsmaður fer annaðhvort í tvær ferðir á dag eða eina ferð og sinnir síðan öðrum verkefnum á bækistöðinni, svo sem matreiðslu, þrifum eða viðgerðum á búnaði.Vinnudagar geta verið allt frá 4 upp í 12 klukkustundir, en algengast er að þeir séu um 8–9 klukkustundir.Fullt starf miðast við 160–170 vinnustundir á mánuði. Þar sem vinnustundir eru breytilegar eru laun greidd samkvæmt tímakaupi.Yfirleitt eru tveir frídagar í viku, en þeir geta verið frá einum upp í þrjá eftir aðstæðum.Húsnæði og fæðiStarfsfólk býr á gömlum sveitabæ í um 1,5 klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík, við hliðina á flúðasiglingabækistöðinni og veitingastaðnum.Allir starfsmenn fá sérherbergi en deila sameiginlegri aðstöðu, þar á meðal baðherbergi með sturtu.Sameiginlegur kvöldverður er á hverjum degi og ætlast er til að allir taki þátt í matreiðslu og frágangi í lok dags.Boðið er upp á morgunmat, hádegismat og kvöldmat á meðan starfsfólk er við vinnu á bækistöðinni.LaunTímakaup fer eftir hæfni og reynslu viðkomandi og er á bilinu 2.500–2.900 krónur á klukkustund.Auk launa er boðið upp á ókeypis húsnæði og fæði meðan á starfstímabilinu stendur.Athugið að á Íslandi geta skattar numið um 40% af launum og að önnur gjöld eru einnig dregin frá, svo sem stéttarfélagsgjöld og lífeyrissjóðsiðgjöld.FríðindiEinstakt tækifæri til að upplifa íslenskt sumar í sveitinni og starfa við flúðasiglingar.Sérherbergi með sameiginlegri baðaðstöðu.Aðgangur að aðstöðu á bækistöðinni, þar á meðal starfsmannaeldhúsi, heitum pottum og gufubaði.Stundum er hægt að nýta sameiginlegan starfsmannabíl.Við mælum eindregið með því að umsækjendur hafi gilt ökuskírteini, þar sem almenningssamgöngur á Íslandi eru afar takmarkaðar þegar búið er á gömlum sveitabæ úti í sveit.Um fyrirtækiðFlúðasiglingar eru ein elsta skipulagða ævintýraafþreying sem boðið hefur verið upp á á Íslandi. Fyrsta flúðasiglingaferðin með viðskiptavini á þessu svæði var farin árið 1985.Um 1990 hófst endurnýjun á gamla fjósinu og íbúðarhúsinu á bænum með það að markmiði að útbúa þá aðstöðu sem þar er í dag.Þar er nú að finna búningsklefa, sturtur, gufubað, heita potta, veitingastað, bar og aðstöðu fyrir leiðsögumenn. Á sumrin er aðstaða fyrir um 10–12 starfsmenn til að búa á staðnum.Viðskiptavinir okkar koma að mestu leyti frá Íslandi, Evrópu og Bandaríkjunum og því er góð enskukunnátta lágmarkskrafa.Fyrirtækið er í eigu flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanns og kajakræðara úr heimabyggð.Nánari upplýsingar um fyrirtækið má finna á vefsíðunni:www.arcticrafting.comMyndband sem sýnir dæmigerðan sumardag hjá Arctic Rafting:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQUmsóknir:Áhugasamir eru beðnir um að senda ferilskrá og kynningarbréf á netfangið:drumbo@arcticrafting.isUmsóknarfrestur er til 1. desember 2026.Með bestu kveðju,Starfsfólk Arctic Raftingdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.com

title: Census Field Support Officer
description: The Census Field Support Officer (previously known as Census Enumerator) is a key member of the Census 2027 field staff team. As a Census Field Support Officer, you will work in or near your local area. Between 5 April and 9 May, you will be calling to homes to let people know about Census 2027 and to offer help and support. After 9 May, you will follow up with the homes in your area which have not completed a census form.You may be required to engage with local groups in your area to help them to understand the census and what they need to do to complete their census forms, along with other census field staff.You should be physically fit as you will be responsible for between 450-850 homes. In some cases, you may be required to make repeat visits to homes to ensure that the householder is aware of and supported to take part in the census.A mobile phone will be provided with a census field app to show you the map of your area and the list of homes to visit. You will record your visits and other details on the mobile phone app. If a household completes their census online, it will automatically be removed from your visit list.You will report to a Census Field Supervisor who will manage a team of census field support officers. Training will be provided and there will be regular contact and support to help you in your role.Census 2027 will take place between 5 April and 9 May 2027. For the first time, people will be able to choose between completing their census form online or on paper. There will be a five-week period (5 April to 9 May) to complete census forms, rather than one census night. Some 3,850 Census Field Support Officers will work on Census 2027 in every part of Ireland. The Census Field Support Officer job is 18 hours per week (mainly evenings and weekends) and is an eight-week contract from 5 April to 28 May. The rate of pay for the full duration will be over €3,000 plus an allowance. Candidates must be over 18 years of age.

title: Accounting Expert
description: Duties•    End-to-End Accounting Operations: Execute daily accounting activities (revenue, expenditures, capital expenditures, etc.), validate original document compliance, and oversee month/year-end closing.  Ensure alignment between ledger balances and actual financial records to mitigate financial discrepancies and compliance risks. •    Financial Reporting & Strategic Analysis: Prepare accurate monthly/quarterly/annual financial statements. Conduct variance analysis to explain fluctuations, deliver actionable business insights, and support data-driven decisions for sustainable growth. •    Process Automation & System Enhancement: Identify workflow inefficiencies and drive automation (e.g., system integrations, rule-based workflows). Refine SOPs and internal controls to elevate financial system integration and operational efficiency. •    Audit Coordination & Regulatory Compliance: Facilitate internal/external audits by providing documentation and clarifications. Monitor tax compliance, optimise incentive applications, and ensure adherence to legal and regulatory standards during inspections. •    Risk Mitigation & Asset Safeguarding: Perform regular account reconciliations, assess risks (e.g., inventory write-downs, receivables defaults), and develop proactive mitigation strategies. Implement monitoring frameworks and closed-loop remediation processes to protect assets.•    Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with business and tech teams to address financial requirements. Deliver accounting policy training and consult on new business models, fostering seamless business-finance alignment through strategic financial integration.Requirements Academic & Professional Qualifications•    Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline from a recognised university.•    A recognised professional accounting qualification or equivalent is strongly preferred.•    Demonstrated continuing professional development in technical accounting and financial reporting standards.•    Solid academic grounding in financial accounting, cost accounting, revenue recognition, tax, and audit principles acquired through formal study.Professional Experience•    Experience in full-cycle accounting, financial reporting and analysis, preferably within a multinational, cross-border or group-accounting environment.•    Hands-on experience executing end-to-end accounting operations — revenue, expenditures and capital expenditures — including validating original document compliance and owning month-end and year-end closing, with a proven record of keeping ledger balances aligned to actuals to prevent discrepancies and compliance risk.•    Practical experience driving process automation and system enhancement — identifying workflow inefficiencies, implementing rule-based workflows or system integrations, and refining SOPs and internal controls.•    Experience coordinating internal and external audits, providing supporting documentation and clarifications, and ensuring tax and regulatory compliance through inspection cycles.•    Demonstrated involvement in account reconciliations and risk assessment (e.g. inventory write-downs, receivables default / bad-debt exposure), including designing monitoring frameworks and closed-loop remediation processes to safeguard assets.•    Experience partnering with business and technology teams and delivering accounting-policy training / advisory on new business models.Technical Skills•    Advanced Excel proficiency — reconciliation modelling, large-dataset validation, aging and variance analysis, and dynamic calculation.•    Financial modelling and reporting: ability to build periodic management reports and translate data into strategic recommendations.•    Internal-control design: competence in designing and documenting controls around source-document validation, closing and data flows.•    Proficiency in core office productivity tools (Word, PowerPoint) for documentation, reporting and policy materials.Knowledge•    Deep, up-to-date command of applicable accounting standards (IFRS, and US GAAP / local GAAP where relevant), including revenue recognition and expenditure/CAPEX treatment.•    Solid understanding of the full financial reporting cycle and the data flow from source records through to the general ledger, and of ledger-to-actual reconciliation principles.•    Strong knowledge of tax compliance, incentive/grant applications, and regulatory/legal requirements governing financial operations during audits and inspections.•    Working knowledge of internal-control frameworks and risk-mitigation practices for inventory, receivables and asset safeguarding.•    Understanding of accounting policy documentation and the principles of consistency, comparability and compliance across an organisation.•    Awareness of new-business-model accounting implications and business-finance integration principles.Hours of Work: 40 hours per week (Monday to Friday - 9.00am to 6.00pm)Work Location: Remote

title: Census Field Support Officer
description: The Census Field Support Officer (previously known as Census Enumerator) is a key member of the Census 2027 field staff team. As a Census Field Support Officer, you will work in or near your local area. Between 5 April and 9 May, you will be calling to homes to let people know about Census 2027 and to offer help and support. After 9 May, you will follow up with the homes in your area which have not completed a census form.You may be required to engage with local groups in your area to help them to understand the census and what they need to do to complete their census forms, along with other census field staff.You should be physically fit as you will be responsible for between 450-850 homes. In some cases, you may be required to make repeat visits to homes to ensure that the householder is aware of and supported to take part in the census.A mobile phone will be provided with a census field app to show you the map of your area and the list of homes to visit. You will record your visits and other details on the mobile phone app. If a household completes their census online, it will automatically be removed from your visit list.You will report to a Census Field Supervisor who will manage a team of census field support officers. Training will be provided and there will be regular contact and support to help you in your role.Census 2027 will take place between 5 April and 9 May 2027. For the first time, people will be able to choose between completing their census form online or on paper. There will be a five-week period (5 April to 9 May) to complete census forms, rather than one census night. Some 3,850 Census Field Support Officers will work on Census 2027 in every part of Ireland. The Census Field Support Officer job is 18 hours per week (mainly evenings and weekends) and is an eight-week contract from 5 April to 28 May. The rate of pay for the full duration will be over €3,000 plus an allowance. Candidates must be over 18 years of age.

description: We are partnering with a prominent industry-leading client to find a STRATEGIC BUYER with a primary focus on steel and metal components. Location: Italy (with frequent interaction across the Group's operations in Italy -Padova and Imperia- and Germany) The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing sourcing strategies for key direct material categories, with a primary focus on steel and metal components, followed by electric motors, plastics and fasteners. This is a highly visible role with a significant impact on the Group's profitability through cost reduction initiatives, supplier development, volume aggregation and strategic sourcing projects across our Italian and German operations. Key Responsibilities Strategic Sourcing & Category Management - Develop and execute sourcing strategies for assigned commodity categories. - Manage RFQs, tenders and supplier negotiations at both local and international levels. - Analyze commodity markets, industry trends and key cost drivers. - Build and maintain a robust pipeline of cost-saving initiatives. - Drive supplier competitiveness while ensuring quality and supply continuity. Group Synergies & Volume Leverage - Identify opportunities to aggregate purchasing volumes across Group companies. - Negotiate framework agreements, volume rebates, index-based pricing mechanisms and commercial terms. - Lead supplier consolidation and standardization initiatives. - Support make-or-buy decisions, localization projects and low-cost-country sourcing strategies. - Harmonize supplier terms, payment conditions and Incoterms across the Group where appropriate. Supplier Development & Management - Develop strategic relationships with key suppliers. - Lead supplier scouting, qualification and onboarding activities. - Identify and implement alternative sourcing solutions to reduce supply chain risks. - Manage supplier performance and continuous improvement programs. - Collaborate closely with Quality, Engineering, Operations and Finance teams. Cost Optimization & Value Engineering - Partner with Engineering and Operations on: o Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VA/VE) o Product standardization o Specification optimization o Target costing initiatives o Localization projects - Challenge supplier quotations through market benchmarking and should-cost analysis. - Drive sustainable cost reduction and productivity initiatives. Reporting & Performance Monitoring - Track spend, savings and procurement KPIs. - Develop and maintain procurement dashboards using Excel and Power BI. - Report sourcing activities, savings projects and supply risks to senior management. - Ensure appropriate contract coverage and procurement governance. What We Are Looking For Essential Requirements - Minimum 7/10 years of experience in strategic procurement of direct materials within a manufacturing environment. - Strong experience in: o Steel purchasing o Metal fabrication sourcing o Commodity management - Proven track record in international procurement and global sourcing. - Solid understanding of: o Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) o Cost breakdown analysis o Incoterms o Contract negotiation o Cross-border supply risks - Fluent English and Italian both written and spoken. - Advanced Excel skills and experience with Power BI or similar analytical tools. Preferred Qualifications - Experience sourcing electric motors, gear motors, plastics or industrial components. - Previous experience working in multinational and multi-site industrial organizations. Key Competencies Strategic Negotiation You understand supplier economics, create competitive tension and secure long-term commercial value through effective negotiations. Analytical Mindset You leverage spend analysis, cost models, market intelligence and data-driven decision making to identify opportunities and support strategic initiatives. Category Management You can build and execute sourcing strategies, supplier roadmaps and multi-year savings plans. Collaboration & Influence You effectively engage stakeholders across Procurement, Engineering, Operations, Quality and Finance, driving alignment across multiple sites and countries. Results Orientation You are passionate about delivering measurable savings, improving procurement performance and creating business value. What We Offer - A strategic role with high visibility within an international industrial group. - The opportunity to influence procurement strategy and business performance at a Group level. - Exposure to international sourcing projects and cross-functional initiatives. - A dynamic and collaborative work environment. - Opportunities for professional growth and career development. - Full remote working - Salary range: 70-80K Euro - Benefits: company Car - Availability to travel approximately 60% of working time, including regular visits to suppliers and frequent travel to the Group's sites in Padua, Imperia and Horstmar, with travel frequency varying according to business needs and project requirements. description: Per solida realtà operante nell'industria edile, siamo alla ricerca di un/a Responsabile di Commessa. La persona avrà la responsabilità di seguire la commessa 'end-to-end' sul campo, garantendo che attività, squadre e fornitori lavorino in modo coordinato, mantenendo una relazione efficace con il cliente. Obiettivo del ruolo Gestire operativamente una o più commesse assicurando l'avanzamento regolare dei lavori e un controllo puntuale su programmazione, risorse, varianti, consegne e marginalità, con approccio pratico e orientamento al risultato. Attività principali Programmare commesse e cantieri: pianificare l'alternanza dei lavori nel medio-lungo periodo in funzione di scadenze contrattuali e durata dei cantieri. Organizzare le attività di apertura del cantiere fino alla chiusura, definendo attività giornaliere e settimanali, monitorando lo stato avanzamento lavori. Gestire operatività, standard e comportamenti, lavorando su efficienza, metodo e rispetto delle procedure con squadre e subappaltatori. Raccogliere esigenze e gestire criticità in modo concreto (es. ripianificazione dell'ordine di montaggio senza perdere il controllo su tempi e costi). Controllo tempi/contratti/spedizioni: presidiare consegne, vincoli contrattuali, varianti ed extra, assicurando coerenza tra accordi e operatività. Controllo economico di commessa: supportare stime e consuntivi, contribuendo alla tutela della marginalità e alla gestione economica. Collaborazione con uffici interni (tecnico, produzione, logistica) per garantire la continuità delle attività e il corretto flusso di arrivo dei materiali sui cantieri. Esperienza indicativa di ~10 anni su cantieri industriali con ruoli di responsabilità (capocantiere / responsabile operativo / responsabile di commessa). Capacità di pianificazione, gestione priorità, avanzamento lavori e controllo economico. description: Per conto di una primaria realtà internazionale leader nei servizi Food & Retail, presente con una rete capillare di punti vendita in aeroporti, stazioni ferroviarie e aree di servizio, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Retail Expansion Specialist. La risorsa entrerà a far parte del team dedicato allo sviluppo della rete e avrà la responsabilità di identificare, valutare e supportare nuove opportunità di espansione commerciale. Operando come punto di raccordo tra funzioni interne ed interlocutori esterni, supporterà l'intero iter di sviluppo delle opportunità, dalla fase di scouting e analisi economica fino alla formalizzazione degli accordi. Principali responsabilità: Analizzare e monitorare opportunità di sviluppo e ampliamento del network retail sul territorio italiano. Effettuare valutazioni economico-finanziarie e business case relativi a nuove aperture, rinnovi contrattuali e progetti di sviluppo. Supportare la gestione delle trattative e delle negoziazioni con proprietari immobiliari, enti pubblici e stakeholder coinvolti. Collaborare con i team Legal, Finance, Real Estate e Operations per garantire la corretta esecuzione dei progetti. Analizzare bandi di gara, convenzioni, contratti di locazione e documentazione correlata. Predisporre presentazioni, report e analisi a supporto delle decisioni di investimento. Gestire relazioni efficaci con interlocutori interni ed esterni, favorendo l'allineamento degli interessi delle diverse parti coinvolte. Requisiti richiesti: Laurea in Economia, Finanza, Amministrazione Aziendale o discipline affini. Esperienza di almeno 3 anni in ruoli legati a sviluppo immobiliare, retail expansion, real estate, business development o analisi investimenti. Solida capacità di lettura e interpretazione di dati economico-finanziari e KPI di business. Buona familiarità con contratti, clausole commerciali e documentazione legale correlata alle attività di sviluppo. Ottima conoscenza di Excel e degli strumenti di analisi economica. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il Profilo Forte orientamento al risultato e al raggiungimento degli obiettivi. Spiccate doti di negoziazione e mediazione. Capacità di influenzare positivamente stakeholder interni ed esterni. Attitudine alla costruzione e gestione di relazioni professionali di lungo periodo. Approccio pragmatico, autonomia e capacità di gestire progetti complessi. Interesse per il settore retail, travel retail e sviluppo di reti commerciali. Cosa offre l'azienda: Inserimento in una realtà internazionale solida e in costante crescita. Opportunità di contribuire direttamente ai progetti di espansione del business. Ambiente dinamico, sfidante e altamente collaborativo. Smart working strutturato. Percorsi di sviluppo professionale e crescita interna. Informatica di base: utilizzo PC, applicativi d'ufficio e sistemi gestionali di produzione (MES/ERP). Category Management You can build and execute sourcing strategies, supplier roadmaps and multi-year savings plans. Collaboration & Influence You effectively engage stakeholders across Procurement, Engineering, Operations, Quality and Finance, driving alignment across multiple sites and countries. description: Direttore Generale Azienda di servizi SW & HW - Information Technology | Piccola Impresa Wyser ricerca un Direttore Generale per una PI (piccola impresa) italiana a proprietà imprenditoriale, attiva nell'erogazione di servizi SW&HW ICT a imprese ed enti pubblici. L'azienda offre soluzioni SW & HW per infrastrutture e reti, cloud, cybersecurity e assistenza IT, integrate con fornitura e noleggio di tecnologie hardware e software. Si distingue per la relazione continuativa con i clienti e per un approccio da boutique orientato alla qualità del servizio. Il ruolo Il Direttore Generale affiancherà la proprietà nella definizione e nell'attuazione della strategia aziendale, assumendo la responsabilità del coordinamento complessivo delle attività e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi concordati. Contribuirà al rafforzamento dell'organizzazione e all'evoluzione dell'offerta, con attenzione alla redditività, all'innovazione tecnologica e allo sviluppo delle persone. Principali responsabilità Definire con la proprietà il piano di sviluppo aziendale e tradurlo in obiettivi, budget e priorità operative, monitorandone l'attuazione e proponendo eventuali azioni correttive. Migliorare il modello organizzativo, i processi e gli strumenti di pianificazione e controllo, introducendo responsabilità chiare e indicatori di performance a supporto delle decisioni. Presidiare i risultati economici e gestionali, in collaborazione con la funzione amministrativa, attraverso l'analisi di ricavi, costi, marginalità di progetti e servizi, investimenti e impiego delle risorse. Coordinare le funzioni commerciali, tecniche e operative, assicurando coerenza tra obiettivi di vendita, capacità di erogazione e qualità del servizio al cliente. Sviluppare il business consolidando le relazioni con i clienti strategici, individuando nuove opportunità e favorendo una maggiore integrazione dell'offerta per imprese ed enti pubblici. Guidare l'evoluzione del portafoglio di soluzioni e servizi, valutando tecnologie emergenti e applicazioni dell'intelligenza artificiale in funzione delle esigenze del mercato e del ritorno economico. Valorizzare e sviluppare le competenze dei collaboratori, promuovendo collaborazione tra team, responsabilizzazione e condivisione delle conoscenze. Gestire e sviluppare le relazioni con vendor e partner strategici, collaborando con le funzioni competenti al presidio della qualità, della sicurezza delle informazioni e della compliance. Requisiti e competenze Esperienza in ruoli di direzione generale, direzione di business unit o responsabilità manageriale trasversale nel settore dei servizi, preferibilmente presso system integrator o provider di servizi IT, in alternativa altri servizi B2B es. Digital, TLC... Responsabilità maturata nella gestione di risultati economici, budget e team, con capacità di integrare visione strategica ed esecuzione operativa. Conoscenza del mercato ICT e dei modelli di business legati a progetti, servizi ricorrenti e soluzioni tecnologiche; capacità di valutarne marginalità, complessità operativa e potenziale di sviluppo. Preparazione tecnologica adeguata a confrontarsi con gli specialisti su infrastrutture, networking, cloud e cybersecurity e a orientare le scelte di offerta e investimento. Esperienza nel miglioramento di processi e organizzazione, con capacità di introdurre metodi e strumenti gestionali proporzionati alle esigenze di una piccola impresa. Capacità di costruire un rapporto di fiducia con la proprietà, condividere le priorità e rendicontare con chiarezza risultati, criticità e proposte. Costituiranno elementi preferenziali l'esperienza in contesti imprenditoriali o familiari e la partecipazione a percorsi di evoluzione manageriale. Saranno valorizzate anche la conoscenza del mercato pubblico e dei modelli di noleggio tecnologico. La ricerca è aperta anche a figure provenienti da ruoli di direzione Sales & Delivery, Operations o Commerciale, purché abbiano maturato responsabilità effettive su organizzazione, persone e risultati economici, oltre allo sviluppo delle vendite. Lo stile manageriale Cerchiamo una persona autorevole e concreta, capace di ascoltare, comprendere il contesto e accompagnare il cambiamento in modo costruttivo. Saranno centrali la capacità di coinvolgere collaboratori esperti, prendere decisioni e tradurre le opportunità tecnologiche in iniziative sostenibili per il business. L'opportunità professionale Il ruolo offre la possibilità di contribuire direttamente alla direzione e all'evoluzione di una piccola impresa ICT, lavorando a stretto contatto con la proprietà e incidendo sulle scelte organizzative, commerciali e tecnologiche. Il progetto valorizza una figura manageriale capace di coniugare sviluppo del business, qualità del servizio e continuità delle relazioni con clienti e collaboratori. Nello specifico, la figura inserita si occuperà di: Monitorare le performance di vendita dei prodotti, analizzando sell-in, sell-out, stock, rotazioni, stock coverage e marginalità per categoria, brand, linea e punto vendita, individuando trend, criticità e opportunità commerciali; Supportare la pianificazione degli assortimenti e dei fabbisogni di prodotto per insegna, categoria, stagione e canale distributivo, sulla base dei dati storici, previsionali e degli obiettivi commerciali; Supportare il team Buying nella definizione dei quantitativi di acquisto e nella costruzione dell'assortimento; Monitorare il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ingresso in assortimento fino alla fase di fine stagione, individuando eventuali criticità e opportunità di intervento; Analizzare le giacenze e individuare tempestivamente situazioni di overstock, understock e slow moving, supportando la definizione delle relative azioni correttive; Supportare il team Buying, in collaborazione con Planning & Allocation, nell'individuazione delle esigenze di riassortimento e redistribuzione del prodotto; Monitorare l'andamento dei budget di acquisto e degli obiettivi economici assegnati alle diverse categorie merceologiche, segnalando eventuali scostamenti; Gestire operativamente l'inserimento, l'emissione e l'aggiornamento degli ordini di acquisto a sistema, assicurando la correttezza delle informazioni relative a prodotti, quantità, prezzi e condizioni concordate; Monitorare l'avanzamento degli ordini, verificando conferme d'ordine, variazioni, cancellazioni ed eventuali anomalie e interfacciandosi con i fornitori per gli aspetti operativi; Presidiare il follow-up delle consegne e il rispetto delle tempistiche previste, segnalando tempestivamente eventuali ritardi o scostamenti rispetto alla pianificazione e garantendo l'allineamento tra piano di acquisto, ordini emessi e merce in consegna; Predisporre e mantenere aggiornata la reportistica relativa a ordini, budget impegnato, consegne, stock e performance di prodotto, fornendo analisi a supporto dell'Ufficio Buying e della Direzione Commerciale. Requisiti richiesti: Laurea in discipline economiche, statistiche, gestionali, moda o affini. Esperienza pregressa di almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli di Buying Planning, Merchandise Planning, Buying, Merchandising o Product Management, preferibilmente nel settore fashion retail. Conoscenza delle logiche di assortimento, pianificazione e gestione dello stock nel settore retail. Spiccata capacità di analisi e interpretazione dei dati. Utilizzo avanzato di Excel; gradita la conoscenza di strumenti di Business Intelligence. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il profilo: approccio analitico e commerciale, capacità di lettura delle performance di prodotto, ottime capacità organizzative e di pianificazione, precisione, problem solving, Sede di lavoro: Palermo, Orari: Lun-Ven 8:30 - 13:00 / 14:30 - 18:00 CCNL Commercio Range Retributivo previsto: € 23.300 - € 27.000.
