title: ingegnere meccanico
description: Grafton Engineering is a team dedicated to enhancing the experience, skills and potential of candidates in Design, Logistics & Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Quality - Safety & Environment, Process & Project Management. Saipem Spa is a global leader in engineering and construction for the energy and infrastructure sectors, delivering complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide. Driven by technological innovation as 'One Company', our 30,000 people from over 130 nationalities in more than 50 countries work every day to enable the energy transition toward Net Zero. At Saipem, we embrace diversity as a driver of innovation and inclusion, while prioritizing people's safety and environmental sustainability, even in the most challenging conditions. As Maintenance Engineering Specialist you will respond to the Maintenance Engineering Lead and be part of the Energy Carriers Business Line within EPC Maintenance and Inspection Engineering Department. Job includes plant reliability analysis, equipment criticality assessment and maintenance plan development. Scope of the work involves activities ranging from acknowledging of process-related conditions and evaluating the equipment detail design. Maintenance Engineering Specialist (MES) is to make sure that the project detailed design is safe and sound from an operation and maintenance point of view, complies with the international standards and meet the requirements arising from contract and technical specification therein referred to. In performing his job, the MES is liaising with client representatives, partners, suppliers and project team. MES regularly reports to the Commissioning, Operation and Maintenance manager the status of the Maintenance Engineering assessment, highlighting areas of concern. How can you support us? supporting the maintenance engineering lead in reviewing the project technical documentation in respect to the contractual requirements, gathering of maintenance related design data from technical disciplines and vendors to build-up a comprehensive plant asset register which includes all the maintainable equipment, preparation of Maintainable Equipment List (MEL) hierarchically organized by functional location which in turn refer to physical asset; operability and maintainability review, support mechanical handling assessment, equipment criticality analysis (ECA) to rank item listed in MEL in view of safety, environment and production requirement, maintenance strategies, procedures, and tasks according to either the original equipment manufacturer data or the results of the performed Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) analysis; operational performance standard preparation; CMMS loading templates preparation Education: Master's Degree/bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or similar qualification Experience: 5+ years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry Languages: English level B2/C1 What else should you know? Some travelling will be expected within EMEA, Africa, etc What we can offer to you: Permanent Contract, CCNL Energia e Petrolio For home office contract: Pay not lower than 43000€ Corporate Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, internal gym, discounts and partnerships, services related to health, family, well-being, and in-house cafeteria. Hybrid working model: Smart Working options and flexible hours to help you achieve a better work-life balance. title: To stipendiatstillingar ved European University Institute (EUI) i Firenze
employer: UNIVERSITETET I BERGEN DET HUMANISTISKE FAKULTET
description:
Stipendiat

Det er ledig to stipendiatstillingar (100%) ved European University Institute (EUI) i Firenze. Oppstart i stillingane i september 2027. Stillingane er ledig for ein periode på tre (3) år, med moglegheit for stipend for eit fjerde år. 

Stillingane er finansierte av det norske kunnskapsdepartementet. Stipendiatane vert teken opp i eit av ph.d.-programma ved EUI, med Universitetet i Bergen som arbeidsgjevar.

Om EUI og ph.d.-programma

European University Institute er eit europeisk forskingsuniversitet innan humaniora og samfunnsvitskap som ligg i Firenze i Italia. EUI har ph.d.-program innan historie, økonomi, samfunnsvitskap og rettsvitskap. Stipendiatane knytt til ph.d.-programma kjem frå 25 ulike europeiske land. Gruppa med stipendiatar er organisert i kull, med samtidig oppstart kvar haust. 

Søkjarane som får tilbod om stipendiatstilling, får opptak til eitt av dei fire ph.d.-programma. 

Ph.d.-utdanninga er normert til fire år.

Meir informasjon om EUI, programma og søknadsskjema finn du her: Doctoral Programmes

Kvalifikasjonar og krav:
  • Søkjaren må vere norsk statsborgar eller ha permanent opphaldsløyve i Noreg.
  • Søkjaren må ha mastergrad eller tilsvarande grad. 
  • Søkjarar som har fullført doktorgrad, kan ikkje bli tilsette i stipendiatstilling innan det same fagområdet.
  • Det er EUI som vurderer om fagbakgrunnen til dei som søkjer opptak er relevant for det einskilde ph.d.-program.
Løn og andre vilkår:
  • Løn som stipendiat, som for tida svarar til ei brutto årsløn på NOK 593.700.
  • Etableringsstipend det første året etter satsane til forskingsrådet: NOK 300 000 for enkeltperson og NOK 516 000 ved familie
  • Driftsmidlar: NOK 50 000 pr år
  • Stipend det fjerde året. Opptak til det fjerde året må stipendiaten søkja EUI om. Ved innvilga opptak vert det gjeve stipend frå EUI og UiB.
Slik søkjer du stillinga:

Lenke til EUI sitt søknadsskjema finn du her: Doctoral Programmes.

Informasjon om faglege krav i søknaden, innhald i programmet og arbeidskvardagen kan ein få ved å sjå på «FAQs and Contacts» under det einskilde program. 

Generell informasjon:

Informasjon om arbeidsforholdet til UiB og UiB si forvaltning av avtalen kan ein få ved å kontakte: 

Seniorrådgiver Yngve Brynjulfsen, yngve.brynjulfsen@uib.no, 

+47 55 58 33 82 

    

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Universitetet i Bergen er ein anerkjend utdannings- og forskingsinstitusjon, organisert i sju fakultet og omlag 54 institutt og faglege senter. Campus ligg i sentrale delar av Bergen med universitetsområde på Nygårdshøyden, Haukeland, Marineholmen, Møllendalsveien og Årstad.

Det humanistiske fakultet består av fire institutt og fire senter. Les meir om fakultet og tilhøyrande institutt.

title: consulente di ricerca e selezione del personale
description: Per conto di una nota realtà operativa nel settore alberghiero, in vista della nuova apertura di una struttura su Roma, siamo alla ricerca di un/una: HR Manager Le mansioni del ruolo sono le seguenti: Reclutamento e inserimento ? Gestire l'intero processo di reclutamento e selezione per tutte le posizioni della struttura; ? Redigere e pubblicare annunci di lavoro in linea con gli standard editoriali e di brand. ? Condurre colloqui, coordinare i processi di selezione con i responsabili di dipartimento e sottoporre le proprie raccomandazioni al General Manager. ? Organizzare e condurre il processo di onboarding e inserimento di tutti i nuovi dipendenti, affinché ciascuno possa iniziare al meglio fin dal primo giorno. ? Gestire i rapporti con i partner di reclutamento e monitorare l'efficacia dei canali di ricerca (ad es. scuole, università, istituzioni). ? Coordinare la pianificazione e le tempistiche delle assunzioni tra i diversi dipartimenti, per garantire che l'hotel disponga del personale adeguato al momento dell'apertura. Amministrazione e payroll ? Predisporre, verificare e gestire tutti i contratti di lavoro e la relativa documentazione amministrativa, in conformità alla normativa italiana sul lavoro e agli standard del Gruppo. ? Gestire il rilevamento delle presenze, i diritti alle ferie e la pianificazione dei turni, in coordinamento con i responsabili di dipartimento. ? Coordinare la raccolta e la verifica dei dati payroll e interfacciarsi con il fornitore esterno del servizio paghe, garantendo elaborazioni corrette e puntuali. ? Coordinare tutte le formalità amministrative relative all'onboarding e all'offboarding dei dipendenti: documentazione, iscrizione agli enti previdenziali, visite mediche, documenti di cessazione e conteggi finali. ? Garantire la conformità alla normativa italiana sul lavoro e ai contratti collettivi applicabili, in coordinamento con il consulente esterno in materia giuslavoristica. Gestione del personale e relazioni con i dipendenti ? Essere il principale punto di riferimento HR in loco per tutti i dipendenti e i responsabili di dipartimento. ? Monitorare le relazioni tra dipendenti e management, individuando e gestendo proattivamente per tempo eventuali criticità. ? Supportare e consigliare i responsabili di dipartimento nella gestione delle persone, nei procedimenti disciplinari e nelle questioni relative alle prestazioni. ? Gestire le comunicazioni formali, i procedimenti disciplinari e gli eventuali contenziosi, in collaborazione con la Direzione HR di Gruppo; ? Interfacciarsi, quando necessario, con i consulenti legali esterni sulle questioni relative alle relazioni di lavoro. ? Segnalare al General Manager e alla Direttrice HR del Gruppo, secondo necessità, le questioni rilevanti o delicate relative ai rapporti con i dipendenti. ? Promuovere una cultura del lavoro positiva, inclusiva e orientata a prestazioni elevate. Formazione e sviluppo ? Individuare e raccogliere le esigenze formative di tutti i dipartimenti. ? Coordinare e supportare l'erogazione delle sessioni formative in loco. ? Monitorare i piani di sviluppo individuali e assicurare il follow-up dei periodi di prova. ? Contribuire all'individuazione dei talenti e alla pianificazione delle successioni, in collaborazione con il General Manager e la Direttrice HR del Gruppo. Budget, costi del personale e reporting ? Elaborare il budget HR annuale in stretta collaborazione con il General Manager e il management del Gruppo. ? Predisporre report periodici per monitorare i costi del personale, l'organico e il rapporto tra costi del lavoro e budget. ? Contribuire al reporting HR e agli indicatori chiave a livello di Gruppo: organico, assenteismo, ore di formazione, tasso di turnover. ? Fornire regolarmente al General Manager report HR e raccomandazioni pertinenti a supporto delle decisioni operative e relative alla forza lavoro. Requisiti Richiesti: ? Esperienza comprovata in un ruolo di responsabilità di un dipartimento HR (trasversale a tutte le funzioni HR), nel settore dell'ospitalità di lusso. ? Costituisce titolo preferenziale l'esperienza nella gestione autonoma di una funzione HR. ? Solida conoscenza della normativa italiana sul lavoro e delle disposizioni in materia di occupazione, con esperienza nel coordinamento di consulenti legali esterni e fornitori di servizi payroll. ? Esperienza comprovata nella gestione dell'intero processo di reclutamento, compreso l'utilizzo di piattaforme ATS. ? Familiarità con i sistemi informativi HR e gli strumenti payroll. ? Ottima padronanza di Microsoft Office, in particolare di Excel. ? Ottima conoscenza scritta e parlata dell'italiano e dell'inglese. title: Principal System Applications Engineer Solid State Transformer  (SST) (f/m/div) (Ingenieur/in - Mikroelektronik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. Turning customer whispers into industry-shaking solutions... ready to amplify the future?As a Principal System Applications Engineer Solid State Transformer (SST) on our Customer Collaboration and Technical Marketing team work hand-in-hand with our customers, enabling them to transform our products into cutting-edge designs, all while building long-lasting partnerships that thrive on success.Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Engage with leading customers to understand SST architectures, requirements, and technical challenges, translating them into semiconductor and subsystem solutions.- Develop and validate application solutions through simulation, prototyping, measurements, benchmarking, and troubleshooting.- Create technical proof points using PoCs, demonstrators, and experimental validation, including collaboration with external partners.- Convert engineering results into customer-ready technical materials, such as design recommendations, BOM guidance, simulation models, and training content. - Enable Field Application Engineers (FAEs) and regional teams through technical training, workshops, and support for complex customer engagements.- Support strategic customer projects and design-ins, working with customers and internal experts to solve system-level application challenges.Your profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field, combined with 6+ years of industry experience in power electronics, power conversion, or application engineering.- Possess strong expertise in power converter topologies and power semiconductor technologies, with experience in Solid-State Transformers (SSTs), medium-voltage systems, modular converters, or multilevel converters considered a plus.- Demonstrate a broad system-level understanding of gate driving, control, protection, sensing, magnetics, thermal management, and reliability.- Apply hands-on experience in simulation, hardware development, commissioning, measurement, and troubleshooting to develop and validate engineering solutions.- Translate system requirements into practical semiconductor and subsystem recommendations, balancing technical performance and application needs.- Thrive in global, cross-functional environments, showing strong ownership, collaboration, and the ability to influence and drive topics independently across regions, divisions, customers, and external partners.Salary pay information:AustriaAt Infineon in Villach you shape the technologies of tomorrow and work in an international environment with more than 4.700 colleagues from over 70 nations. Your personal contribution will be valued and appreciated as the cornerstones of our success. And all that in beautiful surroundings which guarantee a high quality of life.The City of Villach is located in the center of Carinthia, Austria’s southernmost province, in close proximity to the Italian and Slovenian border. Due to its particular geographic location and the outstanding natural beauty of the region, Villach and the whole province of Carinthia have for generations been popular holiday destinations for people from all over the world. Living in Austria also has many social, health-care-related and economic perks. title: dirigente delle risorse umane
description: Direttore Generale Azienda di servizi SW & HW - Information Technology | Piccola Impresa Wyser ricerca un Direttore Generale per una PI (piccola impresa) italiana a proprietà imprenditoriale, attiva nell'erogazione di servizi SW&HW ICT a imprese ed enti pubblici. L'azienda offre soluzioni SW & HW per infrastrutture e reti, cloud, cybersecurity e assistenza IT, integrate con fornitura e noleggio di tecnologie hardware e software. Si distingue per la relazione continuativa con i clienti e per un approccio da boutique orientato alla qualità del servizio. Il ruolo Il Direttore Generale affiancherà la proprietà nella definizione e nell'attuazione della strategia aziendale, assumendo la responsabilità del coordinamento complessivo delle attività e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi concordati. Contribuirà al rafforzamento dell'organizzazione e all'evoluzione dell'offerta, con attenzione alla redditività, all'innovazione tecnologica e allo sviluppo delle persone. Principali responsabilità Definire con la proprietà il piano di sviluppo aziendale e tradurlo in obiettivi, budget e priorità operative, monitorandone l'attuazione e proponendo eventuali azioni correttive. Migliorare il modello organizzativo, i processi e gli strumenti di pianificazione e controllo, introducendo responsabilità chiare e indicatori di performance a supporto delle decisioni. Presidiare i risultati economici e gestionali, in collaborazione con la funzione amministrativa, attraverso l'analisi di ricavi, costi, marginalità di progetti e servizi, investimenti e impiego delle risorse. Coordinare le funzioni commerciali, tecniche e operative, assicurando coerenza tra obiettivi di vendita, capacità di erogazione e qualità del servizio al cliente. Sviluppare il business consolidando le relazioni con i clienti strategici, individuando nuove opportunità e favorendo una maggiore integrazione dell'offerta per imprese ed enti pubblici. Guidare l'evoluzione del portafoglio di soluzioni e servizi, valutando tecnologie emergenti e applicazioni dell'intelligenza artificiale in funzione delle esigenze del mercato e del ritorno economico. Valorizzare e sviluppare le competenze dei collaboratori, promuovendo collaborazione tra team, responsabilizzazione e condivisione delle conoscenze. Gestire e sviluppare le relazioni con vendor e partner strategici, collaborando con le funzioni competenti al presidio della qualità, della sicurezza delle informazioni e della compliance. Requisiti e competenze Esperienza in ruoli di direzione generale, direzione di business unit o responsabilità manageriale trasversale nel settore dei servizi, preferibilmente presso system integrator o provider di servizi IT, in alternativa altri servizi B2B es. Digital, TLC... Responsabilità maturata nella gestione di risultati economici, budget e team, con capacità di integrare visione strategica ed esecuzione operativa. Conoscenza del mercato ICT e dei modelli di business legati a progetti, servizi ricorrenti e soluzioni tecnologiche; capacità di valutarne marginalità, complessità operativa e potenziale di sviluppo. Preparazione tecnologica adeguata a confrontarsi con gli specialisti su infrastrutture, networking, cloud e cybersecurity e a orientare le scelte di offerta e investimento. Esperienza nel miglioramento di processi e organizzazione, con capacità di introdurre metodi e strumenti gestionali proporzionati alle esigenze di una piccola impresa. Capacità di costruire un rapporto di fiducia con la proprietà, condividere le priorità e rendicontare con chiarezza risultati, criticità e proposte. Costituiranno elementi preferenziali l'esperienza in contesti imprenditoriali o familiari e la partecipazione a percorsi di evoluzione manageriale. Saranno valorizzate anche la conoscenza del mercato pubblico e dei modelli di noleggio tecnologico. La ricerca è aperta anche a figure provenienti da ruoli di direzione Sales & Delivery, Operations o Commerciale, purché abbiano maturato responsabilità effettive su organizzazione, persone e risultati economici, oltre allo sviluppo delle vendite. Lo stile manageriale Cerchiamo una persona autorevole e concreta, capace di ascoltare, comprendere il contesto e accompagnare il cambiamento in modo costruttivo. Saranno centrali la capacità di coinvolgere collaboratori esperti, prendere decisioni e tradurre le opportunità tecnologiche in iniziative sostenibili per il business. L'opportunità professionale Il ruolo offre la possibilità di contribuire direttamente alla direzione e all'evoluzione di una piccola impresa ICT, lavorando a stretto contatto con la proprietà e incidendo sulle scelte organizzative, commerciali e tecnologiche. Il progetto valorizza una figura manageriale capace di coniugare sviluppo del business, qualità del servizio e continuità delle relazioni con clienti e collaboratori. title: Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) - HRC1792713 (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.Driving continuous improvement - ready to make quality a culture?As a Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) in our Quality & Excellence team uncover the root causes behind every single error, drive transformational improvements, and implement forward-thinking solutions to ensure our products exceed the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Act as the technical lead and methodological expert for Burn-in (BI), including steering BI decisions, driving continuous improvements, and serving as the primary interface to technology and product development as well as statistics teams- Provide teaching, coaching, and knowledge transfer on Burn-in topics to cross-functional teams, ensuring a consistent and high-quality understanding of BI methodologies across the organization- Support Design for Stress (DfS) sustaining activities, including the management and resolution of DfS Jira Tickets in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders- Serve as the 1st level of support for internal customer inquiries, with a particular focus on** Automotive Governance**, ensuring timely and solution-oriented responses- Drive long-term, strategically important tasks that require sustained attention, ensuring that critical but non-urgent topics receive appropriate prioritization and follow-through- Collaborate closely with Front-End (FE), Back-End (BE) and product development teams, contributing expert knowledge on failure mechanisms, defects, design and test conditions to support informed quality decisions- Lead customer communications about early topics- Contribute to the continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems (QMS), processes, methods, and tools along the entire supply chain, with a strong automotive quality mindsetYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - A degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field- At least 6 years of professional work experience in semiconductor manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality management along the supply chain, Front-End and Back-End processes, and reliability testing- Expert-level knowledge in Burn-in methodologies, including deep understanding of physical failure mechanisms, defect analysis, Fault Analysis (FA), and test conditions relevant to semiconductor devices- Proven experience as a technical lead in a cross-functional environment, with the ability to drive decisions, align stakeholders, and manage Design for Stress (DfS) activities effectively- Solid understanding of wafer manufacturing process, foundational skills in data analysis, and familiarity with chip design, test engineering and product development processes- Proficiency in digital collaboration tools such as Confluence, Jira, and Intranet platforms- Show a strong automotive quality mindset and knowledge about automotive requirements- Outstanding interpersonal skills and a genuine service provider attitude, with demonstrated ability to coach, teach, and inspire colleagues while fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture- Fluent English (written and spoken); German is a plusPlease send us your CV in EnglishPlease note that:- Subject to meeting all job requirements, belonging to protected categories under Law 68/69 will be considered a preferential requirementAdditional information by locationAustriaWe offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H,I (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.Salary pay information:In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.LocationIndicative salary rangePadova, Italy*€52,000 – €71,500*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. Employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package, which may include further compensation and benefit elements depending on local regulations and company policies.#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/)  and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/)  at Infineon.HRC1792713

title: direttore dei sistemi informatici/direttrice dei sistemi informatici
description: Per conto di una realtà strutturata operante nel settore chimico-farmaceutico, inserita in una fase di trasformazione digitale e di rafforzamento dei presidi di governance, sicurezza e standardizzazione a livello di Gruppo, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Chief Technology Officer La posizione si colloca a diretto riporto del CIO e rappresenta un ruolo 'ponte' tra l'operatività quotidiana e la definizione/adozione di policy, processi e controlli, con focus particolare sulla gestione delle sussidiarie estere e sul governo dei fornitori. Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Contribuire alla roadmap tecnologica insieme al CIO: priorità di investimento, architetture target, standard, piani di miglioramento e misurazione dell'avanzamento. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. Possibili trasferte presso sedi del Gruppo in Italia e all'estero in funzione dei progetti. Inquadramento Contratto a tempo indeterminato, livello Quadro. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Il nostro Cliente è un importante gruppo industriale italiano, leader nella manifattura per il settore food & beverage, con presenza internazionale e un percorso di sviluppo fondato su innovazione, investimenti e solidità operativa. Per potenziamento della funzione Acquisti tecnici a supporto dei plant, ricerchiamo un/una: Industrial Sr Buyer / Technical Procurement (CAPEX & MRO). La risorsa, riportando al Purchasing Manager, opererà trasversalmente sugli stabilimenti italiani con impatto diretto su continuità produttiva, governance della spesa tecnica e performance dei fornitori. Collaborerà quotidianamente con Engineering, Manutenzione e Plant Management, oltre che con Qualità/HSE, Finance e Legal. Gestirà relazioni con fornitori italiani e internazionali (OEM, integratori, service provider) e, per investimenti o accordi quadro rilevanti, supporterà l'escalation verso General Management e Proprietà. È possibile un contributo su iniziative corporate di standardizzazione/razionalizzazione con estensione internazionale. Principali responsabilità: Gestione end-to-end del sourcing su CAPEX, servizi tecnici e MRO: dal fabbisogno alla contrattualizzazione Impostazione e conduzione di RFQ/RFP e gare, con comparativi tecnico-economici e analisi TCO Negoziazione di condizioni commerciali e contratti (garanzie, penali, tempi di consegna, collaudi/accettazioni, ricambi e service) Definizione e gestione di accordi quadro e contratti di service con SLA/KPI, aumentando la copertura contrattuale della spesa ricorrente Vendor management: qualifica, monitoraggio performance, gestione criticità/claim, mitigazione rischi (lead time, single source, continuità assistenza) Supporto a Engineering/Manutenzione su standardizzazione, ricambistica critica e iniziative di miglioramento Competenze tecniche richieste: Diploma tecnico (Perito Meccanico/Meccatronico) e/o Laurea in Ingegneria (preferenza Meccanica/Meccatronica/Industriale) Esperienza indicativa 5-10+ anni in acquisti tecnico-industriali in contesti manifatturieri strutturati Esposizione concreta a CAPEX e contrattualistica service, oltre a categorie MRO (ricambi, consumabili, manutenzioni) Familiarità con tendering strutturato, logiche TCO e disciplina di processo Buona padronanza di ERP/strumenti di procurement Inglese fluente per negoziazione e gestione fornitori internazionali Competenze manageriali e soft skills: Negoziazione evoluta e capacità di gestire trade-off costo/qualità/rischio/continuità Autorevolezza con stakeholder tecnici, forte orientamento all'execution e gestione priorità in contesto produttivo Comunicazione sintetica e capacità di escalation strutturata Approccio data-driven, rigore e affidabilità Sede di lavoro: Italia, area Emilia-Romagna, con trasferte prevalentemente nazionali e, in funzione dei progetti, internazionali. Attività prevalentemente on site. Offerta: inserimento a tempo indeterminato. Package indicativo: RAL €45.000-€55.000 + MBO ~10%. Eventuali benefit saranno definiti in base a inquadramento e policy aziendali. Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description: We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a3D Production Manager (m/f/d)Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, StockholmYOUR TASKS:- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters- Actively contributing to the further development of our companyYOUR PROFILE:- Experience in leadership- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness- Fluent English (business level)OUR TOP 3 REASONS:- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design- Responsibility right from the start- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international companyAfter an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.

Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt. Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

Näet heti, missä kukin hanke on ja mitä tänään kannattaa tehdä. - **Trusty AI-Engine laskee, sinä tarkistat.** Se yhdistää sääntöpohjaisen laskennan ja tekoälyn. Se laskee tilinpäätöksistä ja tapaamistiedoista, millainen rahoitus hankkeelle sopii ja mihin takaisinmaksu perustuu. - **Asiakasraportti tekee tuloksista ymmärrettäviä.** Asiakas saa raportin päätöksenteon tueksi, ja sinä saat pohjan keskustelulle rahoituksen vaihtoehdoista. - **Rahoittajapaketti kokoaa valmistellun aineiston.** Siitä näkyy, mitä yritys aikoo toteuttaa ja miksi rahoitus kannattaa. Etenemisestä saat osaamismerkkejä. **Harjoituksia voit uusia rajattomasti.****Mitä teet Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijana?**- hankit yritysasiakkaita ja avaat keskustelun yrittäjien kanssa heidän hankkeistaan - kartoitat rahoitustarpeen ja kokoat tilinpäätös- ja tapaamistiedot - tarkistat rahoitusanalyysin ja käyt Asiakasraportin läpi asiakkaan kanssa - valmistelet Rahoittajapaketin ja huolehdit sovituista jatkotoimista - pidät asiakkaan ajan tasalla hankkeen loppuun saakka **Roolin ydin ei ole tuotteiden myynti.** Ymmärrät asiakkaan tilanteen ja rakennat sille oikean rahoitusratkaisun. **Trusty Finance on yritykselle maksuton**, mikä madaltaa kynnystä aloittaa keskustelu.**Kenelle tehtävä sopii?**Voit tulla esimerkiksi B2B-myynnin, yritysasiakastyön, pankin, rahoituksen tai taloushallinnon parista. Kokemus yrittäjien kanssa toimimisesta antaa hyvän pohjan, mutta **tärkeintä on oikea ote**: kuuntelet asiakasta, haluat oppia ja viet sovitut asiat loppuun.Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos tartut oma-aloitteisesti uusiin asiakaskeskusteluihin, työskentelet huolellisesti ja haluat rakentaa omaa liiketoimintaasi pitkäjänteisesti.**Yhteistyömalli: toimit itsenäisenä yrittäjänä**Kyseessä on **yrittäjämalli, ei työsuhde**. title: Executive Director/Directeur Général (m/f)
description: Description des tâches:Executive Director / Directeur Général (m/f/x)Friendship Luxembourg asbl LuxembourgAbout Friendship LuxembourgFounded in 2006, Friendship Luxembourg is part of the international Friendship network and supports the work of Friendship in Bangladesh, where the organisation works with some of the country's most remote and vulnerable communities.Friendship delivers programmes across healthcare, education, economic development, humanitarian assistance and climate resilience, and is an internationally recognised, award- winning organisation, most recently named the 2025 Earthshot Prize winner in the “Fix Our Climate” category.As Friendship Luxembourg continues to grow and evolve, we are looking for an Executive Director to lead its Luxembourg operations and support the organisation's continued development.The RoleReporting to the Board of Directors and working closely with the Chair and other Board members, the Executive Director will have overall responsibility for the day-to-day management of Friendship Luxembourg and its team of six persons.This is a broad, hands-on leadership role combining operational management, team leadership, stakeholder engagement, fundraising and organisational development. The successful candidate will play a central role in ensuring that Friendship Luxembourg operates effectively, develops strong relationships with its partners and donors, and continues to strengthen its contribution to the wider Friendship network.Key Responsibilities• Lead and support the Friendship Luxembourg team, setting clear priorities and fostering an effective and collaborative working environment.• Manage the organisation's activities and continued development, ensuring effective implementation of Board decisions and agreed priorities.• Strengthen fundraising and donor engagement, while identifying new funding sources and partnership opportunities.• Oversee financial and organisational management, including budgeting, financial monitoring, resource planning and internal processes.• Work closely with the Board of Directors, providing clear reporting, ensuring effective information flow and supporting implementation of Board decisions.• Develop and maintain key external relationships with public authorities, institutional partners, foundations, NGOs, donors and other stakeholders.• Coordinate with Friendship Bangladesh and the wider Friendship network, supporting effective collaboration across the organisation.• Represent Friendship Luxembourg externally, contributing to its visibility, credibility and presence within Luxembourg's development and humanitarian ecosystem.Candidate ProfileWe are looking for an experienced and credible leader who combines sound judgement, strong interpersonal skills and a pragmatic, hands-on approach.The ideal candidate will bring:• Relevant senior management or leadership experience, gained within an NGO, foundation, international organisation or the private sector.• Proven people-management skills and experience leading a professional team.• Experience in fundraising, donor relations, stakeholder management and/or partnership development.• Strong financial, organisational and project-management capabilities.• The ability to work effectively with a Board of Directors and senior external stakeholders.• A good understanding of the Luxembourg institutional and non-profit environment.• Excellent communication, relationship-building and organisational skills.• A high degree of integrity, autonomy, judgement and commitment to Friendship's mission.• Fluency in English and French is essential. Luxembourgish would be an advantage.Other languages would also be valuable.• You must already have the legal right to work in Luxembourg and you must be able to maintain a regular on-site presence in Luxembourg.What We OfferThis is an opportunity to take on a highly visible and varied leadership role within a committed, international and mission-driven organisation.The General Manager will have the opportunity to contribute directly to the future development of Friendship Luxembourg — strengthening the organisation, developing its funding and partnerships, supporting its team and helping increase the impact of Friendship's work with vulnerable communities.Location: LuxembourgPosition: Full-timeReporting to: Board of DirectorsApplication ProcedurePlease submit your application to Friendship using the following email address only: jobs@friendship.lu. Applications to any other email address will not be considered. Your application must include your CV and a separate motivation letter. Applications may be submitted in French or English.Please note that AI-assisted tools may be used to support the analysis of your application.Deadline for submission is 4 December 2026, but early application is encouraged. You can expect to be contacted by 22 December 2026. First interviews are expected to take place during the second half of December and early January. We hope to be able to reply to all applications, however if you have not received a response from us by 23 December 2026, you may consider that your application does not meet the required criteria for this position.Études: Master (Bac+5)Métier / domaine de formation:Expérience dans une ONG ou fondation et une bonne compréhension de l'environnement institutionnel et des ONG au Luxembourg. Expérience requise: 10 années

title: HEAD OF IT OPERATIONS (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description: FA-26033 HEAD OF IT OPERATIONS & SERVICE DELIVERY Permanent contract | BelvauxAre you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join usThe Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ ContextAt LIST, IT Operations & Service Delivery is far more than a support function - it is the operational backbone that enables 840 researchers, engineers, and administrative professionals to perform at the forefront of science and technology. The Head of IT Service Delivery & Operations holds a strategic management position within the IT function, accountable for the quality, operational security, and resilience of all IT services delivered to the organisation. This role shapes how IT services are experienced across LIST - from the first contact a user has with the Service Desk to the operational security and compliance posture of the organisation's endpoints and systems. The position sits at the intersection of service excellence, operational risk, and digital workplace strategy, and plays an integral role in the IT management team alongside the Heads of IT Infrastructure, Applications, and Information Security. Moreover, it is expected from the selected candidate to play an integral strategic advisory role within the IT Service Management team and Head. And directly supports critical IT transversal projects. In a research-oriented environment where IT users range from computational scientists to environmental engineers and corporate functions, the ability to translate diverse and complex needs into reliable, well-governed IT services is a genuine strategic differentiator. This role is expected to build the operational foundations that support LIST's ambitions - today and as the organisation grows. Your team and environment - Your team - 10 people across 3 areas• Service Desk - 6 committed professionals | first line of support for 840 users across research and administrative functions• Operational Security - 3 specialists | endpoint protection, access management operations, patching, and incident response support• Software Asset Management - 1 professional | licence compliance, CMDB, and vendor accountabilityThe IT Operations Office is structurally distinct from the Information Security.On a day-to-day basis, you will work closely with the Head of Information Technologies Service, your manager. He's in charge of 4 Offices, including the IT operations one. In total, around 40+ people (IT Service).Description - You will be mainly responsible for:IT Operations Management & Governance• Define and lead the IT Operations strategy, shaping LIST's operational IT model in alignment with the overall IT strategy and the organisation's research and innovation ambitions.• Establish and own the IT Operations governance framework - including operating model design, role clarity, accountability structures, escalation structures, and cross-domain coordination with Infrastructure, applications, and Information Security.• Act as a full member of the IT management team: contribute to strategic planning, organisational risk management, investment prioritisation, and the long-term evolution of IT services at LIST.• Develop and grow a team of 10 professionals across Service Desk, Operational Security, and Software Asset Management - covering device lifecycle, workplace services, operating environment standardisation, and support for hybrid and remote working models.• Shape users experience with ITSM as a strategic product: set service standards, promote user satisfaction, and ensure IT is perceived as a reliable, responsive, and enabling partner across research and administrative functions.• Own Service Desk performance as a reflection of IT's reputation - building a support culture that balances efficiency with genuine user-centricity in one of the most technically diverse user communities in Luxembourg.• Coordinate communication strategy for IT operational changes, incidents, and service evolutions - ensuring that end users, managers, and senior stakeholders are informed, prepared, and engaged.Incident, Request & Operational Control• Coordinate incident and request management, ensuring effective prioritisation, timely resolution, and transparent stakeholder communication • Own and coordinate major incident management, including stakeholder communication, root cause analysis, and tracking of corrective actionsIT Security Operations & Patching• Co-own LIST's operational risk posture alongside and in smooth collaboration with the Head of Information Security and Head of IT Infrastructure - description: Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d)LuxembourgLine of Service AdvisoryIndustry/Sector Banking and Capital MarketsSpecialism Fraud, Investigations & Regulatory Enforcement (FIRE)Management Level Senior AssociateJob Description & SummaryPwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d). What if it was you? Your Mission: In today's increasingly complex regulatory and financial environment, combating financial crime is a critical priority for all organisations. At our firm, the Financial Crime Compliance team acts as a strategic advisor to management and clients, proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks related to money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions breaches, fraud, and other financial crimes. As a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in delivering expert guidance, designing robust compliance frameworks, and supporting clients in implementing effective controls to safeguard their operations and reputation. Be a part of our team where you will: Client Risk Assessment and Advisory • Conduct comprehensive financial crime risk assessments, covering AML, sanctions, fraud, and bribery/corruption risks;• Advise clients on regulatory requirements and best practices under Luxembourg law, EU directives, FATF recommendations, and global standards;• Assist in designing and implementing financial crime compliance frameworks tailored to client risk profiles. Customer Due Diligence and Enhanced Due Diligence • Review and analyze KYC documentation for new clients during onboarding;• Perform ongoing due diligence and periodic reviews of existing client files;• Conduct reputational checks and adverse media screening on clients and beneficial owners. Transaction Monitoring and Investigations • Design and implement transaction monitoring systems to detect suspicious activities across multiple risk typologies;• Analyze transactional data to identify unusual patterns indicative of money laundering, fraud, or sanctions breaches;• Support clients in investigating alerts and preparing Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) for competent authorities. Sanctions and Screening Controls • Implement and oversee sanctions screening processes, ensuring compliance with EU, UN, and OFAC lists;• Review and validate screening results, investigate potential matches, and escalate confirmed hits;• Advise clients on integrating sanctions screening tools and maintaining up-to-date watchlists. Fraud and Bribery/Corruption Risk Management • Assist clients in developing anti-fraud and anti-bribery policies and controls;• Conduct fraud risk assessments and recommend mitigation measures;• Support investigations into suspected fraud or corruption cases. Monitoring, Reporting, and Regulatory Support • Prepare compliance reports and dashboards for senior management and regulators;• Support clients during regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring timely and accurate responses;• Maintain and file confidential compliance documentation in accordance with legal requirements. Training and Awareness • Deliver training sessions on financial crime compliance, including AML, sanctions, fraud, and anti-bribery measures;• Promote awareness of emerging risks, regulatory developments, and industry best practices. Let's talk about you. If you have/are: • Hold a university degree (minimum Bac+3) in Law, Finance, Compliance, or a related field; • Have at least 3–5 years of experience in financial crime compliance, AML, or regulatory advisory within financial services or consulting; • Possess strong knowledge of Luxembourg and EU financial crime regulations, FATF standards, and global compliance frameworks; • Bring proven experience in transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud risk management, and investigations; • Demonstrate excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to manage complex projects and multiple priorities; • Are fluent in English and French and/or German; • Hold certifications such as CAMS, CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), or equivalent, which are highly desirable. PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,800 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach. At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 370,000 people in 149 countries. title: Gestionnaire immobilier polyvalent (H/F)
description: Qui sommes-nous ?KWARTIER est une société luxembourgeoise spécialisée dans l'investissement, la gestion et le développement immobilier. Nous accompagnons principalement des investisseurs privés et des structures patrimoniales dans la constitution, la gestion, l'optimisation et la valorisation de leur patrimoine immobilier au Luxembourg. Notre philosophie est simple : nous gérons les biens de nos clients comme s'il s'agissait de nos propres biens. Cela implique une attention particulier/ière à la préservation de leur valeur, à l'optimisation de leur rendement, à la maîtrise des coûts et à la qualité de leur entretien sur le long terme. Notre approche repose sur un accompagnement personnalisé, une grande disponibilité, une discrétion absolue et une relation de confiance avec nos clients. Nous ne nous limitons pas à la gestion quotidien/ienne des propriétés : nous cherchons également à anticiper les besoins, identifier les possibilités d'amélioration et conseiller nos clients dans leurs décisions patrimoniales. Nos activités s'articulent autour de trois pôles complémentaires :-   La gestion immobilier/ière et l'optimisation de portefeuilles : gestion administrative, technique et locative de biens immobiliers appartenant à différents propriétaires, avec une attention particulier/ière portée à leur rentabilité, leur entretien et leur valorisation. -   La promotion immobilier/ière : identification d'opportunités d'investissement, développement et réalisation de projets immobiliers, notamment résidentiels. -   La construction et la rénovation : à travers notre société AMAK Construction S.à r.l., nous réalisons et coordonnons des projets de construction, de transformation et de rénovation immobilier/ière.Cette complémentarité nous permet d'intervenir à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie d'un bien immobilier, de son acquisition à sa gestion, son développement et son éventuelle revente. Le posteDans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons un(e) gestionnaire immobilier polyvalent(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe basée à Luxembourg-Ville. Le poste sera principalement consacré à la gestion et à l'optimisation des portefeuilles de nos clients, en assurant un service de qualité à nos propriétaires et locataires. Les missions comprendront notamment :-   Gestion quotidien/ienne des biens : être l'interlocuteur des propriétaires, locataires et prestataires, traiter les demandes et trouver des solutions aux problèmes rencontrés.-   Suivi technique et coordination des interventions : organiser les réparations, travaux d'entretien et interventions des différents corps de métier, demander et comparer des devis, suivre leur bonne exécution.-   Gestion locative : organiser les visites, assurer le suivi des candidatures, participer à la préparation des contrats de bail, coordonner les entrées et sorties des locataires et les états des lieux.-   Optimisation et valorisation du portefeuille : identifier les possibilités d'amélioration des biens, contribuer à l'optimisation des revenus locatifs, à la maîtrise des charges et à la préservation de la valeur des actifs à long terme.-   Suivi administratif : assurer le suivi des dossiers immobiliers, des contrats, des factures et des différentes démarches administratives.-   Relation client : maintenir une communication régulier/ière et professionnelle avec les propriétaires et locataires, dans un esprit de disponibilité, de discrétion et de recherche de solutions.Nous attachons une importance particulier/ière à une gestion proactive. Il s'agit d'anticiper les problèmes plutôt que de simplement y réagir, et de gérer chaque propriété avec le même soin, le même bon sens économique et le même niveau d'exigence que si elle nous appartenait. Un poste varié et évolutifSi la gestion immobilier/ière constitue le cœur du poste, la diversité de nos activités offre également la possibilité de s'impliquer progressivement dans d'autres domaines, notamment la promotion immobilier/ière et la construction. Au sein de notre structure à taille humaine, les responsabilités peuvent évoluer en fonction des compétences, des intérêts et de l'engagement de chacun. Le profil recherchéNous recherchons avant tout une personne autonome, débrouillarde, organisée et polyvalent(e), qui aime prendre des initiatives et trouver des solutions concrètes. Le/la candidat(e) idéal(e) devra notamment :-   Avoir un bon sens du contact et apprécier les relations humaines, aussi bien avec les clients qu'avec les locataires et les professionnels du bâtiment.-   Être organisé, rigoureux et capable de gérer plusieurs dossiers simultanément.-   Faire preuve de bon sens pratique, de réactivité, d'initiative et d'un réel sens des responsabilités.-   Être à l'aise avec les tâches administratives tout en appréciant le travail...

title: Innoclean - Corporate Governance Officer (H/F)
description: Compass Group est le leader mondial des services, présent dans plus de pays, avec plus de , collaborateurs et un chiffre d'affaires de milliards de dollars en . Cette envergure internationale témoigne de la solidité du Groupe et de son ambition : être un partenaire de référence en restauration et multi-services, reconnu pour ses équipes remarquables, un service exceptionnel et des résultats d'excellence.Au Luxembourg, Compass Group occupe depuis une position de leader sur le marché, auprès des entreprises, institutions, écoles, crèches et particuliers. Au Luxembourg, nous comptons plus de clients dans divers domaines tels que les entreprises, les banques, les hôpitaux, les crèches, les industries ou encore les copropriétés. Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons actuellement un Corporate Governance Officer (H/F). Description du poste Ce poste vise à garantir une gouvernance efficace, la coordination et la documentation de tous les comités établis dans le cadre des réglementations AIFMD et OPCVM (UCITS). Il soutient l'Organe de Direction en veillant à ce que les comités fonctionnent avec des mandats clairs, des processus cohérents et des décisions dûment documentées.Le poste est centré sur la gouvernance et n'exerce pas de fonction de contrôle de conformité (compliance) ni de gestion des risques. Principales missions 1. Cadre de gouvernance des comitésLe/La Responsable Gouvernance maintient le cadre de gouvernance des comités, notamment :L'inventaire de tous les comités ;Le suivi des chartes et mandats approuvés (Terms of Reference) ;Le calendrier des revues périodiques.Il/Elle veille à ce que les mandats, responsabilités et circuits d'escalade soient documentés et appliqués de manier/ière cohérente dans toute l'organisation, conformément aux exigences réglementaires et aux standards internes de gouvernance. 2. Gestion de la composition des comitésLe poste assure :La tenue à jour du registre des membres ;Le suivi des rôles, mandats et durées de fonction ;La coordination des nominations, démissions et remplacements.Le/La titulaire veille à l'obtention des validations nécessaires et à la mise à jour de la documentation de gouvernance et des registres internes. Il/Elle collabore également avec l'équipe Compliance pour l'application pratique des procédures relatives aux conflits d'intérêts. 3. Organigramme de gouvernance et des comitésLe poste est responsable de la mise à jour de la partie « gouvernance et comités » de l'organigramme de l'entreprise, comprenant :Les structures des comités ;Les présidents des comités ;Les membres ;Les lignes de reporting vers les Ressources Humaines et les Conducting Officers.L'organigramme doit refléter fidèlement les dispositifs de gouvernance en vigueur et pouvoir être utilisé lors d'audits, d'inspections réglementaires ou de demandes de due diligence. 4. Organisation des réunions et documentationLe/La Responsable Gouvernance gère l'intégralité du cycle de vie des réunions de comité :Élaboration du calendrier annuel ;Organisation et planification des réunions ;Vérification du quorum ;Préparation des ordres du jour conformément aux mandats ;Diffusion des dossiers de réunion dans les délais impartis. Il/Elle rédige des procès-verbaux clairs et précis reflétant :Les discussions essentielles ;Les questionnements et analyses ;Les décisions prises ;Les actions à entreprendre.Il/Elle coordonne également leur revue, leur approbation et leur archivage sécurisé, ainsi que celui des documents associés. 5. Suivi des actions et tenue des registresLe poste :Assure le suivi des plans d'actions des comités ;Veille à leur attribution et à leur clôture ;Escalade les sujets lorsque nécessaire. Il/Elle maintient également un référentiel complet et structuré de la documentation de gouvernance :Chartes et mandats ;Ordres du jour ;Dossiers de réunion ;Procès-verbaux ;Décisions ;Registres des actions. Cette documentation doit pouvoir être produite rapidement en cas d'audit, de revue interne ou d'inspection réglementaire. Bien que ce poste ne relève ni de la conformité ni du risque, il requiert une bonne compréhension pratique des exigences de gouvernance liées aux réglementations AIFMD et UCITS,...

title: Executive Director/Directeur Général (m/f)
description: Description des tâches:Executive Director / Directeur Général (m/f/x)Friendship Luxembourg asbl LuxembourgAbout Friendship LuxembourgFounded in 2006, Friendship Luxembourg is part of the international Friendship network and supports the work of Friendship in Bangladesh, where the organisation works with some of the country's most remote and vulnerable communities.Friendship delivers programmes across healthcare, education, economic development, humanitarian assistance and climate resilience, and is an internationally recognised, award- winning organisation, most recently named the 2025 Earthshot Prize winner in the “Fix Our Climate” category.As Friendship Luxembourg continues to grow and evolve, we are looking for an Executive Director to lead its Luxembourg operations and support the organisation's continued development.The RoleReporting to the Board of Directors and working closely with the Chair and other Board members, the Executive Director will have overall responsibility for the day-to-day management of Friendship Luxembourg and its team of six persons.This is a broad, hands-on leadership role combining operational management, team leadership, stakeholder engagement, fundraising and organisational development. The successful candidate will play a central role in ensuring that Friendship Luxembourg operates effectively, develops strong relationships with its partners and donors, and continues to strengthen its contribution to the wider Friendship network.Key Responsibilities• Lead and support the Friendship Luxembourg team, setting clear priorities and fostering an effective and collaborative working environment.• Manage the organisation's activities and continued development, ensuring effective implementation of Board decisions and agreed priorities.• Strengthen fundraising and donor engagement, while identifying new funding sources and partnership opportunities.• Oversee financial and organisational management, including budgeting, financial monitoring, resource planning and internal processes.• Work closely with the Board of Directors, providing clear reporting, ensuring effective information flow and supporting implementation of Board decisions.• Develop and maintain key external relationships with public authorities, institutional partners, foundations, NGOs, donors and other stakeholders.• Coordinate with Friendship Bangladesh and the wider Friendship network, supporting effective collaboration across the organisation.• Represent Friendship Luxembourg externally, contributing to its visibility, credibility and presence within Luxembourg's development and humanitarian ecosystem.Candidate ProfileWe are looking for an experienced and credible leader who combines sound judgement, strong interpersonal skills and a pragmatic, hands-on approach.The ideal candidate will bring:• Relevant senior management or leadership experience, gained within an NGO, foundation, international organisation or the private sector.• Proven people-management skills and experience leading a professional team.• Experience in fundraising, donor relations, stakeholder management and/or partnership development.• Strong financial, organisational and project-management capabilities.• The ability to work effectively with a Board of Directors and senior external stakeholders.• A good understanding of the Luxembourg institutional and non-profit environment.• Excellent communication, relationship-building and organisational skills.• A high degree of integrity, autonomy, judgement and commitment to Friendship's mission.• Fluency in English and French is essential. Luxembourgish would be an advantage.Other languages would also be valuable.• You must already have the legal right to work in Luxembourg and you must be able to maintain a regular on-site presence in Luxembourg.What We OfferThis is an opportunity to take on a highly visible and varied leadership role within a committed, international and mission-driven organisation.The General Manager will have the opportunity to contribute directly to the future development of Friendship Luxembourg — strengthening the organisation, developing its funding and partnerships, supporting its team and helping increase the impact of Friendship's work with vulnerable communities.Location: LuxembourgPosition: Full-timeReporting to: Board of DirectorsApplication ProcedurePlease submit your application to Friendship using the following email address only: jobs@friendship.lu. Applications to any other email address will not be considered. Your application must include your CV and a separate motivation letter. Applications may be submitted in French or English.Please note that AI-assisted tools may be used to support the analysis of your application.Deadline for submission is 4 December 2026, but early application is encouraged. You can expect to be contacted by 22 December 2026. First interviews are expected to take place during the second half of December and early January. We hope to be able to reply to all applications, however if you have not received a response from us by 23 December 2026, you may consider that your application does not meet the required criteria for this position.Études: Master (Bac+5)Métier / domaine de formation:Expérience dans une ONG ou fondation et une bonne compréhension de l'environnement institutionnel et des ONG au Luxembourg. Expérience requise: 10 années

title: Senior Relationship Manager / Developer - New Resident Desk (m/f)
description: Senior Relationship Manager / Developer - New Resident Desk (M/F)Luxembourgreq1196BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. You will be at the forefront of building relationships within Luxembourg's international community, developing new business opportunities and establishing BIL as a trusted wealth management partner for new residents.This is more than a relationship management role. It is an opportunity to help build and shape a growing business, expand BIL's reach within Luxembourg's international community and directly contribute to the growth of our Wealth Management franchise.Your next challenge:• Develop new relationships with international private clients, entrepreneurs, executives and business owners relocating to Luxembourg.• Building strong relationships with relocation firms, tax advisers, lawyers, real estate professionals, financial intermediaries and other centres of influence.• Identifying new business opportunities and maintaining an active and sustainable client development pipeline.• Building long-term relationships based on trust and a strong understanding of clients' financial and wealth management needs.• Supporting clients through the key financial decisions associated with relocating to Luxembourg.• Delivering tailored wealth management solutions across investments, wealth planning, life insurance, financing and succession planning.• Working closely with investment specialists, wealth planners, credit experts and other business lines to provide clients with a comprehensive service.• Take part in organizing and representing BIL at relevant client events, networking initiatives, seminars and industry gatherings to strengthen our network and develop new business opportunities.• Contributing to the continued development of the New Resident Desk and helping shape its future growth strategy.• Ensuring disciplined follow-up of prospects, opportunities and commercial activities through the Bank's CRM tools.Your skills: • You have at least 7–10 years of professional experience in banking, including significant experience developing relationships with high-net-worth private clients.• You have a strong network of private clients, entrepreneurs and financial intermediaries, ideally within Luxembourg's international community.• You have excellent knowledge of the products and services relevant to private clients and financial intermediaries in Luxembourg, including investments, life insurance, wealth planning solutions and credit financing.• You demonstrate strong commercial drive, an entrepreneurial mindset and a genuine ability to develop and grow a business.• You have a proven ability to build long-term relationships and generate new business opportunities.• You hold a university degree in finance, economics or a related field.• You are highly client- and results-oriented, with a rigorous, organised and methodical approach to business development and client relationship management.• You enjoy working as part of a team in a dynamic and evolving environment and are motivated to contribute to its success.For this position, we are particularly interested in candidates with strong connections to Nordic and international English-speaking communities.Fluency in English is essential. Knowledge of Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, French, German or Luxembourgish would be a strong advantage.BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience. BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

Responsabilités principales:• Assister la responsable achats dans la gestion quotidienne des fournisseurs.• Créer et mettre à jour les références produits dans les systèmes informatiques.• Veiller à la conformité des informations produits (fiches techniques, allergènes, étiquetage).• Assurer le suivi des commandes, des livraisons et des délais d'approvisionnement.• Contrôler les tarifs d'achat, les promotions et les conditions commerciales négociées.• Coordonner les lancements de nouveaux produits et les opérations saisonnières.• Assurer et maintenir une relation efficace et durable avec les fournisseurs et les points de vente• Collaborer avec les équipes marketing, qualité, logistique et magasins.• Gérer les litiges fournisseurs (prix, qualité, livraison).• Contribuer au développement des gammes et aux innovations produits.  Profil recherché:• Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme de formation supérieure en commerce, achats ou gestion.• Une première expérience dans les achats, l'approvisionnement ou l'univers alimentaire est un atout.• Vous avez un intérêt marqué pour l'univers de la boulangerie, de la pâtisserie et des produits frais.• Vous êtes à l'aise avec l'outil informatique et n'avez pas peur de vous familiariser avec de nouveaux logiciels.• Vous êtes organisé·e, rigoureux·se et capable de vous adapter à des situations variées.• Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et collaborez facilement avec différents interlocuteurs.• Vous maîtrisez le français tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit. Des connaissances en luxembourgeois, en allemand ou en anglais constituent un atout.

description: Recovery Specialist (m/f/n)• Luxembourg-Ville• Banque• FinanceEnvie de rejoindre une institution renommée et innovante?
