You thrive in collaborative environments, confidently manage multiple stakeholders, and enjoy solving challenging technical problems.Required Qualifications    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.    Extensive experience in automotive electronics development.    Proven experience developing ECUs and exposure to High-Performance Computing (HPC) platforms.    Demonstrated technical leadership experience, including leading engineering teams and technical activities.    Strong understanding of collaboration models with Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs.    Experience in automotive validation and verification activities.    Experience in project management or technical coordination within automotive development programs.    Hands-on experience with:    Action plan management    Failure analysis and root cause investigations    8D problem-solving methodology    Progress tracking and project follow-up    Experience working in cross-functional environments involving hardware, software, and verification teams.    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.    Professional proficiency in English.Preferred Qualifications    Experience managing complex automotive programs involving multiple stakeholders and supplier networks.    Knowledge of automotive development processes and product lifecycle management.    Experience with system integration and issue resolution in multidisciplinary environments.    Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, international engineering organization. Key Competencies    Automotive electronics expertise    Technical leadership    Structured and analytical problem-solving    Cross-functional collaboration    Project planning and execution    Effective communication and stakeholder management    Supplier and customer interface management    Results-driven mindset Why Join Us?This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on cutting-edge automotive technologies and contribute to innovative products that shape the future of mobility. You will work alongside talented engineers in a collaborative, international environment where your expertise, leadership, and ideas will help drive technical excellence and meaningful results.In this role, you will report to the Head of ECU and HWReady to take the next step in your career? We look forward to hearing from you.We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. Who we are and what we believe in We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. Trucks Technology & Industrial Division hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need. Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Drifttekniker till datacenter i Boden
description: Är du en person som gillar teknik, både den digitala och den mer handfasta, och tycker det är kul att lära dig nya saker? Trivs du bäst när du jobbar ihop med andra i ett team där alla hjälps åt? Och bor du inom 50 minuter från Boden, eller kan du tänka dig att flytta hit?Då vill vi gärna att du söker jobbet som drifttekniker hos ossVilka är vi?BRS Networks är ett väletablerat företag inom fiber och IT. Vi är cirka 75 medarbetare med huvudkontor i Visby och kontor i Kalmar, Mälardalen och Tyskland. Vi är en Managed Service Provider (MSP). Det betyder att vi tar helhetsansvar för våra kunders IT-miljöer, med tjänster inom datacenter, IT-infrastruktur, drift, support och IT-säkerhet.Hos oss är det prestigelöst och vi har stark laganda. Ingen fråga är för liten, och du har alltid kollegor att vända dig till.Vad ska du göra?Som drifttekniker ser du till att allt fungerar i ett modernt, affärskritiskt datacenter. Dina insatser gör att våra kunder kan lita på hög tillgänglighet och stabil drift. Det är en viktig roll.En vanlig arbetsvecka kan innehålla:Daglig drift av den tekniska infrastrukturen· Övervakning och reparationer. Du håller koll på larm och utrustning, åtgärdar fel och byter ut eller reparerar trasiga komponenter· Drift och underhåll av servrar, nätverk och system· Datacentrets fysiska miljö, alltså kraft, kyla och säkerhet· Skötsel av fastigheten till viss del. Du ser till att byggnaden och dess installationer håller god standard, gör enklare underhåll och tillsyn och är kontaktperson mot leverantörer och entreprenörer när det behövs· Felsökning, incidenter och serviceärenden. Ibland är det lite detektivarbete!· Dokumentation av det du har gjort· Månatlig audit. Varje månad inventerar du alla maskiner och all nätverksutrustning i datacentret, så att vi alltid har koll på vad som finns och var det finnsDu jobbar nära kollegor, teamledare och andra tekniker. Vi ger dig stöd från början, och i takt med att du växer i rollen får du ta större tekniskt ansvar.Det här är viktigt att känna till: beredskapI tjänsten ingår beredskap och den kan även innebära skiftarbete. När du har beredskap ska du kunna vara på plats vid datacentret i Boden inom 50 minuter efter larm. Därför behöver du bo inom 50 minuters resväg från Boden, till exempel i Boden, Luleå eller en närliggande ort. Du kan också flytta hit innan du börjar.Skriv i din ansökan var du bor i dag. Om du planerar att flytta, skriv när du kan vara bosatt i området. Vi kan tyvärr inte behandla ansökningar som saknar den här uppgiften eller där kravet inte uppfylls.Vem är du?Du behöver inte kunna allt från dag ett. Nyfikenhet och rätt inställning väger tungt hos oss! Det här behöver du ha med dig:· Gymnasieutbildning eller yrkesutbildning, gärna med inriktning mot IT, elektronik eller teknik· Grundläggande tekniska kunskaper och intresse för IT-drift, nätverk och datacenter· Noggrannhet och en lösningsorienterad inställning· Du trivs med att jobba strukturerat i en miljö där säkerhet och kvalitet är avgörande· God kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och engelska· B-körkortDet är ett plus om du har erfarenhet av arbete i datacenter eller relevanta certifieringar.Vad får du hos oss?En arbetsplats som präglas av samarbete, ansvar och utvecklingErfarna kollegor som gärna delar med sig av vad de kanChansen att utvecklas både tekniskt och personligtEn inkluderande arbetsmiljö där vi värdesätter mångfald och där alla får möjlighet att växa

title: Senior Product Assurance Manager
description: OHB Sweden is a leading Swedish supplier of space systems. We develop, build, test and commission satellites and subsystems for a wide range of missions - including communications, Earth observation, and space research and exploration- serving both institutional and commercial customers within and outside Europe.We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Assurance Manager to join the Quality & Product Assurance team at OHB Sweden.In this role, you will lead Product Assurance activities within our space projects, ensuring that quality, reliability and product assurance requirements are effectively implemented throughout the project lifecycle. You will work closely with engineering, project management, customers and suppliers, with a direct impact on product quality and mission success. Your Role and Responsibilities    Lead and coordinate Product Assurance activities throughout the complete project lifecycle    Define and maintain project Product Assurance plans and ensure compliance with applicable ECSS, customer and company requirements    Act as the main Product Assurance interface towards customers, suppliers and project teams    Support and participate in project reviews, including PDR, CDR, MRR, TRR and acceptance reviews    Manage nonconformances, review boards, root cause investigations and corrective actions    Review and approve PA related documentation, qualification evidence and supplier deliverables    Coordinate Product Assurance disciplines such as EEE, materials and processes, RAMS, software assurance and quality assurance    Perform and support supplier audits, inspections and assessments    Identify product and quality risks and ensure appropriate actions are implemented    Provide technical leadership, guidance and mentoring to other Product Assurance and Quality engineers, consistent with OHB Sweden's senior PA profile.Your Qualifications    University degree in Engineering or another relevant technical field    5 years minimum of experience in Product Assurance or Quality Assurance within the space industry    Good knowledge of ECSS Product Assurance standards    Experience with space hardware development, manufacturing, integration, testing and qualification    Experience with nonconformance management, root cause analysis and supplier quality assurance    Ability to understand and review complex technical documentation    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills    Excellent written and spoken EnglishWho Are We Looking For?You are an experienced and pragmatic professional who combines strong technical judgement with a collaborative mindset. You are comfortable taking ownership, challenging decisions when necessary and working independently with customers, suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams. You bring a risk based and solution-oriented approach to Product Assurance, balancing quality, mission assurance, cost and schedule. The position is based at our office in Kista, Stockholm. Travel may be required, primarily within Europe and occasionally to the USA.

title: IT Security Advisor
description: Want to influence how security is built into IT solutions across a global industrial group? We’re looking for an experienced IT security professional who combines broad technical expertise with sound judgment, helping teams make informed, risk-based decisions throughout the solution lifecycle. We offer you:     Real influence and independence, without people-management responsibility.      Close collaboration with product teams, architects, projects and experienced security specialists.      Exposure to a large, complex environment with an evolving technical scope.  About your job As IT Security Advisor, you provide independent, risk-based guidance and assurance across a broad range of technologies and business solutions. Working closely with stakeholders, you identify relevant requirements and risks, challenge designs when needed and turn complex security matters into clear, practical recommendations. Job responsibilities     Guide product owners, system owners, architects and projects on solution design, security requirements and potential risks.     Conduct independent IT Security Reviews, documenting findings, risk rationale and recommendations on production readiness.     Facilitate security risk assessments and contribute expertise in threats, controls and technical impact.     Interpret security policies and frameworks, helping stakeholders apply them to specific solutions.     Represent Cybersecurity in projects and initiatives, constructively challenging proposed designs and decisions.     Improve advisory services, policies, procedures, guidelines and reusable security practices.  LocationThis position is based in Stockholm or Sandviken.Your profile You’re an experienced IT security professional with technical breadth and judgment to independently assess complex solutions. A strong understanding of risk and compliance enables you to balance security requirements with business needs and apply policies pragmatically. Your background includes     Several years of experience in security architecture, technical security assessments or security risk assessments.     A relevant university degree or the equivalent knowledge.      Practical experience assessing Azure, Microsoft 365 or other key infrastructure platforms.     Knowledge of cloud and SaaS security, identity and access management, and data protection.     Working knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework and CIS Controls.     The ability to document and communicate risks, control gaps and the reasoning behind your recommendations.     Fluency in English is required, while knowledge of Swedish is beneficial. Experience from a large, complex enterprise environment is beneficial, as is  M&A integrations, APIs, application permissions, endpoint or network security. Familiarity with ISO 42001 and AI security is also valuable, and certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CISA, SC-100, AZ-500 or equivalent are considered an advantage. Clear communication and a collaborative approach help you build trusted relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Curious and pragmatic, you quickly understand unfamiliar technologies, translate technical issues into business risks and challenge decisions constructively. You’re comfortable taking ownership, working independently and sharing your expertise with others. The teamYou join IT Security Architecture & Advisory within Cybersecurity at Sandvik Group IT. Mainly based in Stockholm, the team consists of three experienced security advisors and four architects who support product teams, system owners, architects and projects. Together, you develop a more structured, pattern-based approach to security assurance across the solution lifecycle.Our culture At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences.Contact information For further information about this position, please contact Johannes Ryberg, hiring manager, johannes.ryberg@sandvik.com  We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contact in that matter. Union contacts – Sweden     Johanna Beijer, Unionen, +46 (0)70 616 18 27     Tord Engström, Akademikerföreningen, +46 (0)76 106 62 87     Peter Olsson-Andrée, Ledarna, +46 (0)70 222 48 55 Recruitment Specialist: Farzaneh Ghaderi Azar  How to apply We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible and no later than December 7th, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0099167.  We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure an objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test. To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com.

title: Financial Planning & Analysis Lead
description: At Voyado we’re growing internationally, and with growth comes new opportunities, challenges, and decisions to make. That’s where you come in!We’re looking for an FP&A Lead who combines a sharp analytical mind with a strong commercial mindset. Someone who’s curious about the business behind the numbers, enjoys working with people, and isn’t afraid to challenge assumptions or bring new ideas to the table.This is a role where you’ll get the best of both worlds: taking the lead in a small team while staying close to the business and getting hands-on with the numbers yourself.Sound like your kind of challenge? Keep reading!About the roleAs our FP&A Lead, you’ll connect financial performance with what’s happening across the business.You’ll provide day-to-day leadership for a team of business controllers, setting priorities and supporting their success without formal people-management responsibilities. Working closely with stakeholders across Voyado, you’ll turn financial insights into meaningful conversations that help drive smarter business decisions.You’ll also help develop our FP&A processes and ways of working as we continue to scale. You’ll report directly to our CFO, Björn Källén.Some things you'll be up to:    Partner with the business. Work closely with stakeholders, understand their challenges, challenge assumptions, and bring financial and commercial perspectives to the table.    Stay hands-on. Own financial planning, forecasting, performance follow-ups, and analysis for your business areas.    Connect the dots. Analyze SaaS metrics and business performance to identify opportunities, understand what’s driving growth, and support better decisions.    Lead by example. Guide the team’s day-to-day work, support your colleagues, and foster collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.    Challenge and improve. Help develop our FP&A processes, reporting, and tools, including exploring how automation and AI can help us work smarter.Who you areFirst things first: we’re not looking for someone who simply loves spreadsheets and financial reporting. We’re looking for someone who loves understanding a business and using numbers to make a difference.We believe you bring:    Solid experience in FP&A, business controlling, commercial finance, or a similar business-oriented finance role.    Hands-on experience in tech/B2B SaaS, with a strong understanding of recurring revenue models and key metrics such as ARR, churn, retention, and customer economics.    Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn financial data into actionable business insights.    A commercial mindset and experience working closely with stakeholders to influence business decisions.    Experience in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis.    The ability to guide and support others, bring people together, and create structure and momentum in a team.    Professional fluency in English.Experience leading or coordinating others is a plus, but what matters most is your ability to take initiative, bring people together, and lead by example.Your background doesn’t have to follow the traditional finance path. What matters is that you understand the commercial side, enjoy working with people, and know how to turn insights into action.High Impact. Great People. Real Growth.You’ll join a growing international SaaS company where finance plays an important role in shaping the business.You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact. With plenty of room to challenge existing ways of working, bring new ideas, and influence how we grow, this is a role where your contribution will truly matter.And of course, we want you to enjoy the journey along the way!Some of our benefits:    30 days of vacation    Wellness allowance    Personal development opportunities    Summits and team activities    Four days from the office and one day from homeAbout VoyadoVoyado is the agentic OS for retail. AI is only as good as what it knows about the business, so Voyado brings customer, product, order, and behavioral data together in one connected system, creating the context retail runs on. With retail intelligence and agentic reasoning on top, AI agents use that single source of truth to make informed decisions and act across the full customer journey.By combining customer data with product intelligence, Voyado helps retailers deliver more relevant experiences across every channel — online and in-store. The result is more traffic, higher conversions, stronger customer relationships, and measurable business impact.We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.Ready to make an impact?Fantastic! 🎉Applying is easy — just upload your resume. We’d love to hear what excites you about this role and what challenges you’re eager to take on. Be yourself, and let your passion shine through.Additional informationAs part of our recruitment process, we conduct a background check on the final candidate.Making it personal with AIWe believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself, with support from AI where it makes sense. Later in the process, you may even be expected to use AI. At the end of the day, what matters is meeting you — the person behind the application.There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human, so please bring your authentic self. Don’t let AI over-polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice, because that’s what we care about most.

title: Product Cost Specialist to Axis Communications
description: If you would like to become a part of a great team with highly skilled and motivated professionals, working in an innovative and developing environment, continue reading! They are a growing team and are now looking for a Product Cost Specialist.About the roleWho is your future team?Axis Manufacturing Capacity and Cost team is a great contributor to our company's success by developing our base of manufacturing partners and specifically secure cost competitiveness and constant improvements to our purchase costs. Your responsibility will be to ensure the right cost on Axis products through finding opportunities and driving cost reductions from our contract manufacturers, in close collaboration with your colleagues.Who are we looking for/Who are you?We believe you are analytical and have a great eye for details, at the same time you easily see the bigger picture from a holistic perspective. You are ambitious, self-driven and very result oriented. You thrive in collaboration with others and see the benefit of working towards common goals. You are open and your communication skills help you in reaching your goals. We see that you are curious and persistent in the work to make sure that the area of responsibility is delivered. Discussions and negotiations with internal as well as external partners are something that you enjoy, as part of your collaboration skills.This position is very important as you will have great opportunity to affect a significant part of Axis total cost and by this, have the opportunity to affect and make a big difference to our business and continued success.Work tasks    Be responsible for analyzing, negotiating and approving product cost quotations from Axis contract manufacturers throughout the product life-cycle.    Be responsible for identifying and driving cost reduction activities towards our contract manufacturers by analyzing quotation data and having good understanding of all relevant cost drivers.    Work in close cooperation with our contract manufacturers to achieve timely implementation of Axis negotiated component prices in product quotations.    Analyze and maintain product and component database from internal and external sources and create a benchmark to be used in price reduction activities with contract manufacturers.    Support RFQ process for new products and provide input to our product development organization regarding product cost structure and different cost drivers.    Follow-up and optimize different parameters affecting purchase cost of components at our contract manufacturers, such as order quantities, demand changes and delivery terms.    Contribute and give input to process- and IT- tools improvements within area of responsibility, independently or in collaboration with other relevant functions.The position will mean some travels abroad.We are looking for    A degree in Industrial Economy or Business Administration.    2-5 years of supply chain/sourcing experience, preferably from international manufacturing companies.    Experience working with RFQs, cost breakdowns, and supplier negotiations.    Experience from analyzing big amounts of data.    Advanced Excel skills and good MS Office skills.    Excellent skills in English, both orally and in writing.It’s good if you have experience from working in ERP systems and if you have knowledge about business culture in different parts of the world, it will benefit you greatly in your future role.Other information    Start: As soon as possible.    Scope: Full-time.    Location: Lund, and some international travel may be required.    About the assignment: You will be employed by Academic Work on a consulting assignment until the end of September 2027. If both parties are satisfied with the collaboration, there is a  possibility of being hired directly by Axis thereafter.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description: As a Senior Solutions Engineer in the Nordics Field Engineering team, you will use your technical expertise to demonstrate how our Data Intelligence Platform can help customers solve their complex data challenges. You’ll work with a collaborative, customer-focused team who values innovation and creativity, using your skills to create customised solutions to help our customers achieve their goals and guide their businesses forward.The impact you will have:    Form successful relationships with clients throughout your assigned territory to provide technical and business value in collaboration with an Account Executive and a senior Solutions Architect.    Gain excitement from clients about Databricks through hands-on evaluation and Spark programming, integrating with the wider cloud ecosystem and 3rd party applications.    Contribute to building the Databricks technical community through engagement at workshops, seminars, and meet-ups.    Become a Big Data Analytics advisor on aspects of architecture and design.    Support your customers by authoring reference architectures, how-tos, and demo applications.    Develop both technically and in the pre-sales aspect with the goal of becoming an independently operating Solutions Architect.What we look for:• Familiarity working with clients, creating a narrative, answering customer questions, aligning the agenda with important interests, and achieving tangible outcomes.• Ability to independently deliver a technical proposition, identify customers’ pain-points, and explain important areas for business value to develop a trusted advisor skillset.• Code in a core programming language such as Python• Knowledgeable in a core Big Data Analytics domain with some exposure to advanced proofs-of-concept and an understanding of a major public cloud platform.• Experience diving deeper into solution architecture and Data Engineering.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.The RoleTo support our growing scale, we are looking for a Cloud Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will help design, operate, and evolve our private cloud platform built on OpenStack and Ceph.You will work on large-scale infrastructure challenges across compute, storage, and networking — ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and scalable. This includes improving automation, troubleshooting complex platform issues, and continuously optimizing the cloud environment to support our internal services and development workloads.Our work is highly collaborative. You will primarily work alongside other infrastructure teams such as database, networking, and platform engineers, while also supporting software teams when investigating infrastructure-related issues and performance bottlenecks.We value engineers who are curious, pragmatic, and driven to improve systems through automation and operational excellence. If you enjoy building and running the infrastructure that large engineering organizations depend on, and want to have a direct impact on the reliability and evolution of our private cloud platform, this is the role for you.Responsibilities    Design, deploy, and operate our private cloud platform based on OpenStack and Ceph    Manage and improve core cloud services including compute, storage, and networking    Maintain and optimize the Ceph storage platform to ensure performance, reliability, and scalability    Improve platform reliability and operability through automation and infrastructure tooling    Monitor and troubleshoot issues across the cloud stack, from hypervisors and storage to virtual networking    Work closely with infrastructure teams such as database, networking, and platform engineers to troubleshoot platform issues and performance bottlenecks, while also collaborating with software engineers when investigating service behavior and reliability.    Contribute to platform architecture decisions and continuous improvements of the cloud environment    Document systems, architecture, and operational practices to support knowledge sharing within the teamRequirements    Strong Linux administration experience in production environments    Hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting OpenStack and Ceph    Experience with monitoring and observability tools    Experience managing virtual machines and virtual networking    Comfortable building and maintaining infrastructure using GitOps and Infrastructure as Code    Experience with configuration management tools and Infrastructure as Code    Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (switching, routing, and virtual networks)BenefitsAt the Etraveli Group Gothenburg office, you will be part of +200 people, all with different cutting-edge skills and personalities. Our shared ambition, passion, and strong work ethic are what drive us toward the same goals. This foundation allows us to value our individual differences, which we believe are precisely what make us a strong team. With us you can enjoy:    Our office is located in Merkurhuset in Gothenburg, a few steps away from public transport and lunch restaurants.    We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location    We love gaming and after work activities.    We know the value of personal development and continuous training.    Hackathons and Dev Weeks - We believe in promoting creativity and trying new things.    Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.    Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.    Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.

title: Affärsadministratör - Ragn-Sells Recyclables
description: Vill du göra riktig skillnad varje dag? På Ragn-Sells är det exakt det vi gör, oavsett vilken position du har. Vi är ett familjeföretag i tredje generationen med erfarenheten i ryggen och blicken mot morgondagens innovationer. Hos oss får du vara med och forma en cirkulär framtid där vi minskar behovet av att bryta nya råvaror och istället använder det vi redan har – om och om igen. Ragn-Sells Recyclables söker nu en Affärsadministratör till vår verksamhet på Väderholmen. Här får du en central roll i våra affärsflöden och blir en viktig länk mellan kunder och olika delar av verksamheten. Vi erbjuder dig    Arbete inom en av Sveriges viktigaste branscher    En trevlig arbetsplats med bra och kunniga kollegor    Självklart goda anställningsvillkor med kollektivavtal, pension, friskvårdsbidrag osv.    Kompetensutvecklingsmöjligheter genom vår egen Akademi ArbetsuppgifterSom Affärsadministratör ansvarar du för den löpande affärsadministrationen och bidrar till att våra administrativa flöden fungerar effektivt och med hög kvalitet. I arbetet ingår bland annat kund- och orderadministration, fakturering, registervård samt hantering och uppföljning av fakturareklamationer.Du har många kontaktytor och samarbetar nära med kunder, försäljning, logistik och produktion. Du bidrar också till att utveckla och effektivisera våra administrativa arbetssätt. Din profil Vi söker dig som har gymnasieutbildning, gärna inom ekonomi, och erfarenhet av administrativt arbete. Du har god systemvana och erfarenhet av att arbeta i affärssystem, gärna Microsoft Dynamics 365 eller motsvarande. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och har goda kunskaper i engelska. Erfarenhet av affärs- eller försäljningsadministration samt återvinningsbranschen är meriterande.För vem passar den här tjänsten?Tjänsten passar dig som är strukturerad, noggrann och serviceinriktad och som trivs med många kontaktytor. Du arbetar självständigt, tar ansvar för dina uppgifter och har lätt för att samarbeta. Du är lösningsorienterad och kan prioritera när tempot är högt och förutsättningarna förändras. AnsökanVi arbetar med löpande urval och kan därmed komma att tillsätta tjänsten före sista ansökningsdatum som är 2026-12-23. Vid frågor om tjänsten kontakta Christian Gauffin på mailto:christian.gauffin@ragnsells.com.Välkommen med din ansökan!   Ragn-Sells is a privately held corporate group operating companies in six countries. Since 1966, we have been involved in waste management, environmental services and recycling. We collect, treat and recycle waste and residual products from businesses, organizations and households. Our 2,500 employees include specialists in many areas – from treatment experts who design and operate materials centers to experts on hazardous waste, sanitation and sorting. To complement our regular operations, we also provide consulting services with specialists on chemicals, energy and the environment. As a result of the continuous work to improve our services, Ragn-Sells has established Recyclables - an organization responsible for trading of raw materials in the six RS-countries. Recyclables is formed as a subsidiary company under the parent Ragn-Sellsföretagen AB.

title: Technical Coordinator

You will work closely with engineering, procurement, suppliers, contractors and other project stakeholders to ensure that technical scopes and documentation are properly coordinated.**Your responsibilities include**- Coordinating the preparation of technical tender and procurement documentation - Collecting and coordinating technical input from different engineering disciplines - Supporting the preparation of technical specifications, scope definitions and related documentation - Monitoring technical documents, reviews, approvals and outstanding actions - Coordinating technical interfaces and identifying possible gaps or overlaps between different scopes - Supporting technical clarifications during the tendering process - Supporting technical evaluations and contractor selection from a technical perspective - Following up on technical package progress, open items and key risks - Maintaining relevant technical documentation and reporting **We are looking for**- Relevant technical education in engineering or a related field - Extensive experience from industrial projects in technical coordination, engineering, procurement or project delivery roles - Experience with technical procurement, tender preparation or contractor coordination - Experience working with multidisciplinary technical scopes, such as **mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and piping** - Good understanding of technical specifications, scope definitions and project documentation - Experience coordinating technical interfaces between different disciplines, suppliers and contractors - Good IT and reporting skills - Good command of English **Applicants must have the right to work in Sweden.****Accommodation and project-related travel can be arranged by CMS as agreed.****Location:** Northern Sweden**Start:** November 2026**Estimated duration:** approximately 12 months

title: Commercial/ Sourcing SAP Solution Architect
description: Join us in shaping the future of digital manufacturing at Nobia Park!At Nobia Park, we're building one of Europe's most modern manufacturing environments. Our new factory combines advanced automation, digitalization, and lean operations to create a highly efficient and future-focused production setup.We are looking for a Commercial/Sourcing SAP Solution Architect to help design and develop SAP solutions that support our commercial and supply chain processes. Join Nobia's transformation journey and help build the future digital landscape at Nobia Park.Where we are right nowNobia is in one of the most exciting phases in its history. As part of our transformation journey, we are implementing a new SAP S/4HANA landscape while modernizing processes and systems across our business. At the heart of this transformation is Nobia Park in Jönköping, one of Europe's most automated and sustainable kitchen factories.As our digital landscape evolves, the need for scalable and integrated solutions continues to grow. In this role, you will drive solution design across sourcing, order management, logistics, and manufacturing processes, working closely with business stakeholders, developers, consultants, and architects to deliver integrated and scalable solutionsAbout the roleAs a Commercial/Sourcing SAP Solution Architect, you will design, implement, and support business-critical solutions within our SAP S/4HANA environment. Acting as the link between business needs and technical delivery, you will ensure solutions are aligned with both business objectives and architectural standards. The role combines solution architecture, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement in a highly automated manufacturing environment.Your responsibilities    Translate business requirements into scalable and effective SAP solutions within Sales & Distribution and Sourcing processes.    Design and support integrations between SAP S/4HANA and legacy or third-party systems.    Lead workshops and collaborate closely with business stakeholders to define requirements and future ways of working.    Work alongside developers, functional consultants, process owners, and other architects to deliver high-quality solutions.    Drive continuous improvement initiatives and identify opportunities to streamline processes and increase efficiency.Location: Nobia Park, Jönköping. In this role you be able to work remotely on occasions but must be prepared to on weekly basis visit our factory Nobia Park in Jönköping.Who you areYou are a proactive and collaborative professional who enjoys bridging business needs and technology. You thrive in complex environments, challenge existing ways of working, and build strong relationships across functions and countries.Most importantly, you are motivated by contributing to Nobia's transformation and helping shape the future digital architecture of our business.We believe you bring    Extensive experience with SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) and sourcing processes in complex business environments.    Strong knowledge of SAP configuration, solution design, and integrations across modules such as SD, MM, WM, PP, and FI.    Experience translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions and driving initiatives from design through implementation.    Understanding of commercial, logistics, and supply chain processes within manufacturing, retail, or trade environments.    Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, combined with fluency in English and Swedish.It is highly desirable if you have    Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementations.    Experience working in manufacturing or make-to-order (MTO) environments.    Knowledge of SAP Advanced ATP (aATP), Variant Configuration, and SAP EWM or similar warehouse management systems.    Experience integrating SAP with external systems and Fiori applications.    Basic knowledge of ABAP, debugging, and ITIL-based support and change management processes.About NobiaNobia is Europe’s leading kitchen specialist and part of everyday life for millions of people, with the kitchen playing an increasingly important role in modern homes. The Group consists of eighteen strong brands, including Marbodal, HTH, Sigdal, and uno form. Curious to learn more? Visit Nobia Park.Want to be a part of our journey?Then we would like to receive your application in English no later than November 29. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Our recruitment process is competency-based and includes assessments to provide both you and us with the best possible conditions for a successful match. title: Document Controller Mölndal, Göteborg

title: MES Solution Architect
description: Join us in shaping the future of digital manufacturing at Nobia Park!At Nobia Park, we're building one of Europe's most modern manufacturing environments. Our factory combines advanced automation, digitalization, and lean operations to create a highly efficient and future-focused production setup.We are now looking for a MES Solution Architect to play a key role in designing, developing, and evolving the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions that support our production and logistics operations.This is a unique opportunity to join a large-scale transformation journey where technology, processes, and people come together to create the factory of the future.Where we are right nowNobia is in one of the most exciting phases in its history. As part of our transformation journey, we are continuously developing the digital capabilities that support our highly automated production environment at Nobia Park in Jönköping.As production volumes continue to increase and new capabilities are introduced, the need for scalable, integrated and business-driven MES solutions becomes even more important. We are therefore strengthening our MES organization and expanding our internal capability to design, develop, and support solutions that create value across manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, and supply chain operations.About the roleAs a MES Solution Architect, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting business-critical MES solutions that enable efficient and reliable operations across the factory.Acting as the bridge between business processes and technical execution, you will ensure that solutions are scalable, integrated, and aligned with both business objectives and architectural standards.The role combines solution architecture, stakeholder collaboration, process development, and continuous improvement in a highly automated manufacturing environment.Your responsibilities    Translate business requirements into scalable and effective MES solutions, ensuring alignment with both operational needs and architectural standards.    Design and support integrations between MES, SAP S/4HANA, production equipment, and other business-critical systems.    Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, MES Solution Engineers, and external partners throughout the design, development, testing, and implementation lifecycle.    Contribute to the evolution of MES architecture, development standards, governance, and future ways of working.    Drive continuous improvement initiatives, support incident management, and contribute to increased operational efficiency, system stability, and production performance.Location: Nobia Park, Jönköping. This is an on-site position.Who you areTo succeed in this role, you are a proactive and collaborative professional who enjoys working where manufacturing processes and technology meet.You have the ability to understand operational needs and translate them into sustainable system solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, engaging with stakeholders across different functions, and driving improvements that create measurable business value.You are comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving and thrive in an environment where technology plays a critical role in operational success.Most importantly, you are motivated by being part of a transformation journey where your expertise will help shape the digital manufacturing landscape of one of Europe's most advanced production facilities.We believe you bring    5+ years of experience working with MES solutions in manufacturing environments, preferably within highly automated production facilities.    Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, MES architecture, and system integrations across MES, ERP (preferably SAP S/4HANA), machines and shop floor technologies.    Experience with C#, T-SQL, Microsoft SQL Server, relational databases, and industrial communication standards such as OPC UA.    Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.    Fluency in Swedish and English.It is highly desirable if you have    Experience with Insight2020.    Experience working in Agile development environments.About NobiaNobia is Europe’s leading kitchen specialist and part of everyday life for millions of people, with the kitchen playing an increasingly important role in modern homes. The Group consists of eighteen strong brands, including Marbodal, HTH, Sigdal, and uno form.At Nobia, you will have the opportunity to be part of a modern manufacturing environment where you can make a real impact. We offer a dynamic workplace with excellent opportunities for both personal and professional growth, giving you the chance to influence the way we work and the results we achieve. Our culture is built on safety, collaboration, and a continuous drive for improvement.Curious to learn more? Visit Nobia Park.Want to be a part of our journey?Then we would like to receive your application later than December 13.We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. A six-month probationary period can be applied.For questions regarding the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist josephine.tjernlund@nobia.comWe look forward to welcoming you to our team!

title: Global Key Customer Manager
description: Company description:At Epiroc, we collaborate with some of the world’s leading mining companies to address these challenges. We are now looking for a Global Key Account Manager who wants to contribute to developing these long-term partnerships and creating value for both our customers and Epiroc. This is a role for someone with a deep understanding of the mining industry who thrives at the intersection of people, technology, operational development, and business. You see the bigger picture of a mining operation and are motivated by building collaborations that make a real difference over time.Job description:Your missionAs a Global Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing and driving collaboration with some of Epiroc’s most strategically important global customers.You will work closely with both customer leadership teams and operational stakeholders, as well as colleagues across Epiroc, to identify opportunities, develop joint strategies, and ensure long-term growth for both parties.The role includes, among other things:     Develop and implement global account strategies for selected key customers.     Build long-term trust through presence, understanding, and strategic partnership.     Identify business opportunities within equipment, aftermarket services, automation, digitalization, and sustainable mining.     Coordinate customer activities across regions, divisions, and functions within Epiroc.     Act as a trusted advisor by understanding customer challenges and translating them into value-creating solutions.     Drive growth through both existing business and new business opportunities.     Ensure close collaboration between customer organizations and Epiroc’s global organization.     Develop a deep understanding of customers’ strategic priorities and future challenges.     Coordinate resources and expertise from different parts of Epiroc’s organization to meet customer needs.     Identify opportunities where Epiroc and the customer can create greater value together.     Contribute to the development of future solutions within automation, electrification, digitalization, and sustainable mining.     Ensure customer perspectives and needs are translated into concrete initiatives within Epiroc. Your profile We believe you have experience from the mining industry or a related industrial environment and a strong understanding of customers’ day-to-day operations, challenges, and long-term objectives. You understand the interplay between production, technology, maintenance, safety, and business performance.You may, for example, have worked as:     Mine Manager     Production Manager     Mining Engineering Manager or Mining Engineer     Mining Industry Consultant     Site Manager     Technical Services Manager     Mine Planning Manager or Engineer The most important thing is not your current title, but that you understand how value is created in the mining industry and can translate that understanding into strong, long-term business relationships.We would like you to have:     Solid experience from the mining industry.     A strong understanding of operational and strategic mining challenges.     Experience working across multiple functions and stakeholders.     The ability to create engagement and collaboration across organizational boundaries.     Strong communication skills and experience building relationships at both operational and strategic levels.     A genuine interest in people, technology, and business development.     Excellent English language skills. To thrive in this role, we believe you:     Are curious about how the mining industry is evolving.     Have a strong interest in both technology and business.     Are proactive, with a focus on results and long-term value creation.     Are skilled at creating engagement and fostering collaboration.     Are comfortable working in international environments and across different cultures.     Enjoy building relationships and earning trust over time.     See opportunities where others see complexity.     Have a strong holistic perspective and understand both operations and business.     Enjoy bringing people together around shared goals. Location and otherThis position can be in Örebro or Stockholm, Sweden. Other locations with proximity to Epiroc offices could also be discussed.Travel is required. We can offer a hybrid workplace—a way of working that provides flexibility and promotes a healthier balance between professional and personal life.Why Epiroc?By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact.To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:     Global career opportunities     Learning & Development programs     Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)     Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being     Global Parental Leave Policy Application and contact informationWe encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than December 6. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date.For questions about the position, please contact:Hiring Manager, Lars Bergkvist, lars.bergkvist@epiroc.comRecruitment specialist, Martin Liljeholm, martin.liljeholm@external.epiroc.com

title: DESIGN QUALITY ASSURANCE ENGINEER
description: At Permobil, we innovate for individuals, developing advanced assistive solutions that enrich the lives of adults and children living with disabilities. Our users come first, and we combine technology, clinical insights, and continuous improvement to create safe, effective, and trusted products. Join an international team where your expertise helps deliver life-changing technology. About the role As a Design Quality Assurance Engineer, you will help embed quality, safety, and regulatory compliance throughout product development - from concept to commercialization and lifecycle management. Working within cross-functional Agile Innovation teams, you will partner with Engineering, Product Owners, System Architects, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, and Regulatory teams to ensure robust design controls, risk management, verification and validation, and documentation. Key responsibilities     Execute design assurance activities in accordance with QMSR, ISO 13485, EU MDR, ISO 14971, and other applicable requirements,     Support the creation, maintenance, and organization of Design History Files (DHF) and Medical Device Files (MDF),     Develop and review clear, testable, traceable requirements based on user needs, intended use, and risk analysis,    Ensure robust design inputs, outputs, verification, and validation, providing guidance on test strategies, sampling plans, and statistical analysis,    Support risk management, including hazard analyses, FMEAs, and risk control documentation,    Integrate quality into sprint planning, backlog refinement, and design reviews, maintaining traceability, change control, and design controls within Agile development,    Provide quality oversight and regulatory-grade documentation for hardware, software, and system-level development,    Support design changes, post-market updates, lifecycle management, design transfer, and commercialization,    Improve design assurance processes, risk management practices, templates, and tools. Qualifications and skills     Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Science, or a related technical field,    Minimum 3 years of experience in medical device R&D, quality engineering, or design assurance,    Solid understanding of medical device regulations and design controls, including QMSR, ISO 13485, EU MDR, and ISO 14971,    Working knowledge of relevant standards, such as IEC 60601 and IEC 62304,    Experience with risk management, including FMEA and hazard analysis, and a strong foundation in statistics, sampling, verification, and validation,    Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global, regulated environment,    Experience in Agile teams and supporting both hardware and software development is an advantage. Who you are You are proactive, detail-oriented, and passionate about developing safe, effective, and compliant medical devices. You combine technical expertise with a pragmatic approach, enjoy solving challenges across disciplines, and continuously seek better ways of working. Above all, you are motivated by improving the lives of people who rely on our products. Why Permobil? Make a difference, make your mark, and feel welcome. Help improve lives through evidence-based innovation, collaborate across borders, and shape the future of assistive technology alongside passionate, supportive colleagues. Join a responsible business committed to sustainability and continuous improvement. Application Selection is ongoing, so submit your application today. Permobil is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals. Position enquiries: Yousef Norouzi, Director Design Assurance yousef.norouzi@permobil.com Recruitment enquiries: Zivile Mitkute, Talent Acquisition Partner zivile.mitkute@permobil.com We respectfully decline recruitment and advertising services. About Permobil Founded on Dr. Per Uddén’s belief that independence is a basic human right, Permobil has advanced rehabilitation technology for over 50 years. Our solutions include power and manual wheelchairs, seating and positioning products, and power assist. Headquartered in Sweden, Permobil is part of Patricia Industries, a subsidiary of Investor AB, with 2,000 team members across 18 countries. Learn more at permobil.com.

title: Research Ethics Compliance Officer Sensitive Data
description: Ref 2592631 \\\| Date: 23 Nov 2026 !\[EPFL\]( ) EPFL, the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne, is one of the most dynamic university campuses in Europe and ranks among the top 20 universities worldwide. The EPFL employs more than 6,500 people supporting the three main missions of the institution: education, research and innovation. The EPFL campus offers an exceptional working environment at the heart of a community of more than 17,000 people, including over 12,500 students and 4,000 researchers from more than 120 different countries. Research Ethics Compliance Officer Sensitive Data \*\*Mission\*\* The EPFL Research Office (ReO) is seeking a Research Ethics Compliance Officer to support EPFL's research community with ethics compliance and governance aspects of research projects that are within the scope of the Swiss Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the Federal Data Protection Act. This position will also support the establishment and implementation of (i) EPFL's Trusted Research Environment (TRE) "" an ISO 27001\\-certified infrastructure for the processing of sensitive data, with a focus on health\\-related data "" and (ii) the institutional biobank. The candidate is an individual with proven competence in ethics compliance related to scientific research (incl. with health\\-related data and human samples). She/he will have excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a dynamic team. \*\*Main duties and responsibilities\*\* Support EPFL principal investigators and ReO Programme Managers in ensuring ethics and regulatory compliance \* Advise researchers on the applicable ethics and regulatory framework for research involving human participants, human biological samples, and personal/sensitive data. \* Assess the applicability of the Swiss Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings (HRA) and its Ordinances, the Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP), and other Swiss or international requirements, in collaboration with Legal Affairs. \* Guide researchers through appropriate ethics approval procedures and support applications to Cantonal ethics committees. \* Review submissions for quality and completeness and support amendments, renewals and project closures. \* Act as point of contact between researchers and Cantonal ethics committees or other relevant authorities (FOPH, FOEN, etc.) and support follow\\-up on their requirements. Develop guidance documents, resources, training and awareness\\-raising initiatives \* Contribute to institutional procedures and SOPs for research involving human participants, human biological samples, and personal and sensitive data, particularly health\\-related data. \* Develop practical guidance and resources and promote good practices in human research through training and awareness\\-raising activities. Provide support on specific ethics compliance and regulatory questions \* Provide tailored advice on ethics and regulatory questions throughout the lifecycle of projects within the scope of the HRA, FADP. \* Advise on regulatory aspects of human biological sample transfers and redirect researchers to Legal Affairs and TTO for relevant agreements. \* Coordinate with Legal Affairs, TTO, DPO, Library, IT services, Biosafety officers and DSPS on cross\\-cutting regulatory matters. \* Contribute to institutional ethics compliance procedures and positions on emerging regulatory questions, in collaboration with relevant services. Provide ethics compliance input and support for the development and implementation of EPFL's institutional framework for the management of sensitive research data (focus: health\\-related data) and biological samples \* Contribute to the roadmap for EPFL's sensitive/human research data framework, in collaboration with the Institutional Coordinator Human Research Infrastructure and relevant institutional units (Legal Affairs, DPO, IT, etc.). \* Develop internal governance frameworks, workflows/SOPs, tools and guidance for the ethics/legal compliance of projects involving sensitive research data and/or biological samples. \* Ensure ethics compliance and governance requirements for EPFL's biobank infrastructure, including governance regulations, consent documentation and procedures, and certification processes ( SBP Label or ISO). \* Obtain ethics authorization for the EPFL biobank infrastructure, including preparation and submission of the application and interactions with the Cantonal Ethics Committee. Support the activities of the EPFL Human Research Ethics Committee (HREC) \* Provide regulatory and administrative support for the review and follow\\-up of research protocols involving humans that fall outside the HRA but require HREC approval. Support other tasks within the ReO/Ethics Affairs \* Maintain an institutional overview of HRA protocols where EPFL acts as sponsor, partner or participant, including authorizations, amendments, description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Responsable Conformité (100%) --- Responsable Conformité (100%) ============================== L'Office cantonal des assurances sociales est une institution autonome de droit public et constitue un pôle de compétences dans les assurances sociales du 1er pilier. Il gère et coordonne quatre régimes d'assurance : assurance\\-vieillesse et survivants, assurance\\-invalidité, allocations familiales et allocations pour perte de gain. Pour relever les défis actuels, l'OCAS est à la recherche d'un\\-e \*\*Responsable conformité\*\* (100 %) Classe de fonction 23 Au sein du domaine des services partagés et rattaché\\-e au responsable adjoint du domaine, vous avez pour mission de construire et piloter le nouveau secteur conformité de l'OCAS. Vous donnez à l'institution une vue unique de sa maîtrise en matière de gestion des risques, de contrôle interne, de qualité, de sécurité de l'information et de protection des données. Pour ce faire, vous réunissez et développez les dispositifs existants que la loi impose aux organes d'exécution du 1er pilier. Dans un contexte réglementaire exigeant et en évolution, vous priorisez selon les risques que l'institution doit maîtriser. Dans une logique de deuxième ligne de maîtrise, vous élaborez et déployez progressivement le cadre méthodologique, accompagnez la mise en œuvre par les secteurs et les domaines, qui restent responsables de leurs risques, et contrôlez l'efficacité du dispositif. Vous rendez compte de l'état de maîtrise à la direction générale et à la commission risques du conseil d'administration. Vous conduisez une équipe de deux spécialistes en sécurité de l'information et en protection des données. Ce poste s'adresse à une personnalité fédératrice et résolue, dotée d'un bon esprit de synthèse, capable de faire appliquer des exigences de maîtrise sans se substituer aux métiers. \*\*Vos différentes missions\*\* \* Construire et piloter le secteur conformité et y faire vivre une culture de travail alignée sur les valeurs et les principes directeurs de l'OCAS \* Assurer la pérennité de la vision et de l'organisation du secteur en anticiper les évolutions légales et réglementaires \* Définir le cadre de maîtrise de l'institution en matière de gestion des risques, de contrôle interne, de qualité, de sécurité de l'information et de protection des données, en accompagner la mise en œuvre par les secteurs et en contrôler l'efficacité \* Conduire et développer une équipe composée d'un chargé de la sécurité de l'information et d'un juriste spécialisé en protection des données \* Être l'interlocuteur / interlocutrice de la commission risques du conseil d'administration, de l'OFAS, de l'organe de révision et des autorités de protection des données, pour le compte de la direction générale \* Construire par étapes un système de management intégré, piloté par les risques \* Tenir la cartographie des risques et animer le réseau des répondants \* Piloter le système de contrôle interne, suivre les remédiations et prévenir la fraude \* Porter le système de management de la qualité et l'articuler avec la transformation et l'amélioration continue \* Superviser la sécurité de l'information et la protection des données, et assurer le rôle de répondant LIPAD \* Tenir le registre des prescriptions, en contrôler la mise en œuvre et assurer la veille légale et normative \* Rendre compte chaque année de l'état de maîtrise à la commission risques et tenir, pour la direction générale, la relation avec les organes de surveillance \* Gérer et développer le secteur : plan de charge, budget et engagements de service \*\*Votre profil\*\* \* Au bénéfice d'un master universitaire en droit, en économie, en gestion ou dans un domaine en lien avec l'activité, ou d'une formation ou expérience jugée équivalente \* Minimum 5 ans d'expérience dans la gestion des risques, le contrôle interne ou la conformité avec une expérience réussie de la conduite d'équipe \* Maîtrise des référentiels de gestion des risques et de contrôle interne, avec une expérience de mise en place ou de refonte d'un dispositif et de conduite du changement \* Connaissance de la LPGA, de la LAVS, de la LAI, de la LPD et de la LIPAD, un atout \* Connaissance des normes ISO 9001, 27001 et 37301, un atout \* Français : parfaite maîtrise à l'oral et à l'écrit \* Allemand (niveau B2\\), un atout \* Capacité à intégrer, à décliner et à porter une vision de la maîtrise des risques \* Aptitude à piloter le changement et à faire adhérer les domaines et secteurs \* Capacité d'analyse et de synthèse pour intégrer des paramètres complexes \* Sens de l'initiative et force de proposition pour faire évoluer le cadre de maîtrise \* Capacité à animer une équipe et un réseau transversal de répondants risques et contrôle interne \* Aptitude au reporting stratégique auprès des membres de la direction générale et du conseil d'administration \* Facilité d'adaptation, entregent et capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs internes et externes de tous niveaux \* Résistance aux tensions et caractère résolu Installateur sanitaire expérimenté \- dépannage

Cette opportunité est proposée à titre exceptionnel aux entreprises suisses clientes de JobCloud, à condition qu'elles puissent démontrer à JobCloud l'existence d'un besoin légitime de confidentialité (par exemple, pour des raisons organisationnelles ou stratégiques). Dans ce cas, le nom de l'entreprise n'apparaît pas dans l'offre d'emploi. L'entreprise est seule responsable du processus de recrutement et du respect de la réglementation en matière de protection des données. Elle révèle, à sa seule discrétion, son identité au cours du processus de recrutement.*

 

### **Installateur sanitaire expérimenté \- dépannage**

 

### **Introduction**

Une entreprise reconnue dans le domaine du sanitaire à Genève, recherche un Installateur Sanitaire spécialisé dans le dépannage. Si vous êtes passionné par votre métier et souhaitez rejoindre une équipe dynamique et professionnelle, cette opportunité est faite pour vous !

### Vos responsabilités

* Effectuer des interventions de dépannage et de maintenance sur les installations sanitaires.
* Diagnostiquer les pannes et proposer des solutions adaptées.
* Installer, réparer et entretenir les équipements sanitaires (robinetterie, chauffe\-eau, conduites, etc.).
* Assurer la maintenance d'un immeuble, et débouchage.
* Garantir un service de qualité et veiller à la satisfaction des clients.
* Respecter les normes de sécurité et les réglementations en vigueur.


### Votre profil

* Titulaire d’un CFC d'installateur sanitaire ou expérience jugée équivalente dans une entreprise suisse.
* Expérience confirmée dans le domaine du dépannage de plus de 5 ans dans la même entreprise suisse.
* Bonne connaissance des normes suisses en matière d'installations sanitaires.
* Expérience concluante dans un service 7/7 jour et 24/24h.
* Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et à gérer les priorités.
* Excellentes compétences relationnelles et sens du service client.
* Permis de conduire valable en Suisse.


### Ce que nous offrons

* Un environnement de travail dynamique et convivial.
* Des projets variés et stimulants.
* Une rémunération compétitive adaptée au marché genevois et des avantages sociaux attractifs.
* Des opportunités de formation continue et de développement professionnel.
* Un équipement moderne et des outils de qualité.


### Informations pour postuler

Si ce poste vous intéresse et que vous souhaitez rejoindre notre équipe, nous vous invitons à postuler dès maintenant. Nous avons hâte de découvrir votre candidature et de vous accompagner dans votre prochain défi professionnel.

**Candidats sans expérience de 5 ans en Suisse, s’abstenir.**

Sa mission consiste ainsi à créer de la valeur pour ses investisseurs tout en s'engageant activement pour un développement urbain responsable et tourné vers l'avenir. Vous serez également amené à :Préparer les reportings à destination de la Direction et des mandants en présentant les réalisations, écarts, risques, opportunités et décisions l’allocation du temps et des ressources, assurer le suivi des prestations réalisées et leur facturation et contribuer au suivi financier et administratif des opé à ce que l’ensemble des projets intègre les critères de durabilité de l’entreprise et respecte ses engagements en matière d’impact environnemental, social et économique. Votre profil :Formation supérieure d’architecte EPF/HES ou d’ingénieur civil EPF/HES avec une solide compréhension des enjeux techniques des projets immobiliers.Expérience d’au moins 5 ans dans le développement et la réalisation de projets immobiliers. Une expérience dans un rôle d’'AMO est un plus.Bonne connaissance du cadre réglementaire, urbanistique et administratif applicable aux projets immobiliers en Suisse. Une connaissance de la réglementation relative aux marchés publics est un plus.Bonne maîtrise des outils numériques ; une connaissance de l’environnement BIM constitue un atout.Rigueur, autonomie et excellente gestion des priorité relationnelle et capacité à coordonner efficacement les différents intervenants. title: Zero FTE Venture Builder
description: Zero FTE Venture BuilderRemote, within about two hours of Central European Time. Full-time, 12 months to start, starting as soon as you can.Our mission is to build zero-FTE companiesA zero-FTE company is one with no operational staff. AI agents handle the product, the marketing, customer support and the finances, and the only humans are on the board, where they approve the things that really matter. We believe companies like this will exist by 2030, and we want to be among the first to build them.We've spent a lot of time on the question of which businesses can run this way. Our view is that it has remarkably little to do with which AI model you use and a lot to do with the business itself, for example whether the work happens in software and how costly a mistake is. If you're curious, we wrote up the eight questions we ask in the z0 framework (https://www.zappter.com/en-us/).We build these companies on z0, which is our own platform. It isn't publicly available yet, so you'd be one of the first people outside the founding team to work with it.As for us, we're a small team in Switzerland and we come from telecom. Our customers include operators like Orange, Sunrise and freenet, and our board and advisors include former CEOs of EE, Sunrise and Vodafone Germany. The companies you build don't have to be in telecom.What you'd be doingThe ideas come from you. We're not going to hand you a list of companies to build. You bring ideas, we argue about them, and then you take one or two from zero to their first paying customers. You'll build them on z0, with agents doing most of the actual work.When a company is up and running, you stay responsible for it. That means looking at the numbers every week, taking the decisions an agent shouldn't take by itself, and stepping in when the agents get stuck. After a while you'd be looking after five to ten companies this way.We'll also ask you to tell us what went wrong each time, so that the next company takes up less of your time than the one before.What's hard about itA few things you should know before applying. Most ideas won't find customers, which means you'll be shutting down some of your own companies. Much of the daily work is finding out why an agent got something wrong and then changing the setup so it doesn't happen again, and that involves a lot less coding than people expect. Also, nobody will be giving you tasks. You'll have a goal, a budget and the platform, and you can always argue things through with one of the founders.Who we're looking for- You've finished a university degree. Work experience is nice to have but you don't need it.- You've already started something of your own and seen it through. That could be a small business, a product that has real users, or simply something you managed to sell. We care about this more than about grades.- You'd probably start a company one day anyway. With us you can start several, and you get paid a salary while you do.- You build things with AI agents every day.- You care about whether people will actually pay for what you build.- You're comfortable working in English, and your working day overlaps with Central European Time.What we offer- A salary. You're employed in your own country.- A share of the profit of the companies you build, which is written into your contract.- We pay for your tools and your model usage.- The job is remote. We like to meet up in Zürich when we can, but the job doesn't depend on it.- We start with 12 months. If your companies are running by then, we'd like you to keep going with them.How to applySend an email to careers@zappter.com with:1. Your CV2. A link to the best thing you've built or started, and a couple of lines about what happened to it3. Three companies you'd like to build with us. A few sentences each is enough: who would pay, what for, and why you think it could run without staff4. Where you live and when you could startWe're hiring now, so we read applications as they come in, and everyone gets an answer within five working days. If we think it could be a fit, we'll set up a 30-minute call with one of the founders. After that comes a paid build challenge of about a week, where you launch something small that keeps running without you, using whatever tools you want. We pay EUR 500 for the challenge whether or not we hire you, and what you build is yours. Your three ideas stay yours too, and we won't build any of them without you.
