description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Technicien de maintenance électromécanique --- Technicien de maintenance électromécanique ============================================ \*\*Rejoignez un acteur clé de la micro\\-fabrication médicale\*\* --------------------------------------------------------------- Chez Resonetics, nous repoussons les limites de la micro\\-fabrication au service des dispositifs médicaux et du diagnostic. Nos technologies de pointe permettent à nos clients d'innover et d'améliorer la vie des patients à travers le monde. Notre site de Puidoux, qui compte 150 collaborateurs, est un fournisseur stratégique de tubes métalliques et composants de haute précision destinés aux appareils médicaux. Dans un contexte de croissance et d'exigence réglementaire forte, nous renforçons notre équipe qualité. Nous recherchons un \*\*technicien de maintenance électromécanique\*\* prêt à jouer un rôle clé dans la fiabilité et la performance de nos équipements, tout en assurant leur bon fonctionnement et en accompagnant nos équipes de production au quotidien. \*\*Mission\*\* ----------- Au sein de l'équipe de la Maintenance, vous assurez la maintenance préventive et corrective des équipements de production afin de garantir leur disponibilité, leur fiabilité et leur performance. Vous participez à l'ensemble des activités du service maintenance tout en apportant une expertise particulière en électricité industrielle et en diagnostic de pannes. \*\*Vos principales responsabilités\*\* ------------------------------------ \* Réaliser les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les équipements de production. \* Diagnostiquer et dépanner les pannes électriques, mécaniques, pneumatiques et électromécaniques. \* Assurer la remise en service des équipements dans le respect des exigences sécurité, qualité et production. \* Participer à la mise à jour de la documentation technique et des schémas électriques. \* Identifier les composants défectueux ou obsolètes et rechercher des solutions de remplacement adaptées. \* Collaborer avec les fournisseurs et accompagner les prestataires externes lors de leurs interventions. \* Participer aux actions d'amélioration continue visant à améliorer la fiabilité des équipements et à réduire les temps d'arrêt. \* Assurer la traçabilité des interventions dans la GMAO. \*\*Votre profil\*\* ---------------- \* CFC d'Automaticien ou formation technique équivalente avec expérience en maintenance industrielle. \* Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en maintenance industrielle, idéalement dans un environnement réglementé (ISO 13485 ou équivalent). \* Expérience du dépannage et de la maintenance sur des équipements industriels variés, y compris des équipements anciens. \* Maîtrise du français à l'oral et à l'écrit. \* Solides connaissances en électricité industrielle et bonnes connaissances en mécanique industrielle et pneumatique. \* Connaissance d'une GMAO. \* Maîtrise de la lecture de schémas électriques et du diagnostic de pannes. \* Connaissances en automates industriels et interfaces opérateur constituant un atout. \* Autorisation OIBT art. 13 ou 15 constituant un atout. \* Personne autonome et pragmatique, dotée d'un fort esprit de terrain et d'une approche orientée vers la recherche de solutions concrètes. \*\*Ce que nous vous offrons\*\* ---------------------------- \* Un environnement industriel de haute précision, technologiquement exigeant et stimulant. \* Une forte proximité avec la production, l'ingénierie et les clients. \* Une équipe engagée et collaborative. \* Des projets variés et des interactions avec des clients et équipes internationales. \* L'opportunité de contribuer concrètement à l'amélioration et à la transformation de nos processus qualité. \* Des possibilités de développement professionnel au sein d'un groupe international en croissance. Chez Resonetics, nous valorisons l'excellence, l'engagement et l'esprit d'équipe. Si vous souhaitez contribuer à des projets innovants dans un environnement dynamique, nous serions ravis d'échanger avec vous. \*Le masculin est utilisé pour alléger le texte et inclut le féminin.\* !\[Resonetics SA\]( ) \* Resonetics SA Route de Chardonne 4 1070 Puidoux \* \[ \](\< \>) jpid2f88817jm jpit1148jm jpiy26jm

description: Get to know ClimeworksClimeworks is a leading high-quality carbon removal provider, combining decades of expertise in Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology with a holistic approach to carbon removal solutions.Climeworks advises companies on their carbon removal strategies and provides tailored portfolios of nature-based and engineered approaches, offering end-to-end services to help achieve net-zero goals. title: Research Ethics Compliance Officer Sensitive Data
description: Ref 2592631 \\\| Date: 23 Nov 2026 !\[EPFL\]( ) EPFL, the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne, is one of the most dynamic university campuses in Europe and ranks among the top 20 universities worldwide. The EPFL employs more than 6,500 people supporting the three main missions of the institution: education, research and innovation. The EPFL campus offers an exceptional working environment at the heart of a community of more than 17,000 people, including over 12,500 students and 4,000 researchers from more than 120 different countries. Research Ethics Compliance Officer Sensitive Data \*\*Mission\*\* The EPFL Research Office (ReO) is seeking a Research Ethics Compliance Officer to support EPFL's research community with ethics compliance and governance aspects of research projects that are within the scope of the Swiss Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the Federal Data Protection Act. This position will also support the establishment and implementation of (i) EPFL's Trusted Research Environment (TRE) "" an ISO 27001\\-certified infrastructure for the processing of sensitive data, with a focus on health\\-related data "" and (ii) the institutional biobank. The candidate is an individual with proven competence in ethics compliance related to scientific research (incl. with health\\-related data and human samples). She/he will have excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a dynamic team. \*\*Main duties and responsibilities\*\* Support EPFL principal investigators and ReO Programme Managers in ensuring ethics and regulatory compliance \* Advise researchers on the applicable ethics and regulatory framework for research involving human participants, human biological samples, and personal/sensitive data. \* Assess the applicability of the Swiss Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings (HRA) and its Ordinances, the Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP), and other Swiss or international requirements, in collaboration with Legal Affairs. \* Guide researchers through appropriate ethics approval procedures and support applications to Cantonal ethics committees. \* Review submissions for quality and completeness and support amendments, renewals and project closures. \* Act as point of contact between researchers and Cantonal ethics committees or other relevant authorities (FOPH, FOEN, etc.) and support follow\\-up on their requirements. Develop guidance documents, resources, training and awareness\\-raising initiatives \* Contribute to institutional procedures and SOPs for research involving human participants, human biological samples, and personal and sensitive data, particularly health\\-related data. \* Develop practical guidance and resources and promote good practices in human research through training and awareness\\-raising activities. Provide support on specific ethics compliance and regulatory questions \* Provide tailored advice on ethics and regulatory questions throughout the lifecycle of projects within the scope of the HRA, FADP. \* Advise on regulatory aspects of human biological sample transfers and redirect researchers to Legal Affairs and TTO for relevant agreements. \* Coordinate with Legal Affairs, TTO, DPO, Library, IT services, Biosafety officers and DSPS on cross\\-cutting regulatory matters. \* Contribute to institutional ethics compliance procedures and positions on emerging regulatory questions, in collaboration with relevant services. Provide ethics compliance input and support for the development and implementation of EPFL's institutional framework for the management of sensitive research data (focus: health\\-related data) and biological samples \* Contribute to the roadmap for EPFL's sensitive/human research data framework, in collaboration with the Institutional Coordinator Human Research Infrastructure and relevant institutional units (Legal Affairs, DPO, IT, etc.). \* Develop internal governance frameworks, workflows/SOPs, tools and guidance for the ethics/legal compliance of projects involving sensitive research data and/or biological samples. \* Ensure ethics compliance and governance requirements for EPFL's biobank infrastructure, including governance regulations, consent documentation and procedures, and certification processes ( SBP Label or ISO). \* Obtain ethics authorization for the EPFL biobank infrastructure, including preparation and submission of the application and interactions with the Cantonal Ethics Committee. Support the activities of the EPFL Human Research Ethics Committee (HREC) \* Provide regulatory and administrative support for the review and follow\\-up of research protocols involving humans that fall outside the HRA but require HREC approval. Support other tasks within the ReO/Ethics Affairs \* Maintain an institutional overview of HRA protocols where EPFL acts as sponsor, partner or participant, including authorizations, amendments, renewals and closures. \* Collaborate with relevant internal services on cross\\-cutting ethics compliance and regulatory matters. \* Support other Ethics Affairs activities as required. \*\*Profile\*\* \* Master's degree in a relevant field, such as law (specialization human research), public health, life sciences, biomedical sciences or related field (additional certifications and licenses in relation to ethics compliance, biobanking and data protection will be considered a strong asset). \* Solid knowledge and expertise about the ethics compliance framework and of the ethics compliance and governance requirements in Switzerland (Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the Federal Data Protection Act (FADP) and their application). \* Knowledge about management of human biological samples, human subjects/clinical research data, clinical trials, and biobanks. \* Extensive experience with the preparation and submission of ethics applications to the Cantonal Ethics Committees. \* Ability to analyse and understand research projects in relation to the Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the FADP. \* Ability to explain the ethics compliance regulations on research involving humans, personal/sensitive data, biological samples, etc. to researchers who are not necessarily familiar with this area of work. \* Experience in preparing and developing ethics compliance related guidance documents and tools/resources for a broad audience. \* Excellent collaboration skills to conduct joint projects and to liaise with internal and external stakeholders (such as legal affairs, cantonal ethics commissions, etc.). \* Good organization skills, and the ability to set priorities and meet deadlines. \* The ability to work both independently and in a team, and to adapt to the individual needs of EPFL principal investigators. \* Excellent collaboration skills to conduct joint projects and to liaise with internal and external stakeholders (such as legal affairs, DPO, IT, Cantonal ethics commissions, etc.). \* Strong writing, editing and proofreading skills in English. \*\*We offer\*\* \* A dynamic and cosmopolitan work environment in a multidisciplinary institution. \* Competitive salary, remote working may be possible for a portion of the time. \* The opportunity of continuous training and development according to the requirements of the function. At EPFL, we believe that people achieve great results when they feel supported, respected and enabled to succeed. By joining our community, you will help shape the future of society through education, research and innovation. We offer an inspiring, international and collaborative environment where your work has real impact and your ideas are valued. Combined with flexible ways of working and attractive employment conditions, we aim to create an environment where everyone can contribute, grow and make a difference. Beyond work, our campuses host a vibrant community and unique environment, enriched by initiatives promoting equality, inclusion, diversity, well\\-being and sustainability as well as an engaging program of cultural, sports and community activities throughout the year. \[Read about our employment conditions and employee benefits\](\< \> " ") \*\*Informations\*\* Contract Start Date : Activity Rate Min : Activity Rate Max : Contract Type: CDD Duration: one year Reference: 2606 jpid4c643c1jm jpit1148jm jpiy26jm

Il gère et coordonne quatre régimes d'assurance : assurance\\-vieillesse et survivants, assurance\\-invalidité, allocations familiales et allocations pour perte de gain. Pour relever les défis actuels, l'OCAS est à la recherche d'un\\-e \*\*Responsable conformité\*\* (100 %) Classe de fonction 23 Au sein du domaine des services partagés et rattaché\\-e au responsable adjoint du domaine, vous avez pour mission de construire et piloter le nouveau secteur conformité de l'OCAS. Vous donnez à l'institution une vue unique de sa maîtrise en matière de gestion des risques, de contrôle interne, de qualité, de sécurité de l'information et de protection des données. Pour ce faire, vous réunissez et développez les dispositifs existants que la loi impose aux organes d'exécution du 1er pilier. Dans un contexte réglementaire exigeant et en évolution, vous priorisez selon les risques que l'institution doit maîtriser. Dans une logique de deuxième ligne de maîtrise, vous élaborez et déployez progressivement le cadre méthodologique, accompagnez la mise en œuvre par les secteurs et les domaines, qui restent responsables de leurs risques, et contrôlez l'efficacité du dispositif. Vous rendez compte de l'état de maîtrise à la direction générale et à la commission risques du conseil d'administration. Vous conduisez une équipe de deux spécialistes en sécurité de l'information et en protection des données. Ce poste s'adresse à une personnalité fédératrice et résolue, dotée d'un bon esprit de synthèse, capable de faire appliquer des exigences de maîtrise sans se substituer aux métiers. \*\*Vos différentes missions\*\* \* Construire et piloter le secteur conformité et y faire vivre une culture de travail alignée sur les valeurs et les principes directeurs de l'OCAS \* Assurer la pérennité de la relation avec les organes de surveillance \* Gérer et développer le secteur : plan de charge, budget et engagements de service \*\*Votre profil\*\* \* Au bénéfice d'un master universitaire en interne ou la conformité avec une expérience réussie de la conduite d'équipe \* Maîtrise des référentiels de gestion des risques et de contrôle interne, avec une expérience de mise en place ou de refonte d'un dispositif et de conduite du changement \* Connaissance de la LPGA, de la LAVS, de la LAI, de la LPD et de la LIPAD, un atout \* Connaissance des normes ISO 9001, 27001 et 37301, un atout cadre de maîtrise \* Capacité à animer une équipe et un réseau transversal de répondants risques et contrôle interne \* Aptitude au reporting stratégique auprès des membres de la direction générale et du conseil d'administration \* Facilité d'adaptation, entregent et capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs internes et externes de tous niveaux \* Résistance aux tensions et caractère résolu description: # AI Architect**Location** · Zurich, Switzerland## About the RoleWe’re looking for an AI Architect to lead the technical strategy for AI across our products and internal systems. You’ll turn business priorities into architecture decisions and guide AI initiatives from use case definition through to production. Your focus will be on building secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud solutions that teams can operate and maintain.You’ll work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, software architects, product leaders, and executives to set technical direction, explain trade-offs, and guide delivery.## Key Responsibilities### Architecture and strategy- Design end-to-end AI and ML architectures covering data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.- Define the enterprise AI roadmap, reference architectures, and technology standards.- Lead build-versus-buy assessments for foundation models, open-source models, and vendor platforms.### Cloud architecture- Design and lead the delivery of cloud-native AI solutions on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud using managed AI services and scalable infrastructure.- Define cloud landing zones, networking, identity and access management, and security patterns for AI workloads.- Develop hybrid or multi-cloud strategies where appropriate, taking data residency into account.- Optimize cloud cost and performance through FinOps practices, including GPU capacity planning and autoscaling.### Generative AI and large language models- Design applications that use large language models (LLMs), including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, tool integration, and fine-tuning.- Define evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and monitoring for model quality, safety, latency, and cost.- Evaluate model and retrieval performance against business use cases and establish standards for managing prompts, context, and models.### ML platforms and MLOps- Lead the design of scalable ML platforms, including feature stores, vector databases, model registries, CI/CD pipelines, and inference infrastructure.- Design production AI systems for reliability, scalability, and disaster recovery.### Governance, security, and responsible AI- Embed security, privacy, and responsible AI principles into solution design. Work with legal and compliance teams to address applicable requirements and assurance standards.- Define standards for bias testing, explainability, auditability, and data governance.- Partner with legal, security, and risk teams to develop and implement AI policies.### Technical leadership and collaboration- Align business stakeholders, engineering teams, vendors, and cloud providers on architecture decisions and delivery priorities.- Mentor ML engineers, data scientists, and software teams.- Explain AI capabilities, risks, and trade-offs to executives and non-technical stakeholders.- Produce and review technical documentation, architecture decision records, and presentations.- Lead architecture reviews, proofs of concept, and vendor evaluations.- Follow developments in AI research, tools, and industry practices to inform technology decisions.## Required Experience and Technical Skills- **8+ years in software or data engineering**, including **4+ years designing and delivering production AI or ML solutions**.- **5+ years of hands-on cloud experience**, with deep expertise in at least one major platform and its AI services, such as AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure AI and Azure OpenAI Service, or Google Cloud Vertex AI.- Proven experience designing cloud-native systems using serverless services, containers, Docker, Kubernetes, networking, identity and access management, and security best practices.- Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep, and with managing cloud costs.- Deep understanding of machine learning, deep learning, large language models, and generative AI techniques.- Hands-on Python experience with tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face libraries, and experience with LangChain or LlamaIndex.- Proven MLOps experience, including CI/CD, model monitoring, and workflow orchestration.- Strong knowledge of data architecture, including data lakes and warehouses, streaming, vector databases, and ETL/ELT pipelines.- Experience designing secure, scalable distributed systems and APIs.- Strong communication, stakeholder management, and technical documentation skills.## Preferred Qualifications- Professional cloud certifications in architecture, AI, or machine learning from AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.- Experience designing hybrid or multi-cloud architectures and leading cloud migrations.- Experience building multi-agent systems and agentic AI architectures.- Familiarity with model adaptation and optimization techniques such as LoRA, RLHF, distillation, and quantization, and with inference tools such as vLLM or TensorRT.- Experience in regulated environments such as financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, or government.- Published research, patents, or open-source contributions.## Key Competencies- Systems thinking and sound architectural judgment.- Ability to work effectively across functions and cultures.- Practical judgment when balancing innovation, delivery, cost, and risk.- Ownership and sound decision-making when requirements are still evolving.- Ability to influence decisions without direct authority.- Commitment to ethical and responsible AI.

description:

HR Business Partner
===================

**The company**

The Swatch Group Services Ltd. is a dynamic company of the Swatch Group providing high quality services to the Group organizations worldwide in the fields of Logistics, Customer Services, Quality Management Real Estate \& Gems. The company belongs to the Swatch Group, the world's largest watch maker with a portfolio of 16 brands of which Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak.

Swatch Group Services offers a unique ecosystem where people can accomplish their goals and achieve their aspirations. To strengthen our HR team, we are offering an exciting opportunity based between Biel (60%) and Neuchâtel (40%), with flexibility to discuss the allocation. We are currently looking for an:

**HR Business Partner (100%)**

**Job description**

In this role, you will manage the complete employee life cycle and support our managers as a coach and consultant, helping them guide their teams toward success. Your mission? Build a great work environment, solve challenges with style, and contribute to the vibrant culture of our company.

**Profile**

**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Act as the main point of contact for employees and managers (\>150 employees)
* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment and staffing for The Swatch Group Services in the fields of Logistics, Customer Services, Quality Management, Real Estate as well as for the Group's companies based in Neuchâtel.
* Be a partner with managers to analyse needs and select top talent.
* Negotiate offers, prepare contracts, and ensure smooth onboarding \& offboarding.
* Provide guidance on employee relations, performance topics, and change initiatives.
* Support managers in handling discussions, resolving issues, and navigating team conflicts.
* Organise and control of the yearly evaluation and talent management process, and follow\-up with measures if needed.
* Follow up on development needs and action plans.
* Handle warnings and contract terminations.


At Swatch Group Services, we value fresh ideas, especially in areas like employer branding, employee retention \& HR process optimization, to keep improving our quality standards and elevating the employee experience.

**Professional requirements**

* University degree in HR or equivalent (Brevet fédéral) with over 5 years of experience in a similar role.
* You are a natural networker, collaborate efficiently with everybody and you build a trustful relationship at all levels and be regarded as a trusted partner.
* You get a strong experience in Recruitment ideally in the Supply Chain field. Hands on in sourcing.
* You have an excellent consultative and client service skill with the ability to effectively influence and manage key relationships with a strong knowledge of Swiss law.
* Autonomous and self\-motivated, with initiative and an ability to manage multiple priorities with a sense of urgency.
* You are data driven as well as highly organized: You have a very structured way of working, being able to prioritize a variety of complex tasks and to complete them diligently


**You're missing one or two skills in the list, yet you're eager to learn?  
It's perfectly OK. We like to share.**

**Languages**

Now, in order to blend in, socially and professionally, we certainly recommend the following languages:

* Fluent in French and in English, combined with good knowledge of German considered an asset.
* Any other languages are welcome \- we have 29 so far in the company, if you wish to add the 30th, you pretty much know what to do


**Company address**

**Contact**

A dynamic and evolving work environment, complemented by attractive benefits:

* Continuous training to support your professional development
* Career growth opportunities through our internal mobility policy
* 5 to 6 weeks of vacation per year, depending on your age and/or position
* A 40\-hour work week, in line with the collective labor agreement (CCT)
* Competitive salary and excellent social benefits
* Parental leave: up to 3 weeks for the other parent and 19 weeks for mothers
* On\-site company restaurant with employer financial contribution
* Exclusive discounts on Swatch Group products and with our partners
* Sports activities and internal events to foster team spirit
* Contribution to health insurance costs


Ready to debug your career and deploy your next challenge? ? Apply now ?  
Just a quick note from our sysadmin: to keep things clean and green , we only accept applications through our website.

Aline Huguenin

title: Senior Storage & Data Engineer
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Senior Storage &amp; Data Engineer--- Senior Storage \& Data Engineer===============================Senior Storage \& Data Engineer===============================**The Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS)** develops and operates a high\-performance computing and data research infrastructure that supports world\-class science in Switzerland. Its user laboratory is available to domestic and international researchers in academia, industry, and the business sector. The centre is operated by ETH Zurich and has offices at its data centre in Lugano and in Zurich.For this position the work location is either Lugano or Zürich. The contract is for two years.Project background------------------Storing petabytes is the easy part. The hard part is everything between the moment data lands on disk and the moment a researcher — or a training job — can actually trust it, find it, and use it.  Our parallel filesystems and object stores already move data fast. What they don't do on their own is tell a scientist where a dataset came from, which transformations produced it, whether it's the version that backed last quarter's published result, or how to feed it to a DataLoader without saturating the I/O subsystem. That gap — between raw bytes and usable, traceable, reproducible data — is where this role lives.  You'll work at both ends: the storage layer (throughput, integrity, tiering at multi\-petabyte scale) and the data layer above it (lineage, provenance, discoverability, access patterns). If you've ever been annoyed that *"the data is on the cluster"* gets treated as the end of the job rather than the start of it, read on.description-----------* **Bridge ingestion and use.** Design the pipelines and metadata that turn ingested data into something findable and consumable — catalogs, schemas, and access layers that match how training jobs and simulations actually read, not just where bytes sit.* **Make data traceable.** Build lineage and provenance so any dataset, checkpoint, or result can be traced back to its inputs and transformations. Reproducibility is a first\-class requirement here, not a retrofit.* **Tune for the workload.** Optimise parallel filesystems (Lustre, GPFS) and object storage for the concurrency, small\-file, and large\-checkpoint patterns of distributed GPU training and HPC simulation.* **Operate at scale, safely.** Design and run multi\-petabyte storage with the integrity and availability scientific work depends on — erasure coding, redundancy, hot\-to\-archival tiering.* **Automate everything.** Deploy and scale storage and data services as code. Snowflake infrastructure doesn't survive at this scale.* **Make it observable.** Instrument storage health, capacity trends, and pipeline performance so problems surface before users feel them.* **Translate.** Turn real access patterns from domain scientists and ML engineers into technical requirements — and push back when a request would quietly break something downstream.For a project in the weather and climate domain, aimed at understanding and mitigating the impact of climate change, an opening for **two years** is available.The initial two\-year contract could potentially be extended or even become permanent.Profile-------* A technical degree (CS, engineering) **or** equivalent experience that demonstrates the same depth.* Solid storage grounding: filesystems (block and object), performance tuning, redundancy (RAID, erasure coding).* , and comfort automating infrastructure (Ansible, Terraform, or similar).* A working understanding of how ML and scientific workloads consume data — billions of small files, large checkpoints, sharding — and why naive layouts fall over.* A point of view on data lineage, provenance, or reproducibility — and ideally tooling you've used to enforce it.**What helps you stand out*** Hands\-on parallel filesystems (Lustre, Spectrum Scale/GPFS) or distributed storage (Ceph, VAST).* Scientific data formats — HDF5, Zarr, Parquet — and opinions on when each earns its place.* Object storage (S3\) interfaced with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).* Orchestration (Kubernetes, Argo) and data\-movement tooling.* Data versioning / cataloguing (e.g. DVC, lakeFS, a metadata catalog) and familiarity with FAIR data principles.* CI/CD and provisioning: GitLab CI, HashiCorp Vault, MAAS.We don't expect every box ticked. Depth in storage *or* data engineering, plus the curiosity to grow into the other, matters more than a complete checklist.**What you get*** Hardware and scale you won't find in enterprise IT — and problems with no vendor playbook.* Work that directly enables published science and frontier\-scale model training.* Room to shape how data is *managed*, not just maintained, in an environment that takes it seriously.**Our core values as guiding principles:*** Curiosity: You enjoy learning and understanding systems deeply* Openness: You collaborate effectively and value different perspectives* Courage: You are willing to tackle difficult or unfamiliar problems* Supportive: You help colleagues and users succeed* Integrity: You act responsibly, reliably, and transparentlyWe offer--------We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive engineering team and particularly encourage applications from groups underrepresented in tech. If you are technically adept, curious, and eager to grow, we want to hear from you.* Your job with impact: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive change in society* You can expect , such as public transport season tickets and car sharing, a wide range of sports offered by the , and attractive* You can look forward to an exciting working environment, cultural diversity and attractive offers and benefits.* We value the diversity of our team and, to further enhance the diversity of our workforce, we particularly encourage women to apply.We value diversity and sustainability-------------------------------------In line with , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a .Curious? So are we.-------------------Please include the following documents with your application:* Motivation letter in pdf* CV in pdf* Relevant certificates and diplomas in pdf formatWe look forward to receiving your online application, including a letter of motivation, CV, diplomas, and employment certificates. Please address your application to Mrs Frequente, CSCS Human Resources, Via Trevano 131, 6900 Lugano.Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.Further information about CSCS can be found on our . Questions regarding the position should be directed to Pim Witlox, witlox@ (no applications).For recruitment services, the apply.About ETH Zürich-----------------ETH Zurich is one of the world’s leading universities specialising in science and technology. We are renowned for our excellent education, cutting\-edge fundamental research and direct transfer of new knowledge into society. Over 30,000 people from more than 120 countries find our university to be a place that promotes independent thinking and an environment that inspires excellence. Located in the heart of Europe, yet forging connections all over the world, we work together to develop solutions for the global challenges of today and tomorrow.![ETH Zürich]()* ETH Zürich  Culmannstrasse 8  8006 Zürich*jid7d6273ajm jit1148jm jiy26jm

description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: INFIRMIER/ERE CLINICIEN/NE SPÉCIALISÉ/E (ICLS) --- INFIRMIER/ERE CLINICIEN/NE SPÉCIALISÉ/E (ICLS) ================================================ Pour renforcer notre pôle santé et soutenir le développement des pratiques et compétences cliniques au sein de nos établissements médico\\-sociaux (EMS) et de notre Service d'aide et de soins à domicile de la Broye (SASDB), nous recherchons un/e \*\*INFIRMIER/ERE CLINICIEN/NE SPÉCIALISÉ/E (ICLS)\*\* \*\*60\\-80%\*\* \*\*Mission/tâches\*\* •Vous exercez une pratique infirmière avancée auprès des résidents des EMS, des bénéficiaires des soins à domicile et de leurs proches, en apportant une expertise clinique spécialisée dans les situations complexes, instables ou à risque. •Vous réalisez des évaluations cliniques approfondies, formulez des recommandations et accompagnez les équipes dans la définition et l'adaptation des interventions de soins. •Vous contribuez à l'amélioration continue de la qualité, de la sécurité et de la continuité des soins, en favorisant des pratiques professionnelles harmonisées et fondées sur les données probantes. •Vous soutenez le développement des compétences cliniques des équipes, notamment par l'accompagnement des professionnels, l'analyse des pratiques et la mise en œuvre d'actions de formation en collaboration avec le service de formation du RSSBF. •Vous participez à l'élaboration, à l'actualisation et à l'implantation de référentiels et d'outils cliniques communs, adaptés aux spécificités des EMS et des soins à domicile. •Vous collaborez étroitement avec les responsables des entités, les médecins et les partenaires du réseau socio\\-sanitaire afin de favoriser la coordination des parcours et la continuité des prises en charge. •Vous contribuez aux projets d'amélioration des pratiques, à l'évaluation de la qualité des soins et au transfert des connaissances issues de la recherche dans la pratique quotidienne. \*\*Profil souhaité\*\* •Bachelor HES en soins infirmiers ou titre jugé équivalent, complété par un Master of Science en sciences infirmières (MScSI). •Expérience clinique infirmière d'au moins trois ans, avec une pratique confirmée dans la prise en charge de situations complexes. •Expérience dans le domaine des EMS ou des soins à domicile souhaitée. Une connaissance des deux environnements constitue un atout. •Excellentes compétences en raisonnement clinique avancé, en analyse critique des données scientifiques et en évaluation des pratiques professionnelles. •Aptitudes reconnues dans l'accompagnement pédagogique des équipes, le développement des compétences et la conduite de projets cliniques. •Capacité à travailler de manière transversale et interprofessionnelle, avec une posture collaborative, un sens aigu de l'éthique et d'excellentes qualités relationnelles. •Très bonne maîtrise du français, à l'oral comme à l'écrit, et aisance avec les outils informatiques et les dossiers de soins informatisés. •Connaissance du réseau socio\\-sanitaire fribourgeois souhaitée et disponibilité pour intervenir sur les différents sites du RSSBF ainsi qu'à domicile. \*\*Nous offrons\*\* •Un poste transversal, diversifié et stimulant, vous permettant de valoriser votre expertise clinique et de contribuer directement à la qualité des soins au sein des EMS et des soins à domicile. •Un environnement professionnel collaboratif, favorisant l'autonomie, l'innovation, le partage des connaissances et le développement des pratiques infirmières avancées. •La possibilité de jouer un rôle actif dans le développement des compétences des équipes, l'harmonisation des pratiques et la réalisation de projets cliniques à l'échelle du pôle santé. •Des conditions salariales et sociales modernes. \*\*Renseignements\*\* Monsieur Laurent Bourgeois, Directeur des soins: \*\*Délai de postulation: 9 décembre 2026\*\* !\[Réseau Santé Social de la Broye Fribourgeoise (RSSBF)\]( ) \* Réseau Santé Social de la Broye Fribourgeoise (RSSBF) Rue Centrale 57 1776 Montagny\\-la\\-Ville \* \[ \](\< \>) jpidc24a538jm jpit1148jm jpiy26jm

title: Research Ethics Compliance Officer Sensitive Data
description: Ref 2592631 \\\| Date: 23 Nov 2026 !\[EPFL\]( ) EPFL, the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne, is one of the most dynamic university campuses in Europe and ranks among the top 20 universities worldwide. The EPFL employs more than 6,500 people supporting the three main missions of the institution: education, research and innovation. The EPFL campus offers an exceptional working environment at the heart of a community of more than 17,000 people, including over 12,500 students and 4,000 researchers from more than 120 different countries. Research Ethics Compliance Officer Sensitive Data \*\*Mission\*\* The EPFL Research Office (ReO) is seeking a Research Ethics Compliance Officer to support EPFL's research community with ethics compliance and governance aspects of research projects that are within the scope of the Swiss Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the Federal Data Protection Act. This position will also support the establishment and implementation of (i) EPFL's Trusted Research Environment (TRE) "" an ISO 27001\\-certified infrastructure for the processing of sensitive data, with a focus on health\\-related data "" and (ii) the institutional biobank. The candidate is an individual with proven competence in ethics compliance related to scientific research (incl. with health\\-related data and human samples). She/he will have excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a dynamic team. \*\*Main duties and responsibilities\*\* Support EPFL principal investigators and ReO Programme Managers in ensuring ethics and regulatory compliance \* Advise researchers on the applicable ethics and regulatory framework for research involving human participants, human biological samples, and personal/sensitive data. \* Assess the applicability of the Swiss Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings (HRA) and its Ordinances, the Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP), and other Swiss or international requirements, in collaboration with Legal Affairs. \* Guide researchers through appropriate ethics approval procedures and support applications to Cantonal ethics committees. \* Review submissions for quality and completeness and support amendments, renewals and project closures. \* Act as point of contact between researchers and Cantonal ethics committees or other relevant authorities (FOPH, FOEN, etc.) and support follow\\-up on their requirements. Develop guidance documents, resources, training and awareness\\-raising initiatives \* Contribute to institutional procedures and SOPs for research involving human participants, human biological samples, and personal and sensitive data, particularly health\\-related data. \* Develop practical guidance and resources and promote good practices in human research through training and awareness\\-raising activities. Provide support on specific ethics compliance and regulatory questions \* Provide tailored advice on ethics and regulatory questions throughout the lifecycle of projects within the scope of the HRA, FADP. \* Advise on regulatory aspects of human biological sample transfers and redirect researchers to Legal Affairs and TTO for relevant agreements. \* Coordinate with Legal Affairs, TTO, DPO, Library, IT services, Biosafety officers and DSPS on cross\\-cutting regulatory matters. \* Contribute to institutional ethics compliance procedures and positions on emerging regulatory questions, in collaboration with relevant services. Provide ethics compliance input and support for the development and implementation of EPFL's institutional framework for the management of sensitive research data (focus: health\\-related data) and biological samples \* Contribute to the roadmap for EPFL's sensitive/human research data framework, in collaboration with the Institutional Coordinator Human Research Infrastructure and relevant institutional units (Legal Affairs, DPO, IT, etc.). \* Develop internal governance frameworks, workflows/SOPs, tools and guidance for the ethics/legal compliance of projects involving sensitive research data and/or biological samples. \* Ensure ethics compliance and governance requirements for EPFL's biobank infrastructure, including governance regulations, consent documentation and procedures, and certification processes ( SBP Label or ISO). \* Obtain ethics authorization for the EPFL biobank infrastructure, including preparation and submission of the application and interactions with the Cantonal Ethics Committee. Support the activities of the EPFL Human Research Ethics Committee (HREC) \* Provide regulatory and administrative support for the review and follow\\-up of research protocols involving humans that fall outside the HRA but require HREC approval. Support other tasks within the ReO/Ethics Affairs \* Maintain an institutional overview of HRA protocols where EPFL acts as sponsor, partner or participant, including authorizations, amendments, renewals and closures. \* Collaborate with relevant internal services on cross\\-cutting ethics compliance and regulatory matters. \* Support other Ethics Affairs activities as required. \*\*Profile\*\* \* Master's degree in a relevant field, such as law (specialization human research), public health, life sciences, biomedical sciences or related field (additional certifications and licenses in relation to ethics compliance, biobanking and data protection will be considered a strong asset). \* Solid knowledge and expertise about the ethics compliance framework and of the ethics compliance and governance requirements in Switzerland (Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the Federal Data Protection Act (FADP) and their application). \* Knowledge about management of human biological samples, human subjects/clinical research data, clinical trials, and biobanks. \* Extensive experience with the preparation and submission of ethics applications to the Cantonal Ethics Committees. \* Ability to analyse and understand research projects in relation to the Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the FADP. \* Ability to explain the ethics compliance regulations on research involving humans, personal/sensitive data, biological samples, etc. to researchers who are not necessarily familiar with this area of work. \* Experience in preparing and developing ethics compliance related guidance documents and tools/resources for a broad audience. \* Excellent collaboration skills to conduct joint projects and to liaise with internal and external stakeholders (such as legal affairs, cantonal ethics commissions, etc.). \* Good organization skills, and the ability to set priorities and meet deadlines. \* The ability to work both independently and in a team, and to adapt to the individual needs of EPFL principal investigators. \* Excellent collaboration skills to conduct joint projects and to liaise with internal and external stakeholders (such as legal affairs, DPO, IT, Cantonal ethics commissions, etc.). \* Strong writing, editing and proofreading skills in English. \*\*We offer\*\* \* A dynamic and cosmopolitan work environment in a multidisciplinary institution. \* Competitive salary, remote working may be possible for a portion of the time. \* The opportunity of continuous training and development according to the requirements of the function. At EPFL, we believe that people achieve great results when they feel supported, respected and enabled to succeed. By joining our community, you will help shape the future of society through education, research and innovation. We offer an inspiring, international and collaborative environment where your work has real impact and your ideas are valued. Combined with flexible ways of working and attractive employment conditions, we aim to create an environment where everyone can contribute, grow and make a difference. Beyond work, our campuses host a vibrant community and unique environment, enriched by initiatives promoting equality, inclusion, diversity, well\\-being and sustainability as well as an engaging program of cultural, sports and community activities throughout the year. \[Read about our employment conditions and employee benefits\](\< \> " ") \*\*Informations\*\* Contract Start Date : Activity Rate Min : Activity Rate Max : Contract Type: CDD Duration: one year Reference: 2606 jpid4c643c1jm jpit1148jm jpiy26jm

Boursier·ère adjoint·e
=========================

La Municipalité d’Echandens met au concours un poste en contrat à durée indéterminée (CDI) de :  

**Boursier·ère adjoint·e (taux 80\-100 %)**  

**Missions principales :**  

•La facturation des diverses prestations (taxes, émoluments, impôts communaux, etc.)  
•Assurer le suivi de la correspondance du service  
•La gestion du contentieux (procédures de poursuites et faillites)  
•La tenue à jour des rôles des contribuables et des propriétaires  
•Gestion du registre des entreprises  
•Etablir les décomptes TVA  
•Coordination et collaboration avec les autres services pour les facturations spécifiques  
•Toute autre tâche administrative pouvant relever de la compétence de la Municipalité ou de la bourse communale  

**En soutien ou en suppléance du boursier titulaire :**  

•Assurer le bon fonctionnement de la bourse communale en termes de stratégie, de lignes directrices, de planification et de respect du cadre légal  
•Gestion et tenue de la comptabilité communale (budget, comptes, investissements, trésorerie et bouclements)  
•Elaboration de l’arrêté d’imposition et du taux d’escompte  
•Organiser et accompagner le contrôle annuel des comptes  
•Organiser et accompagner l’élaboration du budget annuel (y compris coordination avec les autres services et la Municipalité)  
•Etablir des analyses et des projections financières  
•La gestion des salaires  

**Votre profil :**  

•Certificat fédéral de capacité (CFC) d’employé·e de commerce avec expérience de comptable ou formation équivalente  
•Expérience professionnelle d’au minimum 5 ans dans le domaine. Expérience dans une collectivité publique souhaitée  
•Connaissance du plan comptable des communes (MCH2\) souhaitée  
•Connaissance des lois, règlement et directives cantonales et communales relatives au domaine d’application du service souhaitée  
•Nationalité Suisse ou Autorisation d'établissement (permis C)  
•Capacité à agir et à collaborer de manière transversale  
•Jouir d'une bonne réputation, d’autonomie, de gestion organisationnelle, d’esprit méthodique, de rigueur, de discrétion, d’initiative et précision d’exécution  
•Orientation client et sens du service publique  
•Excellente maîtrise du français et aisance rédactionnelle  
•Maîtrise des outils bureautiques courants et de gestion financière  
•Casier judiciaire et extrait du registre des poursuites vierges  

**Entrée en fonction** : 1er mars ou à convenir.

Sa mission consiste à développer et superviser le cyclisme sous toutes ses formes et pour tout le monde, en tant que sport de compétition, activité de loisir saine, et moyen de transport et de s’amuser. L’UCI assure par ailleurs la promotion de ses propres événements, notamment des Championnats du Monde Route UCI, manifestation annuelle emblématique, et d’un grand nombre d’autres Championnats du Monde et Coupes du Monde dans les différentes disciplines. Son siège se trouve à Aigle, en Suisse, au Centre Mondial du Cyclisme UCI. L’UCI est à la recherche d’un(e) : Marketing \& Commercial Manager (100%) Anglais – çais======================================================== **Mission:**Sous la supervision du Directeur Communication, Marketing, Médias et RSE, le/la Marketing \& Commercial Manager dirige la division Marketing and Commercial, qui réunit les partenariats, le servicing partenaires et le développement commercial de l’UCI. Il/elle est responsable de la conception, du suivi de la commercialisation et du pilotage des agences commerciales, de la livraison des packages marketing et sponsoring, , ainsi que de la stratégie merchandising et licensing de l’organisation.Il/elle joue un rôle clé dans la livraison des Championnats du Monde UCI et garantit la livraison optimale des engagements partenaires sur l’ensemble de nos Championnats du Monde. Il/elle développe et contribue à l’innovation digitale et au fan engagement, et entretient une relation de confiance avec les partenaires tout au long de l’année.  **Principales responsabilités**:* agences commerciales mandatées par l’UCI : objectifs, suivi des prospects, des négociations et du reporting.  * Superviser l’activité commerciale de l’UCI et du Centre Mondial du Cyclisme UCI.  * Concevoir, mettre à jour et commercialiser les packages marketing et sponsoring (droits marketing, hospitalités, activations, digital).  * Mener les négociations de nouveaux contrats et les renégociations des contrats existants.  * Identifier des opportunités innovantes de revenus et proposer de nouveaux concepts marketing.  * Être l’interlocuteur(trice) principal(e) des partenaires : coordination, réunions, communication et événements corporate.  * Superviser la livraison de toutes les contreparties marketing et activations sur les événements, en lien avec l’équipe Digital pour les activations digitales.  * Développer des initiatives dépassant le cadre contractuel pour renforcer la valeur partenariale et fidéliser les partenaires.  * Définir et valider la répartition des droits marketing pour chaque événement, assurer le suivi des contrats LOC, valider les partenaires locaux et organiser des visites de sites avec sponsors et LOC.  * Déployer et superviser la stratégie merchandising et licensing de la marque UCI « Rainbow » : gammes de produits, partenaires de production et de distribution, conformité de l’utilisation de la marque.  * Préparer, analyser et suivre le budget de la division ainsi que les revenus marketing et commerciaux.  * Toute autre mission liée au service marketing et commercial, selon les besoins du service.    **Profil:*** Formation supérieure en marketing, commerce, management du sport ou commerce international, idéalement avec une spécialisation en marketing sportif ou sponsoring, ou expérience équivalente.  * 7 à 10 ans d’expérience en marketing, partenariats, sponsoring ou vente de droits, de préférence dans le sport international ou l’événementiel.  * Expérience confirmée de la vente et de la négociation de partenariats, avec des résultats commerciaux démontrables.  * Expérience du pilotage d’agences commerciales ou de prestataires externes.  * Expérience confirmée en management d’équipe et en coordination de projets internationaux.  * Expérience de la livraison de contreparties partenaires et d’activations sur des événements sportifs majeurs.  * Connaissance du merchandising et du licensing.  * Capacité à développer et entretenir des relations solides avec les partenaires et les comités d’organisation locaux.  * Esprit créatif pour proposer des concepts marketing innovants et des activations digitales.  * Rigueur, sens de l’organisation et capacité à gérer les pics d’activité liés aux événements.  * Parfaite maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, écrit et oral.  * Intérêt pour le sport, idéalement le cyclisme.  * Disponible pour voyager et travailler ponctuellement les week\-ends.    **Entrée en fonction:** de suite ou à convenir Nous rejoindre, c’est avoir l’opportunité d’exploiter Wir möchten auch Sie bewegen und vorwärts bringen deshalb suchen wir eine/n**Chauffeur C/E auf Autoporter oder Sattelschlepper 100% (LKW Standort dort wo Sie wohnen oder Oberhasli)****Unsere Kunden und wir zählen auf Sie weil:**Sie sind täglich in der Schweiz unterwegs und liefern mit ihrem persönlich zugeteilten Fahrzeug Transporte aus für unsere Kunden (PW und Motorräder). Sie erwartet eine Stelle, in welcher Sie in Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Disposition die Aufträge ausführen, sowie wo Sie ein grosses an Eigenverantwortung mit bringen. Sie sind die Visitenkarte bei der Abholung und Auslieferung an unsere Kunden. (Garagen, Private usw.)**Wir erwarten von Ihnen:**Sie verfügen über **eine technische Ausbildung vorzugsweise im Automobilbereich und/oder sind gelernter Chauffeur**, **haben überdurchschnittlich hohe Sozialkompetenz**, beherrschen die Deutsche Sprache und können sich vorstellen auch 1 bis 2 mal in der Woche im LKW zu übernachten. title: Research Ethics Compliance Officer Sensitive Data
description: Ref 2592631 \\\| Date: 23 Nov 2026 !\[EPFL\]( ) EPFL, the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Lausanne, is one of the most dynamic university campuses in Europe and ranks among the top 20 universities worldwide. The EPFL employs more than 6,500 people supporting the three main missions of the institution: education, research and innovation. The EPFL campus offers an exceptional working environment at the heart of a community of more than 17,000 people, including over 12,500 students and 4,000 researchers from more than 120 different countries. Research Ethics Compliance Officer Sensitive Data \*\*Mission\*\* The EPFL Research Office (ReO) is seeking a Research Ethics Compliance Officer to support EPFL's research community with ethics compliance and governance aspects of research projects that are within the scope of the Swiss Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the Federal Data Protection Act. This position will also support the establishment and implementation of (i) EPFL's Trusted Research Environment (TRE) "" an ISO 27001\\-certified infrastructure for the processing of sensitive data, with a focus on health\\-related data "" and (ii) the institutional biobank. The candidate is an individual with proven competence in ethics compliance related to scientific research (incl. with health\\-related data and human samples). She/he will have excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a dynamic team. \*\*Main duties and responsibilities\*\* Support EPFL principal investigators and ReO Programme Managers in ensuring ethics and regulatory compliance \* Advise researchers on the applicable ethics and regulatory framework for research involving human participants, human biological samples, and personal/sensitive data. \* Assess the applicability of the Swiss Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings (HRA) and its Ordinances, the Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP), and other Swiss or international requirements, in collaboration with Legal Affairs. \* Guide researchers through appropriate ethics approval procedures and support applications to Cantonal ethics committees. \* Review submissions for quality and completeness and support amendments, renewals and project closures. \* Act as point of contact between researchers and Cantonal ethics committees or other relevant authorities (FOPH, FOEN, etc.) and support follow\\-up on their requirements. Develop guidance documents, resources, training and awareness\\-raising initiatives \* Contribute to institutional procedures and SOPs for research involving human participants, human biological samples, and personal and sensitive data, particularly health\\-related data. \* Develop practical guidance and resources and promote good practices in human research through training and awareness\\-raising activities. Provide support on specific ethics compliance and regulatory questions \* Provide tailored advice on ethics and regulatory questions throughout the lifecycle of projects within the scope of the HRA, FADP. \* Advise on regulatory aspects of human biological sample transfers and redirect researchers to Legal Affairs and TTO for relevant agreements. \* Coordinate with Legal Affairs, TTO, DPO, Library, IT services, Biosafety officers and DSPS on cross\\-cutting regulatory matters. \* Contribute to institutional ethics compliance procedures and positions on emerging regulatory questions, in collaboration with relevant services. Provide ethics compliance input and support for the development and implementation of EPFL's institutional framework for the management of sensitive research data (focus: health\\-related data) and biological samples \* Contribute to the roadmap for EPFL's sensitive/human research data framework, in collaboration with the Institutional Coordinator Human Research Infrastructure and relevant institutional units (Legal Affairs, DPO, IT, etc.). \* Develop internal governance frameworks, workflows/SOPs, tools and guidance for the ethics/legal compliance of projects involving sensitive research data and/or biological samples. \* Ensure ethics compliance and governance requirements for EPFL's biobank infrastructure, including governance regulations, consent documentation and procedures, and certification processes ( SBP Label or ISO). \* Obtain ethics authorization for the EPFL biobank infrastructure, including preparation and submission of the application and interactions with the Cantonal Ethics Committee. Support the activities of the EPFL Human Research Ethics Committee (HREC) \* Provide regulatory and administrative support for the review and follow\\-up of research protocols involving humans that fall outside the HRA but require HREC approval. Support other tasks within the ReO/Ethics Affairs \* Maintain an institutional overview of HRA protocols where EPFL acts as sponsor, partner or participant, including authorizations, amendments, renewals and closures. \* Collaborate with relevant internal services on cross\\-cutting ethics compliance and regulatory matters. \* Support other Ethics Affairs activities as required. \*\*Profile\*\* \* Master's degree in a relevant field, such as law (specialization human research), public health, life sciences, biomedical sciences or related field (additional certifications and licenses in relation to ethics compliance, biobanking and data protection will be considered a strong asset). \* Solid knowledge and expertise about the ethics compliance framework and of the ethics compliance and governance requirements in Switzerland (Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the Federal Data Protection Act (FADP) and their application). \* Knowledge about management of human biological samples, human subjects/clinical research data, clinical trials, and biobanks. \* Extensive experience with the preparation and submission of ethics applications to the Cantonal Ethics Committees. \* Ability to analyse and understand research projects in relation to the Federal Act on Research involving Human Beings and the FADP. \* Ability to explain the ethics compliance regulations on research involving humans, personal/sensitive data, biological samples, etc. to researchers who are not necessarily familiar with this area of work. \* Experience in preparing and developing ethics compliance related guidance documents and tools/resources for a broad audience. \* Excellent collaboration skills to conduct joint projects and to liaise with internal and external stakeholders (such as legal affairs, cantonal ethics commissions, etc.). \* Good organization skills, and the ability to set priorities and meet deadlines. \* The ability to work both independently and in a team, and to adapt to the individual needs of EPFL principal investigators. \* Excellent collaboration skills to conduct joint projects and to liaise with internal and external stakeholders (such as legal affairs, DPO, IT, Cantonal ethics commissions, etc.). \* Strong writing, editing and proofreading skills in English. \*\*We offer\*\* \* A dynamic and cosmopolitan work environment in a multidisciplinary institution. \* Competitive salary, remote working may be possible for a portion of the time. \* The opportunity of continuous training and development according to the requirements of the function. At EPFL, we believe that people achieve great results when they feel supported, respected and enabled to succeed. By joining our community, you will help shape the future of society through education, research and innovation. We offer an inspiring, international and collaborative environment where your work has real impact and your ideas are valued. Combined with flexible ways of working and attractive employment conditions, we aim to create an environment where everyone can contribute, grow and make a difference. Beyond work, our campuses host a vibrant community and unique environment, enriched by initiatives promoting equality, inclusion, diversity, well\\-being and sustainability as well as an engaging program of cultural, sports and community activities throughout the year. \[Read about our employment conditions and employee benefits\](\< \> " ") \*\*Informations\*\* Contract Start Date : Activity Rate Min : Activity Rate Max : Contract Type: CDD Duration: one year Reference: 2606 jpid4c643c1jm jpit1148jm jpiy26jm

Working hours follow the camp schedule and include some evenings and weekends.Benefits : Full board and single-room accommodation on campus, laundry service, accident insurance.Experience : Experience leading workshops or projects with children or teenagers, ideally in entrepreneurship, business or project-based learning.About Le RoseyWith a reputation spanning generations, Le Rosey is the oldest and largest boarding school in Switzerland. in AI research, tools, and industry practices to inform technology decisions.## Required Experience and Technical Skills- **8+ years in software or data engineering**, including **4+ years designing HR Business Partner
===================

**The company**

The Swatch Group Services Ltd. is a dynamic company of the Swatch Group providing high quality services to the Group organizations worldwide in the fields of Logistics, Customer Services, Quality Management Real Estate \& Gems. The company belongs to the Swatch Group, the world's largest watch maker with a portfolio of 16 brands of which Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak.

Swatch Group Services offers a unique ecosystem where people can accomplish their goals and achieve their aspirations. To strengthen our HR team, we are offering an exciting opportunity based between Biel (60%) and Neuchâtel (40%), with flexibility to discuss the allocation. We are currently looking for an:

**HR Business Partner (100%)**

**Job description**

In this role, you will manage the complete employee life cycle and support our managers as a coach and consultant, helping them guide their teams toward success. Your mission? Build a great work environment, solve challenges with style, and contribute to the vibrant culture of our company.

**Profile**

**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Act as the main point of contact for employees and managers (\>150 employees)
* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment and staffing for The Swatch Group Services in the fields of Logistics, Customer Services, Quality Management, Real Estate as well as for the Group's companies based in Neuchâtel.
* Be a partner with managers to analyse needs and select top talent.
* Negotiate offers, prepare contracts, and ensure smooth onboarding \& offboarding.
* Provide guidance on employee relations, performance topics, and change initiatives.
* Support managers in handling discussions, resolving issues, and navigating team conflicts.
* Organise and control of the yearly evaluation and talent management process, and follow\-up with measures if needed.
* Follow up on development needs and action plans.
* Handle warnings and contract terminations.


At Swatch Group Services, we value fresh ideas, especially in areas like employer branding, employee retention \& HR process optimization, to keep improving our quality standards and elevating the employee experience.

**Professional requirements**

* University degree in HR or equivalent (Brevet fédéral) with over 5 years of experience in a similar role.
* You are a natural networker, collaborate efficiently with everybody and you build a trustful relationship at all levels and be regarded as a trusted partner.
* You get a strong experience in Recruitment ideally in the Supply Chain field. Hands on in sourcing.
* You have an excellent consultative and client service skill with the ability to effectively influence and manage key relationships with a strong knowledge of Swiss law.
* Autonomous and self\-motivated, with initiative and an ability to manage multiple priorities with a sense of urgency.
* You are data driven as well as highly organized: You have a very structured way of working, being able to prioritize a variety of complex tasks and to complete them diligently


**You're missing one or two skills in the list, yet you're eager to learn?  
It's perfectly OK. We like to share.**

**Languages**

Now, in order to blend in, socially and professionally, we certainly recommend the following languages:

* Fluent in French and in English, combined with good knowledge of German considered an asset.
* Any other languages are welcome \- we have 29 so far in the company, if you wish to add the 30th, you pretty much know what to do


**Company address**

**Contact**

A dynamic and evolving work environment, complemented by attractive benefits:

* Continuous training to support your professional development
* Career growth opportunities through our internal mobility policy
* 5 to 6 weeks of vacation per year, depending on your age and/or position
* A 40\-hour work week, in line with the collective labor agreement (CCT)
* Competitive salary and excellent social benefits
* Parental leave: up to 3 weeks for the other parent and 19 weeks for mothers
* On\-site company restaurant with employer financial contribution
* Exclusive discounts on Swatch Group products and with our partners
* Sports activities and internal events to foster team spirit
* Contribution to health insurance costs


Ready to debug your career and deploy your next challenge? ? Apply now ?  
Just a quick note from our sysadmin: to keep things clean and green , we only accept applications through our website.

Aline Huguenin

description: Postdoc in Computational Systems Biology and Metabolic Modeling Postdoc in Computational Systems Biology and Metabolic Modeling===============================================================Dysregulation of lipid metabolism plays a key role in the development and progression of metabolic disorders, including obesity, type 2 diabetes, and metabolic dysfunction\-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist in Computational and Systems Biology to work on a project funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) aimed at advancing our understanding of human lipid metabolism in MASLD. The project focuses on modelling human metabolism by integrating clinical data with experimental models. It involves biochemical and molecular data from multiple tissues and biofluids to investigate tissue\-specific metabolism, metabolic interactions across organs, and nutrient uptake, transformation, and release. The project combines statistical modelling, systems biology, and in silico metabolic modelling with clinical, transcriptomic, proteomic, metabolomic/lipidomic, spatial molecular imaging, and experimental metabolic flux data to provide new insights into the complex metabolic alterations underlying MASLD.**What you can expect*** Develop and apply mathematical, statistical, and title: Linux System Engineer
description: Are you ready to take ownership of world-class Linux infrastructure in a dynamic biological research environment? Linux and storage service delivery is shared across three team members (with our fourth colleague focusing on Windows and virtualization). In this position, you will lead the core technical architecture and operations, while two team members work somewhat more closely with daily client and customer support. Underpinning our local setup are the central services of ETH ID, providing robust networking, central storage, and a growing central Linux core.Whether you are already an experienced senior engineer or a talented, motivated Linux professional ready to step into a larger role and expand your capabilities, we offer the autonomy and support for you to thrive. We operate in 16 countries and are backed by leading institutional investors DigitalBridge and Swiss Life Asset Managers, with over $ billion committed to infrastructure. TIP acts as a trusted commercial partner to property owners who host structures such as mobile (cell) sites or rooftop antennas. We provide upfront lease payments and professionally manage agreements, giving owners financial security, reducing risk, and handling the long\\-term complexities of their leases. We also work closely with telecom operators and infrastructure companies, offering reliable, structured access to network sites under clear, professionally managed agreements. This approach allows operators to focus on building and operating networks, while we manage lease administration and complexity. Our work sits at the intersection of finance, telecom, and real estate, and at the heart of it all is our commitment to long\\-term partnerships built on trust, transparency, and value. We are growing our Swiss team and recruiting a Business Development Manager (internally known as an Investment \\\& Development Manager 'IDM') to be based in Valais. This is an exciting opportunity to join TIP at a time of growth and play a key role in building our presence across Switzerland. \*\*Our Culture and Values\*\* We're a company in motion. Like many growing businesses, things move fast and not everything is fully refined. We're building processes, shaping systems, improving how we work, and learning as we go. It's not always perfect, but that's where the opportunity lies in making a meaningful impact and helping to shape what TIP becomes next. \* We Put People First. \* We Pursue Excellence. \* We Act with Authenticity. \* We Act with Integrity. \* We Embrace Change. We're focused on building a culture that supports both pace and progress. That means putting strong foundations in place, being clear on our values, and creating an environment where people can do their best work with trust, autonomy, and a shared commitment to continuous improvement. \*\*How You Will Contribute\*\* As a Business Development Manager at TIP, you'll be responsible for sourcing and closing deals with property owners who host telecom infrastructure. That means identifying potential clients, building trust, and helping them understand the benefits of turning lease income into upfront capital. This is a commercially focused role where your success depends on your ability to build relationships, offer credible guidance, and manage deals from first contact through to close. As part of our growing team in Switzerland, you'll play a key role in expanding our presence and building strong local partnerships based on cultural, linguistic, and regulatory understanding. In this role, you will: \* Own and grow a regional territory within Switzerland, managing your own pipeline of prospects. \* Identify and approach new leads through research, outreach, and referrals. \* Build rapport with landowners and institutions, offering clear, honest advice. \* Present and negotiate offers, handling questions and objections with confidence. \* Review lease and legal documents to identify risks, obligations, and value. \* Collaborate with internal teams including Legal, Underwriting, and Operations to progress deals. \* Keep accurate records in our CRM and manage activity across your portfolio. \* Stay informed on market trends and apply insights to shape your strategy. \* Advise property owners on financial decisions and lead deals that have tangible, measurable impact on their assets and our business. \*\*About You\*\* This role would suit someone who: \* Has experience in field based, client\\-facing, results driven roles ( real estate, business development, account management, sales, recruitment etc). \* Communicates clearly and builds trust quickly with a wide range of stakeholders. \* Works independently, takes ownership, and delivers results while being a collaborative team player. \* Can stay organised and manage multiple priorities. \* Is curious, adaptable, and open to feedback. \* Thrives in a collaborative, dynamic, and supportive environment. \* Is comfortable with some regional travel. We're a global company with deep local roots, so fluency in both spoken French and Swiss German are essential for this role. English skills are also a plus, as it's the language we use to connect across our international teams. \*\*Bonus skills:\*\* \* Familiarity with legal, financial, or investment processes \* Confidence with Microsoft Office and CRM systems \* Experience engaging with both private landowners and institutional decision\\-makers \*\*Why Join TIP?\*\* We want our people to thrive, both professionally and personally, and we offer a package designed to support that: \* Competitive compensation with performance\\-based incentives. \* Hybrid and flexible working model, with connection to our head office in Zurich \* Opportunities for professional development, including structured training and on\\-the\\-job learning. \* Career growth potential in Switzerland and across our international teams. \* A collaborative and inclusive workplace built on trust, transparency, and respect. \* The chance to make a meaningful impact in a dynamic and expanding industry. !\[Telecom Infrastructure Partners Switzerland GmbH\]( ) \* Telecom Infrastructure Partners Switzerland GmbH Thurgauerstrasse 101 8152 Glattpark (Opfikon) \* \[ \](\< \>) jpida0eb91cjm jpit1148jm jpiy26jm
