title: Culinary Chef Instructor
description: Swiss Education Group (SEG) is the largest private educator in Switzerland. We currently operate 4 of the world’s top hospitality schools and have more than 6000 students enrolled in our courses.  With nearly 40 years experience in hospitality, business, and culinary arts education, we are firmly rooted in the great tradition of Swiss hospitality.We are committed to equipping our students with the leadership and entrepreneurial skills they need to thrive in the hospitality industry and beyond. We offer a wide range of hospitality education courses, including Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees. We also offer short professional courses, so students can choose a program that is specific to their individual learning needs and professional interests.For our campuses Cesar Ritz Colleges Switzerland and from January 6th 2026, we are looking for :  Culinary Chef InstructorThe successful candidate will join a dynamic team, committed to the delivery of high quality programs and will be required to teach to multi-cultural profiles. Key Responsibilities:Teach Kitchen theory and practical classes to students according to our standardsAdvise students on menu preparation and techniquesEnsure and provide quality food production for students and staffElaborate and update course materialEnsure proper maintenance and usage of all equipment within the designated sectionDemonstrate sanitation, cleanliness and security of the kitchen and storerooms to studentsRequirements :Degree from a recognized culinary school as a Cook (Professional Certificate or equivalent)At least 5 years’ experience in the industry, ideally in renowned restaurantsUp-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in culinary artsCulinary teaching experience within a hospitality school a strong assetCreative team-player, able to work in a very international environmentSens of Initiative, creativity, maturity, leadership skillsFluent in English written and spoken (mandatory), French is strong an asset.Ideally based in the canton of Valais, between Le Bouveret and Brig.

title: Office Manager – Finance & HR Administration
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Office Manager – Finance &amp; HR Administration--- Office Manager – Finance \& HR Administration===============================================About NÜKT-----------NÜKT is a Swiss snack brand introducing a new generation of chips made using ZEEN Tech’s patented \-in\-Water technology. We are preparing to bring our products to selected European markets and beyond.Your Role---------As our Office Manager, you will support the smooth day\-to\-day running of NÜKT and keep office, finance, HR and contract administration organised. Your responsibilities will include routine bookkeeping, invoice and payment administration, employee documentation, recruitment coordination and contract records. You will support management with financial information and planning materials, and coordinate with external accounting, payroll and legal advisers where needed.Key Responsibilities--------------------**1\. Office Administration**Coordinate day\-to\-day office administration and help keep internal processes and documentation organised.Maintain office records and coordinate routine administrative matters with management and service providers.**2\. Finance \& Accounting Administration**Manage routine bookkeeping, accounts payable and accounts receivable, ensuring accurate and timely records.Prepare customer invoices, process supplier invoices and employee expenses, and coordinate payment runs for approval.Follow up on outstanding customer payments and keep payment records up to date.Reconcile bank accounts and maintain orderly financial documentation and filing systems.Support monthly and year\-end closing by preparing documents and schedules in coordination with external accountants.Assist management with compiling information for financial reports and planning materials.Help maintain efficient accounting workflows and internal controls.**3\. HR Administration \& Recruitment**Support recruitment activities and coordinate interviews, onboarding and offboarding.Prepare employment contracts, amendments, references and other employee documents in coordination with management.Maintain complete and confidential personnel files and keep employee documentation organised.Track working time, holidays and absences.Prepare payroll inputs and coordinate with external payroll and social insurance providers.Act as a point of contact for routine employee questions and support consistent HR processes.**4\. Contract Management \& Administration**Maintain an organised central register of customer, supplier and service agreements, including signed copies and supporting documents.Track key dates, renewal periods, notice periods and approval status, and remind the relevant people when action is due.Coordinate document preparation, review and signing workflows with management and external legal advisers.Keep records of agreed changes and ensure that the latest contract versions are easy to locate.Your Profile------------**Professional Qualifications**Commercial education or training in office administration, finance, accounting or business administration; equivalent practical experience is welcome.At least three years of experience in office administration, accounting support or a related administrative role.Practical experience processing invoices, payments and routine bookkeeping tasks.Familiarity with Swiss accounting, VAT, payroll or HR administration is an advantage.Confident use of Excel, accounting software and modern digital business tools.Fluent in English and , with clear written and verbal communication skills.Experience in a growing company, food\-tech, FMCG or consumer goods is an advantage.Personal AttributesOrganised, reliable and attentive to detail.Proactive and comfortable handling a broad range of administrative tasks.Trustworthy and discreet when handling financial, contractual and employee information.Practical and solution\-oriented, with the ability to prioritise and meet deadlines.Collaborative and adaptable in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment.What We Offer-------------A varied and responsible role in an innovative Swiss snack company.The opportunity to help build the organisational foundations of a growing international snack brand.A high degree of independence and scope to contribute your own ideas.Close collaboration with management and short decision\-making processes.Opportunities for professional development and additional responsibility as the company grows.Join NÜKT----------We are looking for someone who brings structure to everyday operations and enjoys supporting finance, HR and contract administration. If you are organised, practical and ready to contribute to the growth of an innovative food company, we would love to hear from you.**Be part of NÜKT and help us shape the future of snacking.**![Nuekt AG]()* Nuekt AG  Artherstrasse 60  6405 Immensee*jid36b5256jm jit1148jm jiy26jm
